author: john-owen
fields.title: Okutta Ekibi mu Bakkiriza
fields.subtitle: Okutta Ekibi ku bw’Omwoyo
fields.description: “Beera ng’otta ekibi oba kijja kuba nga kikutta” ye sentensi ya Owen esinga okujuliziddwa, era kino kye kitabo mw’eva. Kyawandiikirwa abayizi b’e Oxford abaali tebalina kye batuukako mu kulwanyisa emize gye baali bakyawa, era kigaana eby’okuddamu byombi ebyangu: nti Omukristaayo tasaanye kulwana, n’nti okulwana n’amaanyi agasingawo kwe kuddamu. Mu kifo ky’ekyo Owen ayita mu kibi ekikwata omuntu bwe kiri ddala, engeri gye kifunamu ettaka, n’ensonga lwaki Omwoyo yekka y’ayinza okukitta — n’obutereevu ku kwerimbalimba abawandiisi batono ennyo ab’edda oba ab’oluvannyuma be bakyenkanyaako.
fields.about_html:
Owen ky’ayogerako kye kitundu kya Pawulo mu Abaruumi 8:13 — “bwe munnatta ebikolwa eby’omubiri, muliba balamu” — era ensonga ye enkulu lwe lunyiriri buli muntu lw’ajuliza: beera ng’otta ekibi, oba kijja kuba nga kikutta. Ebiddirira kwe kwekenneenya okusinga obwegendereza mu Lungereza ku ngeri ekibi ekikwata omuntu gye kikola ddala, ebyeefuula eddagala lyakyo, n’ensonga lwaki amaanyi g’okwagala n’okwekyawa si kye kimu n’okutta ekibi.

Kyatandika ng’ebigambo ebyabuulirwa abayizi b’e Oxford Owen bwe yali omumyuka w’omukulu wa yunivasite eyo — okusinga abavubuka, abaali bagambibwa nti ekibi tekifugibwa na kusalawo. Abawuliriza abo bayinza okulabika: ekitabo kya butereevu, tekiriimu birooto, era kitwala nti abakiwulira baali bagezaako dda era nga balemererwa dda.

Ekitabo kigabanyizibwamu ebitundu bisatu, era eky’okusatu kye kisinga omugaso: ng’amaze okulaga nti omulimu guno gwa bulamu bwonna era nti Omwoyo y’akola omulimu, Owen akyukira ku bulagirizi — engeri y’okutikka omuntu ow’omunda omusango gw’ekibi, engeri y’okukinoonyereza okutuuka ku kye kyetaaga ddala, engeri y’okwawula ekibi ekifunye ekiwundu ku kibi ekifudde. Kye kitundu ekisinga obutafaanana ng’eby’eddiini era ekisinga okufaanana ng’okukebera kw’omusawo.

Ebigambo bya Owen bye bisinga obuzibu ku kitabo kyonna ku sseddaala lino; sentensi mpanvu era ebitundu byazo bituumiddwa. Era kye kitabo abasomi kye basinga okugamba nti kyakyusa engeri gye balwanamu. Kitwale mpola — ekitundu kimu buli lw’otuula — era kijja kubikkuka.

qa.question: Ekitabo Okutta Ekibi kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kwe kwekenneenya okusinga obwegendereza mu Lungereza ku ngeri ekibi ekikwata omuntu gye kikola ddala, ekyeefuula eddagala lyakyo mu bulimba, n’engeri gye kittibwamu ddala. Owen akwata ekitundu kya Pawulo mu Abaruumi 8:13 — nti bwe tunatta ebikolwa eby’omubiri ku bw’Omwoyo, tuliba balamu — n’akifuula ekitabo eky’okulagirira ekinoonyereza era eky’omugaso eri Omukristaayo alwana n’ekibi naye ng’awangulwa.

qa.question: Sentensi ya Owen esinga okumanyibwa y’eruwa?
qa.answer: Beera ng’otta ekibi, oba kijja kuba nga kikutta. Lwe lunyiriri ekitabo kyonna lwe kibeererawo okunnyonnyola: nti ekibi ekibeera mu ffe tekyebaka era tekiba kya wakati, wabula bulijjo kikola, kale omukkiriza alekera awo okulwana ajja kusanga ng’olutalo lumulwanyisibwa ye. Okusinziira ku Owen, obulamu bw’Omukristaayo bulimu olutalo olwa buli lunaku era olw’okugenderera olutawangulwa ddala ku luuyi luno olw’okufa.

qa.question: Owen yakiwandiikira ani?
qa.answer: Kyatandika ng’ebigambo ebyabuulirwa abayizi b’e Oxford Owen bwe yali omumyuka w’omukulu wa yunivasite eyo — okusinga abavubuka abaali tebalina kye batuukako mu kulwanyisa emize gye baali bakyawa. Abawuliriza abo bayinza okulabika: ekitabo kya butereevu, tekiriimu birooto, era kitwala nti abakisoma baali bagezaako dda era nga balemererwa dda, era eyo y’ensonga ddala lwaki kigaana okubawa amaanyi g’okwagala agasingawo ng’eky’okuddamu.

qa.question: 'Okutta ekibi' kitegeeza ki ddala wano?
qa.answer: Si kuziyiza buziyiza kikolwa eky’okungulu, si kwekyawa, era si kasirise ak’akaseera akaddirira okutiisibwa, wabula kunafuya ekibi okuva ku kikolo kyakyo ku bw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Owen yeegendereza okwawula okutta ekibi okw’amazima ku bifaananyi byakwo eby’obulimba ebingi — ekibi ekikyusiddwa obukyusibwa, oba ekikwekeddwa, oba omuntu kye yakaddiyiramu n’akivaamu — era anyweza nti gwe mulimu gw’Omwoyo omukkiriza mw’akolera awamu, so si atudde butuuzi.

qa.question: Owen alowooza nti amaanyi g’okwagala gayinza okuwangula ekibi?
qa.answer: Nedda — era ekitundu kinene eky’ekitabo kiraga lwaki okwefuba, okusalawo, n’okwekyawa si kye kimu n’okutta ekibi era tebiyinza kukola mulimu gwakwo. Amaanyi g’okwagala gayinza okuziyiza ekibi okweyoleka naye ne galeka obulamu bwakyo nga tebukwatiddwako. Mu kifo ky’ekyo Owen alagirira alwana eri omusaalaba n’eri Omwoyo, eri okukkiriza Kristo n’omutima ogukuumibwa nga mugonvu, ng’amaanyi gokka agatta ddala ekibi mu kifo ky’okukisiba omumwa obusibi.

qa.question: Ekitabo kizimbiddwa ku kyawandiikibwa ki?
qa.answer: Abaruumi 8:13 — 'bwe munnatta ebikolwa eby’omubiri, muliba balamu.' Owen apima kumpi buli kigambo kyakwo: nti omulimu gwa mukkiriza, nti amaanyi ga Mwoyo, nti ekigendererwa bye bikolwa eby’omubiri, era nti ekisuubizo ekigattiddwako bwe bulamu. Ekitabo kyonna mu butuufu ye nnyinnyonnyola y’olunyiriri olwo lumu nga lunyigirizibwa ku muntu ow’omunda.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kya abo bokka abalina ekibi 'ekinene'?
qa.answer: Nedda — Owen awandiikira buli mukkiriza, kubanga ekibi ekibeera mu ffe kisigala ne mu Mukristaayo asinga obutukuvu era olutalo lwa bulamu bwonna. Alabula okusingira ddala ku kwerowooza nti omuntu ayise akabi. Ekitabo kibadde kitwalibwa nga kya muwendo okumala ebyasa kubanga kyogera ku ntalo eza bulijjo era ezikwekeddwa ez’Abakristaayo abanyiikivu, so si ku kugwa okw’olulango kwokka.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanye kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, ng’asoma mpola — kizitowa naye si kiwanvu. Owen asooka kulaga obwetaavu n’obutonde bw’okutta ekibi, oluvannyuma n’abikkula eddagala ery’obulimba, oluvannyuma n’awa obulagirizi ku mulimu gwennyini. Abasomi batera okusanga essuula ezikebera, ku ekyo okutta ekibi kye kutali, nga ze zisinga okunoonyereza mu mutima; naye ekitabo kigendereddwamu okukoma mu ssuubi, ku musaalaba ekibi we kizikirizibwa ddala.

fields.title: Ennyanjula
fields.body_html:
Omusomi Omukristaayo,

Mu bigambo bitono njagala okukubuulira ensonga ezankkirizisa okufulumya okwogera kuno okuddako. Ensonga esinga obukulu mu zo kwe kulowooza ku mbeera abeeyatula eddiini abasinga obungi gye balimu kaakano: obubonero obulabika obw’embeera y’emitima gyabwe n’emyoyo gyabwe bulaga nti banafu nnyo okulwanyisa ebikemo ebibeetoolodde — ebiva mu mirembe gye balina mu nsi, ne mu kweyawulamu kwe balina bokka na bokka. Kino nkakasa nti kikulu nnyo, ne kiba nti singa ku lw’ekyo nkubiriza bukubiriza abalala okunyigiriza n’amaanyi ku mitima gy’abantu omulimu gw’okulowooza ku makubo gaabwe, n’okuwa obulagirizi obweyongera okutegeerekeka ku ngeri y’okutuuka ku kigendererwa ekyo, nja kwesiima olw’omugabo gwange mu mulimu guno. Ku kyo kwagattibwako okulaba ensobi ez’akabi ez’abantu abamu, abeetwala mu nnaku zino ezisembyeyo okuwa obulagirizi ku kutta ekibi; abo, olw’obutamanya kyama kya njiri n’amaanyi g’okufa kwa Kristo, bazzeemu okussa ku nsingo z’abayigirizwa baabwe ekikoligo ky’okutta ekibi kwe beekolera bokka, ekitaasobola kwetikkibwa bo wadde bajjajjaabwe. Okutta ekibi kwe batendereza era kwe bakaka abantu tekufaanana n’okw’enjiri mu ngeri yonna — si mu kikula kyakwo, si mu abo be kukwatako, si mu nsibuko zaakwo, si mu makubo gaakwo, wadde mu bibala byakwo; era bulijjo kuleeta ebivaamu eby’ennaku: obulombolombo obutaliimu, obutuukirivu obw’okwekolera, n’okweraliikirira kw’omutima mu abo abeetikka omugugu ogwo ogubasibiddwa bwe gutyo.

Kye ndeeta wano mu bunafu, nsuubira n’obwetoowaze nti kijja kukwatagana n’omwoyo n’ebigambo by’enjiri, era n’ebyo abo abamanyi kye kitegeeza okutambula ne Katonda bye bayiseemu, ng’endagaano ey’ekisa bw’egamba. Bwe kiba si kino, ddala ekintu eky’engeri eno kyetaagisa nnyo mu kiseera kino okukulaakulanya n’okutwala mu maaso omulimu guno ogw’okutta ekibi okw’enjiri mu mitima gy’abakkiriza, n’okubalung’amya mu makubo amateefu, mwe bayinza okufunira emmeeme zaabwe ekiwummulo. Nnina kye nnyongerako ku bikwata ku nze nzennyini. Bwe nnamala okubuulira ku nsonga eno, ne kibaamu ebibala ebizzaamu amaanyi, olw’ekisa ky’oyo awa omulimi ensigo okusiga, abantu abawerako, abalina amakubo ga Katonda mu mitima gyabwe, bampaliriza okufulumya bwe ntyo bye nnabuulira, nga nongerako n’okukyusaamu nga bwe nnandirabye nga kyetaagisa. Nga nsikiriziddwa okwegomba kwabwe, ne nzijukira ebbanja lye mmaze emyaka egiwerako nga mbanjibwa mikwano gyange Abakristaayo abawerako ab’ekitiibwa era abasaanidde, ery’ekitabo ku Kussa Ekimu ne Katonda kye nnabasuubiza edda; ne ndowooza nti obanga sisobola kusasula bbanja eddene ku lw’ekyo, nnyinza okubawa okwogera kuno okukwata ku kulwana n’obwabwe bokka, ng’amagoba olw’okugumiikiriza kwabwe nga balindirira okwo okukwata ku mirembe n’okussa ekimu ne Katonda. Ate era nalowooza nti olw’enteekateeka ya Katonda nnali mbadde mu kukubaganya ebirowoozo mu lwatu ku nkaayana ez’enjawulo mu by’eddiini, ekyo ne kiyinza okulabika ng’ekyetaaga ekintu eky’engeri endala ekigasa abantu bonna, ng’ekibala eky’okwerondera, so si eky’obuwaze. Olw’ensonga ezo n’endala ezifaanana bwe zityo, okwogera kuno okumpi kufulumiziddwa mu lwatu, era kaakano kwe nkuwa. Nsuubira nti nnyinza okwatula mu mazima nti okwegomba kw’omutima gwange eri Katonda, n’ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’obulamu bwange mu kifo enteekateeka ennungi eya Katonda mwe yanteeka, kwe kuba nti okutta ekibi n’obutukuvu mu byonna bikulaakulane mu mutima gwange ne mu mitima n’amakubo g’abalala, Katonda agulumizibwe; enjiri ya Mukama waffe era Omulokozi waffe Yesu Kristo eyonjebwe mu byonna. Okutuuka ku kigendererwa ekyo, obanga okwogera kuno akatono (ku kufulumizibwa kwakwo kuno kwe kunnyonnyola kwange kwonna kwe nnaawa) kunaagasa mu kintu kyonna omutukuvu asembayo obutono, kujja kutwalibwa ng’okuddibwamu kw’essaala ennafu ezikuwerekera okuva eri omuwandiisi waakwo atasaanidde,

John Owen.

fields.title: Omusingi gw’okwogera kwonna, oguzimbiddwa ku Abaruumi 8:13
fields.body_html:
Omusingi gw’okwogera kwonna okuddako guzimbibwa ku (Abaruumi 8:13) — Ebigambo by’omutume binnyonnyolwa — Okukwatagana okukakafu wakati w’okutta ekibi okw’amazima n’obulokozi — Okutta ekibi mulimu gwa bakkiriza — Omwoyo ye nsibuko enkulu ekukola — Kiki ekitegeezebwa “omubiri” mu bigambo by’omutume — Kiki ekitegeezebwa “ebikolwa eby’omubiri” — Obulamu, mu ngeri ki gye busuubizibwa olw’omulimu guno.

Obulagirizi bwe nnina okuwaayo ku kutwala mu maaso omulimu gw’okutta ekibi mu bakkiriza bulyoke bubeere mu nteekateeka era butegeerekeke, nja kuzimba omusingi gwabwo ku bigambo by’omutume ebyo, (Abaruumi 8:13), ebigamba nti ku bw’Omwoyo, “bwe munnatta ebikolwa eby’omubiri, muliba balamu;” era nja kukyusa byonna okuba okukozesa amazima ag’enjiri amakulu n’ekyama ebiri mu byo.

Omutume bw’amala okuddamu mu bufunze okuyigiriza kwe ku kuweebwa obutuukirivu olw’okukkiriza, n’embeera ey’omukisa ey’abo abafuulibwa ku bw’ekisa okugabana ku bwo, (ennyiriri 1-3) ez’essuula eno, agenda mu maaso okubikozesa ku butukuvu n’okubudaabudibwa kw’abakkiriza.

Mu nsonga ze n’ebimukubiriza ku butukuvu, olunyiriri lwe twogeddeko lulimu emu eva mu bivaamu n’ebibala ebikontana eby’obutukuvu n’ekibi: “Bwe munaagobereranga omubiri, mugenda kufa.” Kye kitegeeza “munaagobereranga omubiri,” ne kye kitegeeza “kufa,” olw’okuba ekyo si kye ngenderera kaakano, sijja kukinnyonnyola okuggyako nga bwe kinaakwatagana n’amakulu g’ebigambo eby’oluvannyuma eby’olunyiriri, nga bwe twabiteeseteese.

Mu bigambo ebiragiddwa okuba omusingi gw’okwogera okuddako, mulimu, —

Ekisooka, Omulimu ogulagiddwa: “Mutte ebikolwa eby’omubiri.”

Ekyokubiri, Abantu balagibwa abo be gulagirwa: “Mmwe,” — “bwe munnatta.”

Ekyokusatu, Mu bo mulimu ekisuubizo ekigattiddwa ku mulimu ogwo: “Muliba balamu.”

Ekyokuna, Ensibuko oba ekkubo ery’okutuukiriza omulimu guno, — Omwoyo: “Bwe mu… ku bw’Omwoyo.”

Ekyokutaano, Obukwakkulizo obw’ekiteeso kyonna, omuli omulimu, ekkubo, n’ekisuubizo: “Bwe munnatta,” n’ebirala.

1. Ekintu ekisooka okulabika mu bigambo nga bwe biri mu kiteeso kyonna kye kigambo eky’obukwakkulizo, Εἰ δὲ, “Naye bwe.” Ebigambo eby’obukwakkulizo mu biteeso ng’ebyo biyinza okutegeeza ebintu bibiri:—

(1.) Obutali bukakafu obw’ekiriva mu kyo oba ekisuubiziddwa, eri abo abalagiddwa omulimu. Kino kibaawo ng’obukwakkulizo bwetaagisa ddala okutuuka ku kivaamu, ate nga bwo bwennyini tebwesigamye ku nsonga yonna enkakafu emanyiddwa oyo aweereddwa omulimu. Bwe tutyo tugamba nti, “Bwe tunaaba abalamu, tujja kukola kino oba kiri.” Kino tekiyinza kuba kye kigendererwa ky’ebigambo eby’obukwakkulizo mu kifo kino. Ku bantu abo ebigambo bino be byogerwako, kigambibwa mu (olunyiriri 1) olw’essuula y’emu nti, “Tebaliiko musango.”

(2.) Obukakafu bw’okukwatagana n’okuyungibwa okuli wakati w’ebintu ebyogerwako; nga bwe tugamba omulwadde nti, “Bw’onoonywa eddagala lino, oba n’okozesa obujjanjabi buno, ojja kuwona.” Kye tugenderera okwogera kyokka bwe bukakafu bw’okukwatagana okuli wakati w’eddagala oba obujjanjabi n’obulamu. Era kino kye kitegeezebwa wano. Okukwatagana okukakafu okuli wakati w’okutta ebikolwa eby’omubiri n’okuba omulamu kulagibwa mu kigambo kino eky’obukwakkulizo.

Kaakano, okukwatagana kw’ebintu bwe kuba okw’engeri nnyingi, ng’okw’ensibuko n’ekivaamu, okw’ekkubo n’enkomerero, okukwatagana kuno wakati w’okutta ekibi n’obulamu si kwa nsibuko n’ekivaamu mu bulambulukufu bwakwo, — kubanga “ekirabo kya Katonda, bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe,” (Abaruumi 6:23), — wabula kwa kkubo n’enkomerero. Katonda yateekawo ekkubo lino olw’okutuuka ku nkomerero eyo gye yasuubiza ku bwereere. Amakubo, newaakubadde nga geetaagisa, gali bulungi wansi w’enkomerero ey’ekisuubizo eky’obwereere. Ekirabo, n’ensibuko ekifunya mu oyo akiweebwa, tebiyinza kubeerera wamu. Kale ekigendererwa ky’ekiteeso kino eky’obukwakkulizo kiri nti waliwo okukwatagana okukakafu, okutasobya, wakati w’okutta ekibi okw’amazima n’obulamu obutaggwaawo: bw’onookozesa ekkubo lino, ojja kutuuka ku nkomerero eyo; bw’onootta ekibi, ojja kuba mulamu. Era wano we wali ensonga enkulu ekubiriza n’okuggumiza omulimu ogulagiddwa.

2. Ekiddako kye tusanga mu bigambo be bantu abalagiddwa omulimu guno, era kino kyogerwa mu kigambo “Mmwe,” ekiri mu kikolwa mu lulimi olwasooka, θανατοῦτε “bwe munnatta;” — kwe kugamba, mmwe abakkiriza; mmwe abagambibwa nti “tebaliiko musango,” (olunyiriri 1); mmwe “temufugibwa mubiri wabula mufugibwa Mwoyo,” (olunyiriri 9); “abaafuulibwa abalamu ku bw’Omwoyo wa Kristo,” (ennyiriri 10, 11); mmwe mulagiddwa omulimu guno. Okukaka omulimu guno butereevu ku muntu omulala yenna kibala kyeyoleka eky’obulombolombo n’obutuukirivu obw’okwekolera ensi bye ejjudde, — omulimu omukulu n’ekigendererwa ky’abantu abeewaddeyo eri eddiini naye nga tebamanyi njiri, (Abaruumi 10:3, 4; Yokaana 15:5). Kaakano, ennyinnyonnyola eno ey’abantu, nga egattiddwa ku kulagira omulimu, gwe musingi omukulu ogw’okwogera okuddako, nga bwe guli mu kiteeso kino:—

Abakkiriza abasinga obulungi, abaasumululwa ddala okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi obusalira omusango, kibagwanidde naye okufuula omulimu gwabwe ennaku zaabwe zonna okutta obuyinza bw’ekibi ekibeera mu bo.

3. Ensibuko enkulu ekola omulimu guno ye Mwoyo: Εἰ δὲ Πνεύματι, — “ Bwe mu… ku bw’Omwoyo.” Omwoyo ayogerwako wano ye Mwoyo ayogeddwako mu (olunyiriri 11), Omwoyo wa Kristo, Omwoyo wa Katonda, “abeera mu ffe,” (olunyiriri 9), “atufuula abalamu,” (olunyiriri 11); “Omwoyo Omutukuvu,” (olunyiriri 14); “Omwoyo eyabafuula abaana,” (olunyiriri 15); “Omwoyo yennyini atwegayiririra,” (olunyiriri 26). Amakubo amalala gonna ag’okutta ekibi tegaliimu nsa, n’obuyambi bwonna butuleka nga tetuyambiddwa; kirina okukolebwa ku bw’Omwoyo. Abantu, ng’omutume bw’alaga, (Abaruumi 9:30-32), bayinza okugezaako omulimu guno ku misingi emirala, nga bakozesa amakubo n’ebibayamba ebiweebwa ku lw’ensonga endala, nga bwe bakoze bulijjo, era bwe bakola: naye agamba nti, “Guno mulimu gwa Mwoyo; ye yekka y’alina okugukola, era tewali maanyi galala gayinza kuguleeta.” Okutta ekibi okuva mu maanyi g’omuntu ku bubwe, okutwalibwa mu maaso mu makubo g’okwegunjira, olw’ekigendererwa ky’obutuukirivu obw’okwekolera, gwe mwoyo era kye kikula ky’eddiini yonna ey’obulimba mu nsi. Era kino gwe musingi ogwokubiri ogw’okwogera kwange okuddako.

4. Omulimu gwennyini, “Mutte ebikolwa eby’omubiri,” gwe guddako okwetegerezebwa.

Ebintu bisatu bye tulina okunoonyereza wano:— (1.) Kiki ekitegeezebwa omubiri; (2.) Kiki ekitegeezebwa ebikolwa eby’omubiri; (3.) Kiki ekitegeezebwa okubitta.

(1.) Omubiri ku nkomerero y’olunyiriri kye kimu n’omubiri ku ntandikwa: “Bwe munaagobereranga omubiri, mugenda kufa. Naye bwe munnatta ebikolwa eby’omubiri,” — kwe kugamba, eby’omubiri ogwo ogwogeddwako mu ntandikwa. Gwe mutume gw’abadde ayogerako ebbanga lyonna ng’aguyita omubiri; ekyo kyeyoleka mu kugenda mu maaso n’okukontanya Omwoyo n’omubiri, emabega n’oluvannyuma. Kale omubiri wano gutegeeza obwonoonefu n’okuvunda kw’obutonde bwaffe, omubiri gw’ennyama bwe gubeera mu kitundu ekinene ekifo kyabwo n’ekikozesebwa kyabwo, ebitundu by’omubiri byennyini nga bifuulibwa abaddu b’obutali butuukirivu olw’obwo, (Abaruumi 6:19). Kye kibi ekibeera mu ffe, omubiri ogwonoonese oba okwegomba okubi, ekitegeezebwa. Ensonga nnyingi ziyinza okuweebwa olw’enjogera eno ey’okuyita ekintu erinnya ly’ekirala, sijja kuzinnyonnyolako kaakano. “Omubiri” wano kye kimu ne παλαιὸς ἄνθρωπος, ne σῶμα τῆς ἁμαρτίας, “omuntu waffe ow’edda,” ne “omubiri gw’ekibi,” (Abaruumi 6:6); oba guyinza, ng’ekitundu kiyimirirwako ekiramba, okutegeeza omuntu yenna nga bw’alowoozebwa ng’ayonoonese, era ekifo ky’okwegomba okubi n’enneewulira ezitali nnamu bulungi.

(2.) Ebikolwa eby’omubiri. Ekigambo kiri πράξεις, ekitegeeza ddala okusinga byonna ebikolwa eby’okungulu, “Ebikolwa by’omubiri,” nga bwe biyitibwa, τὰ ἔργα τῆς σαρκός, (Abaggalatiya 5:19); ebyogerwako eyo nti “bya lwatu,” era ne bibalibwa. Kaakano, newaakubadde ng’ebikolwa eby’okungulu byokka bye byogeddwa wano, naye ensibuko ez’omunda era ezibiriraanye ze zisinga okugenderebwa; “embazzi … eteekeddwa ku buli kikolo kya muti,” — ebikolwa by’omubiri birina okuttibwa mu nsibuko zaabyo, gye biva. Omutume abiyita ebikolwa, kubanga ekyo buli kwegomba okubi kye kugenderera; newaakubadde nga kufuna bufunyi olubuto ne luvaamu, kugenderera okuzaala ekibi ekituukiridde.

Bw’amala, mu ssuula ey’omusanvu ne ku ntandikwa y’essuula eno, okwogera ku kwegomba okubi n’ekibi ekibeera mu ffe ng’ensulo n’ensibuko y’ebikolwa byonna eby’ekibi, wano ayogera ku kuzikirizibwa kwakyo ng’akozesa erinnya ly’ebibala bye kizaala. Πράξεις τοῦ σώματος kye kimu ne φρόνημα τῆς σαρκός, (Abaruumi 8:6), “Okulowooleza mu by’omubiri,” mu ngeri y’emu ey’enjogera ng’eyasooka; oba ne παθήματα ne ἐπιθυμίαι, “okwegomba kwagwo, n’omululu gwagwo,” (Abaggalatiya 5:24), ebikolwa n’ebibala byagwo gye biva; era mu makulu gano omubiri gwe gukozesebwa, (Abaruumi 8:10): “Omubiri gwammwe mufu olw’ekibi.”

(3.) Okutta. Εἰ θανατοῦτε, — “Bwe munnatta;” enjogera ey’olugero, eggiddwa mu kutta ekintu kyonna ekiramu. Okutta omuntu, oba ekintu ekirala kyonna ekiramu, kwe kumuggyako ensibuko y’amaanyi ge gonna, obuvumu bwe, n’obuyinza bwe, aleme kusobola kukola oba kweyoleka, oba okukola ebikolwa bye ku bubwe; bwe kiri ne mu nsonga eno. Ekibi ekibeera mu ffe kigeraageranyizibwa ku muntu, omuntu omulamu, ayitibwa “omuntu waffe ow’edda,” n’obusobozi bwe, n’engeri ze, amagezi ge, obukujjukujju bwe, obukalabakalaba bwe, amaanyi ge; ono, omutume agamba nti, alina okuttibwa, — kwe kugamba, okuggibwako obuyinza bwe, obulamu bwe, obuvumu bwe, n’amaanyi ge, okuzaala ebibala bye, ku bw’Omwoyo. Ddala, olw’omuwendo gw’omulimu gwa Kristo, ne mu ngeri ey’ekyokulabirako, kyattibwa era ne kizikirizibwa ddala ku musaalaba gwa Kristo; era “omuntu waffe ow’edda” kye kiva kyogerwako nti “yakomererwa wamu naye ku musaalaba,” (Abaruumi 6:6), naffe nti “twafiira wamu ne Kristo,” (olunyiriri 8), era mu butuufu ne kitandika mu kuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri, (Abaruumi 6:3-5), ensibuko ekikontana nakyo, era ekikizikiriza, (Abaggalatiya 5:17), bw’esimbibwa mu mitima gyaffe; naye omulimu gwonna gulina okutwalibwa mu maaso mpolampola okutuuka ku kutuukirira ennaku zaffe zonna. Ku kino tujja kwogera nate mu maaso mu kwogera kwaffe. Ekigendererwa ky’omutume mu kulagira omulimu guno kiri nti, — okutta ekibi ekibeera mu ffe ekisigadde mu mibiri gyaffe egifa, kireme kubeera na bulamu n’amaanyi okuzaala emirimu oba ebikolwa by’omubiri, gwe mulimu ogw’olubeerera ogw’abakkiriza.

5. Ekisuubizo ekiweereddwa olw’omulimu guno bwe bulamu: “Muliba balamu.” Obulamu obusuubiziddwa bukontana n’okufa okwalabulwako mu kitundu ekisooka, “Bwe munaagobereranga omubiri, mugenda kufa;” omutume y’omu kye yogera bw’ati, “Oyo asiga eri omubiri gwe, alikungula ebiggwaawo,” (Abaggalatiya 6:8), oba okuzikirizibwa okuva eri Katonda. Kaakano, oboolyawo ekigambo kino tekitegeeza bulamu obutaggwaawo bwokka, wabula n’obulamu obw’omwoyo mu Kristo, bwe tulina wano; si mu kikula n’okubeerawo kwabwo, abakkiriza bye balina edda, wabula mu ssanyu, okubudaabudibwa, n’amaanyi gaabwo: ng’omutume bw’agamba mu nsonga endala, “Bwe muba abanywevu mu Mukama waffe, naffe tuba balamu,” (1 Abasessaloniika 3:8); — “Kaakano obulamu bwange bujja kungasa; nja kuba n’essanyu n’okubudaabudibwa mu bulamu bwange;” — “Muliba balamu, nga mutambuza obulamu obulungi, obw’amaanyi, obw’okubudaabudibwa, obw’omwoyo nga mukyali wano, era mulifuna obulamu obutaggwaawo oluvannyuma.”

Nga twetegereza bye twasoose okwogera ku kukwatagana okuli wakati w’okutta ekibi n’obulamu obutaggwaawo, ng’okw’ekkubo n’enkomerero, nja kwongerako kyokka, ng’ensonga ey’okubiri ekubiriza omulimu ogulagiddwa, nti, —

Amaanyi, obuyinza, n’okubudaabudibwa kw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo byesigamye ku kutta ebikolwa by’omubiri.

fields.title: Obwetaavu bw’okutta ekibi: omulimu gw’abakkiriza abasinga obulungi
fields.body_html:
Ekiteeso ekikulu ku bwetaavu bw’okutta ekibi kireetebwa okukakasibwa — Okutta ekibi mulimu gw’abakkiriza abasinga obulungi, (Abakkolosaayi 3:5; 1 Abakkolinso 9:27) — Ekibi ekibeera mu ffe kibeerawo bulijjo; tewali kutuukirira mu bulamu buno, (Abafiripi 3:12; 1 Abakkolinso 13:12; 2 Peetero 3:18; Abaggalatiya 5:17), n’ebirala — Okukola kw’ekibi ekisigala mu bakkiriza, (Abaruumi 7:23; Yakobo 4:5; Abaebbulaniya 12:1) — Okubala kwakyo n’ekyo kye kigendererera — Buli kwegomba okubi kugenderera entikko mu ngeri yaakwo — Omwoyo n’obutonde obuggya biweebwa okulwanyisa ekibi ekibeera mu ffe, (Abaggalatiya 5:17; 2 Peetero 1:4, 5; Abaruumi 7:23) — Ebiva mu kulagajjalira okutta ekibi eby’entiisa, (Okubikkulirwa 3:2; Abaebbulaniya 3:13) — Omusingi ogusooka ogw’okwogera kwonna gukakasibwa bwe gutyo — Okubulwa omulimu guno kukungubagirwa.

Bwe mmaze okuzimba omusingi guno, okukakasa mu bufunze ebiggiddwamu ebikulu bye twogeddeko kujja kuntwala ku kye nsinga okugenderera, —

I. Nti abakkiriza abasinga obulungi, abaasumululwa ddala okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi obusalira omusango, kibagwanidde naye okufuula omulimu gwabwe ennaku zaabwe zonna okutta obuyinza bw’ekibi ekibeera mu bo.

Bw’atyo omutume, (Abakkolosaayi 3:5), “Noolwekyo temufugibwa bikolwa byammwe eby’omubiri, byonna mubitte.” Ayogera n’ani? N’abo “mwazuukirira awamu ne Kristo,” (olunyiriri 1); abo “mwafa” wamu naye, (olunyiriri 3); abo Kristo be yali obulamu bwabwe, era abagambibwa nti “mulyoka mulabisibwa wamu naye mu kitiibwa,” (olunyiriri 4). Mutte; mukifuule omulimu gwammwe ogwa buli lunaku; mubeerenga ku gwo bulijjo nga mukyali balamu; temulekangayo lunaku na lumu omulimu guno; mubeerenga mutta ekibi oba kijja kubatta. Okubeera nti mwafa wamu ne Kristo mu butuufu bw’omulimu gwe, okubeera nti mwafuulibwa abalamu wamu naye, tekijja kubaggya ku mulimu guno. Era Omulokozi waffe atubuulira Kitaawe bw’akola buli ttabi eriri mu ye eribala ebibala, buli ttabi ery’amazima eddamu. “Alirongoosa lyeyongerenga okubala,” (Yokaana 15:2). Alisalira, era si lunaku lumu oba bbiri, wabula ng’ekyali ttabi mu nsi muno. Era omutume akubuulira kye yakolanga, (1 Abakkolinso 9:27), “Mbonereza omubiri gwange ne ngufuula omuddu wange.” “Nkikola,” bw’agamba, “buli lunaku; gwe mulimu gw’obulamu bwange: sigulekaayo; guno gwe mulimu gwange.” Era obanga guno gwe gwali omulimu gwa Pawulo, eyali agulumiziddwa okusukkiridde mu kisa, okubikkulirwa, mu by’asanyukamu, mu nkizo, ne mu kubudaabudibwa, okusinga ekigera ekya bulijjo eky’abakkiriza, tuyinza tutya okwesigamya okusonyiyibwa omulimu guno n’obuvunaanyizibwa buno nga tukyali mu nsi muno? Ensonga ezimu ez’ekyo ziyinza okuweebwa mu bufunze:—

1. Ekibi ekibeera mu ffe kibeerawo bulijjo nga tukyali mu nsi muno; n’olwekyo kirina okuttibwa bulijjo. Enkaayana ez’obwereere, ez’obusirusiru, era ez’obutamanya ez’abantu ku kukwata amateeka ga Katonda mu bujjuvu, ku kutuukirira mu bulamu buno, ku kufiira ddala ekibi mu bujjuvu, kaakano sizeeyingizaamu. Kirabika nnyo nti abantu abo ab’ebyo eby’omuzizo tebamanyangako kiki ekyetaagisa okukwata etteeka lyonna erimu erya Katonda, era bali wansi nnyo w’okutuukirira kw’emitendera, ne kiba nti tebatuukangako ku kutuukirira kw’ebitundu mu buwulize, oba obuwulize mu byonna mu mazima. N’olwekyo, bangi mu nnaku zaffe aboogedde ku kutuukirira babadde n’amagezi okusingawo, ne bagamba nti kuli mu butamanya njawulo wakati w’ekirungi n’ekibi. Si nti batuukiridde mu bintu bye tuyita ebirungi, wabula nti byonna bye bimu gye bali, era entikko y’obubi kwe kutuukirira kwabwe. Abalala abaazuula ekkubo eriggya eridda eyo, nga beegaana ekibi eky’obuzaaliranwa ekibeera mu ffe, era nga bakkakkanya obw’omwoyo bw’etteeka lya Katonda okutuukana n’emitima gy’abantu egy’omubiri, nga bwe beeyolese ekimala nti tebamanyi bulamu bwa Kristo n’amaanyi gaabwo mu bakkiriza, bwe batyo bagunjizzaawo obutuukirivu obuggya enjiri bw’etemanyi, nga beegulumiza bwereere olw’ebirowoozo byabwe eby’omubiri. Ffe abatayaŋŋanga kuba ba magezi okusinga ebyo ebyawandiikibwa, newaakubadde okwenyumiriza mu bulamu bw’abantu abalala olw’ebyo Katonda by’atatukoledde, tugamba nti ekibi ekibeera mu ffe kiba kiramu mu ffe, mu kigera n’omutendera ogumu, nga tukyali mu nsi muno. Tetwaŋŋanga kwogera ng’abagamba nti “mmaze okufuna oba nti mmaze okutuukirira,” (Abafiripi 3:12). “Omuntu waffe ow’omunda adda buggya bulijjo” nga tukyali balamu wano, (2 Abakkolinso 4:16); era ng’okuzzibwa obuggya kw’omuntu omuggya bwe kuli, n’okwonooneka n’okuvunda kw’ow’edda bwe kuli. Nga tukyali wano, “mmanyiiko kitundu butundu,” (1 Abakkolinso 13:12), nga tulina ekizikiza ekisigaddewo ekirina okuggibwawo mpolampola nga tuyita mu kukula “mu kutegeera Mukama waffe era Omulokozi waffe Yesu Kristo,” (2 Peetero 3:18); era “okwegomba kw’omubiri kulwanagana n’Omwoyo … mulemenga okukola bye mwagala,” (Abaggalatiya 5:17): era n’olwekyo tulina ebbula mu buwulize bwaffe ne mu kutegeera kwaffe, (1 Yokaana 1:8). Tuli mu “mubiri guno ogugenda okufa,” (Abaruumi 7:24); mwe tutalokolebwa okuggyako olw’okufa kw’emibiri gyaffe, (Abafiripi 3:21). Kaakano, olw’okuba omulimu gwaffe kwe kutta, okubeera nga tutta ekibi nga kikyali mu ffe, tulina okubeera mu mulimu. Oyo alagiddwa okutta omulabe, bw’alekera awo okukuba ng’omulabe tannalekera awo kubeera mulamu, akola kitundu bukola ku mulimu gwe, (Abaggalatiya 6:9; Abaebbulaniya 12:1; 2 Abakkolinso 7:1).

2. Ekibi tekikoma ku kusigala mu ffe, wabula era kikyali kikola, nga kikyafuba okuzaala ebikolwa by’omubiri. Ekibi bwe kitulekera awo, naffe tuyinza okukirekera awo; naye ng’ekibi bwe kitabeera kisirifu nnyo okusinga bwe kirabika ng’ekisinga okusirika, era amazzi gaakyo emirundi egisinga gaba mawanvu nga gateredde, bwe zityo n’enteekateeka zaffe okukirwanyisa zirina okuba ez’amaanyi mu biseera byonna ne mu mbeera zonna, ne we wasinga okuba nga tewali kwekengera. Ekibi tekikoma ku kubeera mu ffe, wabula mu bitundu byaffe mulimu “amateeka ag’enjawulo nga gawakana n’etteeka lya Katonda amagezi gange ge limanyi,” (Abaruumi 7:23); era omwoyo ogubeera mu ffe gwegomba n’obuggya, (Yakobo 4:5). Kiri mu mulimu ogutakoma bulijjo; “okwegomba kw’omubiri kulwanagana n’Omwoyo,” (Abaggalatiya 5:17); okwegomba okubi kukyakema era kukyafunyisa olubuto lw’ekibi, (Yakobo 1:14); mu buli kikolwa eky’empisa kiba bulijjo nga kitusika eri obubi, oba nga kitulemesa ekirungi, oba nga kitabulatabula omwoyo okuguggya mu kussa ekimu ne Katonda. Kitusika eri obubi. “Ekibi kye saagala kye nkola,” bw’agamba omutume, (Abaruumi 7:19). Ekyo kiva wa? Kubanga, “Mu nze,” (kwe kugamba, mu mubiri gwange) “temuli kalungi n’akamu.” Era kitulemesa ekirungi: “Ekirungi kye njagala okukola si kye nkola,” (olunyiriri 19); — “Olw’ensonga y’emu, oba sikikola, oba sikikola nga bwe kingwanira; ebintu byange byonna ebitukuvu nga byonoonebwa ekibi kino.” “Okwegomba kw’omubiri kulwanagana n’Omwoyo … mulemenga okukola bye mwagala,” (Abaggalatiya 5:17). Era kitabulatabula omwoyo gwaffe, era kye kiva kiyitibwa “Ekibi ekitwesibako amangu,” (Abaebbulaniya 12:1); era olw’ensonga eyo omutume kwe yeemulugunyiza ennyo bw’atyo, (Abaruumi 7). Bwe kityo ekibi kiba bulijjo nga kikola, bulijjo nga kifunyisa olubuto, bulijjo nga kisendasenda era nga kikema. Ani ayinza okugamba nti yali akoze ekintu kyonna ne Katonda oba ku lwa Katonda, ekibi ekibeera mu ffe ne kitabaako kye kikola okwonoona kye yakola? Era omulimu guno kijja kugukola, okusinga oba okukendeera, ennaku zaffe zonna. Kale, obanga ekibi kinaabeeranga kikola bulijjo, ffe bwe tutaabeerenga batta kibi bulijjo, tuli bitonde ebibuze. Oyo ayimirira obuyimirizi n’aleka abalabe be okumukuba emirundi n’emirundi nga tabalwanyisa, ddala ajja kuwangulwa ku nkomerero. Obanga ekibi kya bukujjukujju, kitunula, kya maanyi, era bulijjo kiri ku mulimu gw’okutta emmeeme zaffe, ate ffe ne tuba bagayaavu, abalagajjavu, abasirusiru mu kugenda okukizikiriza, tuyinza okusuubira ekiriva mu kyo eky’essanyu? Tewali lunaku ekibi lwe kitawangula oba ne kiwangulwa, lwe kitasinza oba ne kisinzibwa; era bwe kiriba bwe kityo nga tukyali balamu mu nsi muno.

Nja kusonyiwa omulimu guno oyo asobola okuleeta ekibi mu kukkaanya, okuyimiriza okulwana mu lutalo luno; obanga kinaamusonyiwa olunaku lumu lwokka, mu mulimu gumu gwokka (kasita aba omuntu amanyi obw’omwoyo bw’obuwulize n’obukujjukujju bw’ekibi), ka agambe emmeeme ye, ku mulimu guno, nti “Emmeeme, … Wummula.” Abatukuvu, emmeeme zaabwe ezeegomba okulokolebwa okuva mu bujeemu bwakyo obutabulatabula, bamanyi nti tewali bukuumi okukirwanyisa okuggyako mu lutalo olutakoma.

3. Ekibi tekijja kukoma ku kufuba, kukola, kujeema, kutawaanya, kutabulatabula, wabula bwe kirekebwa, bwe kitattibwa bulijjo, kijja kuzaala ebibi ebinene, ebikolimiddwa, ebiswaza, ebizikiriza emmeeme. Omutume atubuulira emirimu gyakyo n’ebibala byakyo bwe biri, (Abaggalatiya 5:19-21), “Ebikolwa by’omubiri bya lwatu, bye bino: obwenzi, obukaba, obugwenyufu, okusinza bakatonda abalala, obufumu, obulabe, okuyomba, obuggya, obusungu, okwekuluntaza, okweyawula, okwesalamu, ettima, obutamiivu, ebinyumu, n’ebirala ebiri ng’ebyo.” Mumanyi kye kyakola mu Dawudi n’abalala abawerako. Ekibi bulijjo kigenderera entikko; buli lwe kisituka okukema oba okusendasenda, singa kirekebwa okugenda nga bwe kyagala, kyandituuse ku kibi ekisingirayo ddala mu ngeri eyo. Buli kirowoozo ekitali kirongoofu oba okutunula kwandibadde bwenzi singa kyali kisobola; buli kwegomba okw’omululu kwandibadde kunyigiriza, buli kirowoozo eky’obutakkiriza kyandibadde kugaana nti Katonda taliiyo, singa kyandikuze okutuuka ku ntikko yaakyo. Abantu bayinza okutuuka awali nti ekibi tekiwulirwa nga kyogera kigambo kiswaza mu mitima gyabwe, — kwe kugamba, nga kikubiriza ekibi ekinene nga kirina ekiswaza mu kamwa kaakyo; naye buli kusituka kw’okwegomba okubi, singa kwandirekeddwa okugenda nga bwe kwagala, kwanditutte ku ntikko y’obukozi bw’ebibi: kiri ng’entaana, etakkuta. Era wano we wali omugabo ogutali mutono ogw’obulimba bw’ekibi, mwe kiwangulira okukakanyaza abantu, ne kubatwala mu kuzikirira kwabwe, (Abaebbulaniya 3:13), — kiba ng’ekyewombeefu, mu ntandikwa zaakyo ne mu bye kisooka okuteesa, naye bwe kimala okufuna we kiteeka ekigere mu mutima olw’ebyo, kinyweza bulijjo ettaka lye kifunye, era kinyigiriza okweyongerayo mu mitendera emirala mu ngeri y’emu. Okukola kuno okuggya n’okusindika mu maaso kuleetera emmeeme obutafaayo nnyo ku kugwa okuva ku Katonda kwe kumaze okutandika; erowooza nti byonna biri bulungi ekigero kasita tewali kweyongerayo; era emmeeme nga bw’efuulibwa obutawulira kibi kyonna, — kwe kugamba, mu ngeri enjiri gy’eyagala, — bw’etyo bw’ekakanyazibwa: naye ekibi kikyanyigiriza mu maaso, kubanga tekirina nsalo okuggyako okuleka Katonda ddala n’okumulwanyisa; okuba nti kigenda kikula mpolampola okutuuka ku ntikko yaakyo, nga kinyweza ettaka lye kifunye olw’obukakanyavu, tekiva mu butonde bwakyo, wabula mu bulimba bwakyo. Kaakano tewali kiyinza kuziyiza kino okuggyako okutta ekibi; kwe kukaza ekikolo era kwe kukuba omutwe gw’ekibi buli ssaawa, ne kiba nti buli kye kigenderera kiremesebwa. Tewali mutukuvu asinga obulungi mu nsi, singa yandirese omulimu guno, ataandigudde mu bibi ebikolimiddwa bingi ng’omuntu yenna ow’engeri ye bwe yali agudde.

4. Eno y’emu ku nsonga enkulu lwaki Omwoyo n’obutonde obuggya byatuweebwa, — tulyoke tubeere n’ensibuko munda mu ffe ey’okulwanyisa ekibi n’okwegomba okubi. “Okwegomba kw’omubiri kulwanagana n’Omwoyo.” Kale! Kati olwo? Kubanga, “N’Omwoyo n’alwanagana n’omubiri,” (Abaggalatiya 5:17). Waliwo okwagala mu Mwoyo, oba mu butonde obuggya obw’omwoyo, okulwanyisa omubiri, nga bwe kuli ne mu mubiri okulwanyisa Omwoyo: bwe kiri ne mu (2 Peetero 1:4, 5). Okugabana kwaffe ku butonde bw’obwakatonda kwe kutuwonya obugwagwa obuli mu nsi olw’okwegomba okubi; era, (Abaruumi 7:23), waliwo etteeka ly’amagezi, nga bwe waliwo n’etteeka ly’ebitundu. Kaakano kino, okusooka, kye kintu ekisinga obutali bwenkanya n’obutaba na magezi mu nsi, abalwanyi babiri bwe baba balwana, okusiba omu n’okumuziyiza okukola ky’asobola kyonna, n’oleka omulala eddembe okumufumita nga bw’ayagala; era, okwokubiri, kye kintu ekisinga obusirusiru mu nsi okusiba oyo atulwanirira ku lw’embeera yaffe ey’olubeerera, [obulokozi?] n’oleka oyo anoonya era agezaako n’amaanyi okutuzikiriza emirembe gyonna. Olutalo luli ku lw’obulamu bwaffe n’emmeeme zaffe. Obutakozesa buli lunaku Omwoyo n’obutonde obuggya okutta ekibi, kwe kulagajjalira obuyambi obwo obulungi ennyo Katonda bw’atuwadde okulwanyisa omulabe waffe asinga obukambwe. Bwe tulagajjalira okukozesa bye tufunye, Katonda ayinza mu bwenkanya okuziyiza omukono gwe okutuwa ebisingawo. Ebisa bye, n’ebirabo bye, tubiweebwa okubikozesa, okubikolamu, n’okubisuubulamu. Obutatta kibi buli lunaku, kwe kwonoona eri obulungi, obusaasizi, amagezi, ekisa, n’okwagala kwa Katonda, eyatuwa ensibuko ey’okukikola.

5. Obulagajjavu mu mulimu guno busuula emmeeme mu mbeera ekontana ddala n’eyo omutume gy’agamba nti yali erimu, (2 Abakkolinso 4:16), “Newaakubadde ng’emibiri gyaffe gifa, naye omuntu waffe ow’omunda adda buggya bulijjo.” Mu bano omuntu ow’omunda y’azikirira, n’ow’okungulu n’azzibwa obuggya buli lunaku. Ekibi kiba ng’ennyumba ya Dawudi, n’ekisa ng’ennyumba ya Sawulo. Okukozesebwa n’okuwangula bye bintu ebibiri ebikulu ebiriisa ekisa mu mutima; bwe kirekebwa nga kigalamidde, kiwotoka era kiggwaawo: ebintu byakyo bitera okufa, (Okubikkulirwa 3:2); era ekibi kifuna ettaka okutuuka ku kukakanyaza omutima, (Abaebbulaniya 3:13). Kino kye ngenderera: olw’okulekayo omulimu guno ekisa kiwotoka, okwegomba okubi kukulaakulana, n’embeera y’omutima yeeyongera okwonooneka; era Mukama amanyi ebivuddemu eby’entiisa n’eby’akabi bye bireese mu bangi. Ekibi bwe kifuna obuwanguzi obunene olw’okulagajjalira okutta ekibi, kimenya amagumba g’emmeeme, (Zabbuli 31:10; 51:8), ne kifuula omuntu omunafu, omulwadde, ali kumpi kufa, (Zabbuli 38:3-5), n’atasobola kuyimusa maaso, (Zabbuli 40:12; Isaaya 33:24); era ebitonde ebinaku bwe bikkiriza okukubibwa ekikonde ku kikonde, ekiwundu ku kiwundu, okuwangulwa ku kuwangulwa, ne bitezuukusa okulwana n’amaanyi, biyinza okusuubira ekirala kyonna okuggyako okukakanyazibwa olw’obulimba bw’ekibi, n’emmeeme zaabwe okufuluma omusaayi okutuusa okufa? (2 Yokaana 8). Ddala, kintu kya nnaku okulowooza ku bivaamu eby’entiisa eby’obulagajjavu buno, ebiri mu maaso gaffe buli lunaku. Tetulaba abo be twamanya nga Bakristaayo abeetoowaze, ab’omutima ogusaanuuka era ogumenyese, abeegendereza era abatya okunyiiza, abanyiikivu ku lwa Katonda n’amakubo ge gonna, Ssabbiiti ze n’ebiragiro bye, nga bafuuse, olw’okulagajjalira okutunula ku mulimu guno, ab’ensi, ab’omubiri, abannyogovu, abasunguwavu, abakkiriziganya n’abantu b’ensi n’ebintu by’ensi, ne kiswaza eddiini era ne kikema nnyo abo ababamanyi? Amazima gali nti, olw’okuteeka okutta ekibi mu mbeera y’omwoyo enkakanyavu, eya kalumanywera, emirundi egisinga ey’ensi, ey’amateeka, ey’okusalira abalala omusango, ey’okusalira ku ludda, egendera wamu n’obusungu, obuggya, ettima, amalala, ku ludda olumu, n’okwefuula eddembe, ekisa, n’ebirala bye simanyi, ku ludda olulala, okutta ekibi okw’amazima okw’enjiri kumpi kubuze mu ffe: ku kino tujja kwogera oluvannyuma.

6. Mulimu gwaffe okubeera “nga tutuukiriza obutukuvu mu kutya Katonda,” (2 Abakkolinso 7:1); okubeera mu “okukula mu kisa” buli lunaku, (1 Peetero 2:2; 2 Peetero 3:18); okubeera nga “omuntu waffe ow’omunda adda buggya bulijjo,” (2 Abakkolinso 4:16). Kaakano, kino tekiyinza kukolebwa awatali kutta kibi buli lunaku. Ekibi kiteeka amaanyi gaakyo okulwanyisa buli kikolwa eky’obutukuvu, era n’okulwanyisa buli mutendera gwe tukulamu. Omuntu oyo talowoozanga nti alina ky’agenda mu maaso mu butukuvu, atalinnyirira okwegomba kwe okubi nga kugalamidde wansi. Oyo atatta kibi mu ngeri eno tatambula ddaala lyonna eri enkomerero y’olugendo lwe. Oyo atasanga kukontana okuva gye kiri, era ateefuba mu buli nsonga okukitta, ali mu mirembe nakyo, tafa gye kiri.

Kale guno gwe musingi ogusooka ogw’awamu ogw’okwogera kwaffe okuddako: Newaakubadde waliwo okutta okw’omuwendo, bwe nnyinza okwogera bwe ntyo, okw’ekibi kyonna na buli kibi ku musaalaba gwa Kristo; newaakubadde waliwo omusingi ogw’amazima ogw’okutta ekibi mu byonna ogwazimbibwa mu kukyuka kwaffe okusooka, olw’okulumirizibwa olw’ekibi, okwetoowaza olw’ekibi, n’okusimbibwa kw’ensibuko empya ekikontana era ekikizikiriza; — naye ekibi kisigala bwe kityo, kikola bwe kityo era kitawaana bwe kityo mu bakkiriza abasinga obulungi, nga bakyali balamu mu nsi muno, ne kiba nti okukitta buli lunaku obutakoma kuli ku bo ennaku zaabwe zonna. Nga sinnagenda ku kulowooza ku musingi oguddako, sisobola butakungubaga mu kkubo ku beeyatula eddiini bangi ab’ennaku zino, abaali basuubirwa okuzaala ebibala ebinene era ebyeyoleka eby’okutta ekibi, naye nga tebalina na bikoola byakwo. Ddala, omusana omungi gwagwiridde abantu b’omulembe guno, era wamu nagwo ebirabo eby’omwoyo bingi ne biweebwa, ebyo, wamu n’ensonga endala, bigaziyizza nnyo ensalo z’abeeyatula eddiini n’okwatula eddiini; bo n’okwatula kwabwe byeyongedde nnyo era ne bikulaakulana. N’olwekyo waliwo oluyoogaano lw’eddiini n’emirimu gy’eddiini mu buli nsonda, okubuulira okungi ennyo, — era si mu ngeri ey’amakamaka, ennyangu, etaliimu, era ey’obwereere, nga bwe kyali edda, wabula nga kituukana bulungi n’ekirabo eky’omwoyo, — ne kiba nti bw’onoopima omuwendo gw’abakkiriza olw’omusana, ebirabo, n’okwatula, ekkanisa eyinza okuba n’ensonga okugamba nti, “Ani eyanzaalira abaana bano bonna?” Naye kaakano bw’onoobapima olw’ekisa kino ekinene ekyawula Abakristaayo, oboolyawo onoosanga omuwendo gwabwe tegweyongedde nnyo bwe gutyo. Ali ludda wa oyo eyeeyatula eddiini, akyuse olw’ennaku zino ez’omusana, era ayogera era eyeeyatula mu ngeri ey’obw’omwoyo abatono mu nnaku ez’edda gye baali bamanyi, mu kigera kyonna (sijja kubasalira musango, naye oboolyawo nga beenyumiriza mu ebyo Mukama by’akoze mu bo), atalaga bubonero bwa mutima ogutattibwamu kibi mu ngeri ey’ennaku? Obanga okwonoona obudde mu bwereere, obugayaavu, obutagasa mu bifo by’abantu, obuggya, okuyomba, obutakkaanya, okuvuganya, obusungu, amalala, okwagala ensi, okwefaako ffekka, (1 Abakkolinso 1), bye bubonero bw’Abakristaayo, tubirina ku ffe era wakati mu ffe mu bungi. Era obanga bwe kiri bwe kityo eri abo abalina omusana mungi, era nga, bwe tusuubira, gwa kulokola, tunaagamba ki ku bamu abaagala okutwalibwa ng’abeddiini naye nga banyooma omusana gw’enjiri, era ku mulimu gwe tulimu, tebamanyiiko kirala okuggyako ekyo ekiri mu bantu okwegaana ebimu ku by’okungulu bye basanyukamu oluusi, nga lino lye limu ku matabi ag’okungulu ennyo agaakwo, naye era kye batera obutakola? Mukama omulungi atume omwoyo ogw’okutta ekibi awonye endwadde zaffe, bwe kitaba ekyo tuli mu mbeera ya nnaku!

Waliwo ebibi bibiri ebigoberera ddala buli eyeeyatula eddiini atattanga kibi; — ekisooka, mu ye yennyini; ekirala, ku balala:—

1. Mu ye yennyini. K’yeefuule nga bw’ayagala, alina ebirowoozo ebitono ku kibi; waakiri, ku bibi eby’obunafu obwa buli lunaku. Ekikolo ky’obulamu obutattibwamu kibi kwe kumira ekibi awatali bukaawu mu mutima. Omuntu bw’amala okunyweza ebirowoozo bye ku ngeri ey’okutegeera ekisa n’okusaasira, n’asobola, awatali bukaawu, okumira n’okugaaya ebibi bya buli lunaku, omuntu oyo ali ku lubalama ddala olw’okufuula ekisa kya Katonda obukaba, n’okukakanyazibwa olw’obulimba bw’ekibi. Era tewali bujulizi businga bwa mutima mulimba era omuvundu mu nsi okusinga okukola omulimu ogwo. Okukozesa omusaayi gwa Kristo, oguweebwa okutunaazaako ekibi, (1 Yokaana 1:7; Tito 2:14); okugulumizibwa kwa Kristo, okutuwa okwenenya, (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:31); okuyigiriza kw’ekisa, okutuyigiriza okuleka obutatya Katonda bwonna, (Tito 2:11, 12), okuwagira ekibi, bujeemu obunaamenya amagumba ku nkomerero. Mu mulyango guno abasinga obungi ku beeyatula eddiini abaavaako mu nnaku zino ze tulimu mwe baayita okutuvaako. Okumala akaseera, abasinga obungi baali wansi w’okulumirizibwa; okwo kwabakuumiranga ku mirimu gy’eddiini, ne kubaleeta mu kwatula eddiini; bwe batyo ne “bategeera Mukama waffe era Omulokozi waffe Yesu Kristo, ne badduka okuva mu bintu ebyo eby’ensi ebyonoona,” (2 Peetero 2:20): naye bwe baamala okumanya enjigiriza y’enjiri, ne bakoowa emirimu gy’eddiini, gye bataalina nsibuko yaago munda, ne batandika okwekkiriza obulagajjavu obw’engeri nnyingi nga beekwasa enjigiriza y’ekisa. Kaakano, ekibi kino bwe kyamala okubakwata, ne bagwa mangu mu kuzikirira.

2. Ku balala. Kibaleetera akabi mu ngeri bbiri:—

(1.) Kibakakanyaza, nga kibazaalamu endowooza nti bali mu mbeera ennungi ng’abeeyatula eddiini abasinga obulungi. Buli kye babalabamu kiba kyonoonese nnyo olw’obutabaamu kutta kibi kuno, ne kiba nti tekirina mugaso gye bali. Balina obunyiikivu ku lw’eddiini; naye bugenda wamu n’obutagumiikiriza n’obutaba na butuukirivu mu byonna. Beegaana obwononyi bw’ebintu, naye nga baagala ensi; beeyawula ku nsi, naye nga babeerawo ku lwabwe bokka ddala, nga tebafaayo kulaga kisa mu nsi; oba boogera eby’omwoyo, naye nga batambuza obulamu obutaliimu; boogera ku kussa ekimu ne Katonda, naye nga bafaanana ensi mu ngeri zonna; beenyumiriza mu kusonyiyibwa ebibi, naye nga tebasonyiwa balala. Era ebitonde ebinaku bikakanyaza emitima gyabyo mu butazaalibwa buggya nga byesigama ku birowoozo ng’ebyo.

(2.) Babalimbalimba, nga babakkirizisa nti bwe banaatuuka ku mbeera yaabwe, kinaaba bulungi gye bali; era bwe kityo kifuuka kyangu okubeera n’ekikemo ekinene eky’okumanyibwa mu by’eddiini eky’okumeggana nakyo, ate nga bayinza okubasukkuluma ennyo mu ebyo ebirabika mu bo, naye ne batatuuka ku bulamu obutaggwaawo. Naye ku bintu bino n’ebibi byonna eby’okutambula nga totta kibi, tujja kwogera oluvannyuma.

fields.title: Omwoyo yekka y’akola omulimu guno
fields.body_html:
Omusingi ogwokubiri ogw’awamu ku ngeri z’okutta ekibi guleetebwa okukakasibwa — Omwoyo yekka y’akola omulimu guno — Obutaliimu bw’okutta ekibi okw’Ekipaapa bulagibwa — Engeri nnyingi ze bakozesa Katonda ze yatateekawo — Ezo ze yateekawo bazikozesa bubi — Ensobi z’abalala mu nsonga eno — Omwoyo yasuubizibwa abakkiriza olw’omulimu guno (Ezeekyeri 11:19; 36:26) — Byonna bye tufuna okuva eri Kristo tubifuna ku bw’Omwoyo — Engeri Omwoyo gy’atta ekibi — (Abaggalatiya 5:19-23) — Engeri ez’enjawulo z’akolamu olw’ekigendererwa kino ziteekebwawo — Engeri gye guli omulimu gwe ate era omulimu gwaffe.

Omusingi oguddako gukwata ku kivaako ekikulu ennyo eky’okutta ekibi kwe twogerako; ekyo, mu bigambo ebyateekebwa ng’omusingi gw’okwogera kuno, kyogerwako nti ye Omwoyo, — kwe kugamba, Omwoyo Omutukuvu, nga bwe kyalagibwa.

II. Ye yekka y’asobola omulimu guno; engeri zonna n’amakubo gonna awatali ye tebiriimu nsa; era ye y’agukola ddala, — akolera mu ffe nga bw’ayagala.

1. Abantu banoonya bwereere eddagala eddala; tebaliwonyezebwa nalyo. Engeri nnyingi ezaalagirwa olw’ekigendererwa kino, ekibi kittibwe, zimanyiddwa. Ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky’eddiini y’Ekipaapa, eky’ekyo ekisinga okufaanana eddiini mu kwatula kwabwe, kirimu amakubo n’engeri ez’ensobi ez’okutta ekibi. Kino kye kyekwaso ky’ebyambalo byabwe ebikalubo, bye balimbisa. Obweyamo bwabwe, ebibiina byabwe eby’eddiini, okusiiba kwabwe n’okwebonereza kwabwe, byonna bizimbiddwa ku musingi guno; byonna bigendereddwa kutta kibi. Okubuulira kwabwe, emisomo gyabwe n’ebitabo byabwe eby’okusinza, byonna bitunuulira ku kino. Kyova olaba nga abo abategeeza nti enzige ezaava mu bunnya obutakoma (Okubikkulirwa 9:3) be basajja b’eddiini ab’ebibiina eby’ekkanisa y’e Rooma, abagambibwa okubonyaabonya abantu, ne kiba nti “balyagala okwetta naye tekirisoboka,” (olunyiriri 6), balowooza nti baakikola nga bayita mu kubuulira kwabwe okubalumya, kwe baabakakasizaamu ekibi, naye nga tebasobola kubalaga ddagala ery’okukiwonya n’okukitta, ne babaleka mu bulumi n’entiisa ebitakoma, ne mu kutabuka okw’omuntu ow’omunda okw’engeri eyo, ne beegomba okufa. Kino, nkiddamu, kye kikulu era kye kitiibwa ky’eddiini yaabwe; naye olw’okufuba kwabwe okutta ebitonde ebifu, nga tebamanyi mulimu guno kye guli wadde ekigendererwa kyagwo, — n’olw’obutwa bwe baagutabikamu, nga bakkiriza nti gubaweesa empeera, weewaawo, okukola okusukka ekyetaagisa (nga bwe bayita empeera yaabwe eteetaagisa, n’erinnya ery’amalala era ery’obutamanya), — ekitiibwa kyabwe ze nsonyi zaabwe: naye ku bo n’okutta ekibi kwabwe nja kwogera nate oluvannyuma (essuula 7).

Kimanyiddwa nti amakubo n’engeri ze baagunjaawo ez’okutta ekibi bikyakkaatirizibwa era bikyalagirwa, olw’ekigendererwa kye kimu, abamu abandibadde n’ekitangaala n’okumanya okusingawo ku njiri. Ebiragiro eby’engeri eyo biweereddwa abamu mu biseera bino, era abalala abeeyita Abapulotestanti babikwakkula n’omululu, nga bwe kyandisaanidde abasinza ab’Ekipaapa emyaka ebikumi bisatu oba bina emabega. Okufuba okw’ebweru ng’okwo, okwekangavvula okw’omubiri ng’okwo, ebikolwa by’omuntu ku lulwe ng’ebyo, emirimu egy’amateeka gyokka ng’egyo, nga tewali na kwogera kutono ku Kristo oba ku Mwoyo we, bisiigibwako ebigambo eby’amalala ebitaliimu nsa, ne bitwalibwa ng’engeri zokka n’amakubo gokka ag’okutta ekibi, ne biraga obutamanya obw’emirandira egy’ewala ku maanyi ga Katonda n’ekyama ky’enjiri. Okulowooza ku kino kye kimu ku byankubiriza okufulumya okwogera kuno okwangu.

Kaakano, ensonga lwaki Abagoberezi b’Ekipaapa tebasobola, newaakubadde nga bafuba batya, kutta ddala kibi na kimu, mu nsonga endala, ze zino, —

(1.) Kubanga engeri nnyingi n’amakubo bye bakozesa era bye bakkaatiriza olw’ekigendererwa kino, Katonda teyabiteekawo n’akatono olw’ensonga eyo. (Kaakano, tewali kintu mu ddiini ekirina amaanyi okutuukiriza ekigendererwa, wabula nga kyagafuna okuva mu Katonda kubanga yakiteekawo olw’ekigendererwa ekyo.) Ebyo bye bino: ebyambalo byabwe ebikalubo, obweyamo bwabwe, okwebonereza kwabwe, okwekangavvula kwabwe, obulamu bwabwe obw’ekimonaaki, n’ebirala ebiringa ebyo; ku byonna ebyo Katonda alyogera nti, “Ani eyabasaba ebintu bino?” era nti, “Okusinza kwabwe kwa bwereere. Kubanga bayigiriza amateeka abantu ge beekoledde.” Eby’engeri y’emu bye by’okwebonyaabonya eby’enjawulo abalala bye bakkaatiriza.

(2.) Kubanga ebintu Katonda bye yateekawo ng’engeri tebabikozesa mu kifo kyabyo ne mu nteekateeka yaabyo entuufu, — gamba ng’okusaba, okusiiba, okutunula, okufumiitiriza, n’ebirala ebiringa ebyo. Bino birina omugaso mu nsonga gye tulimu; naye ng’ate byonna bisaanidde okutwalibwa ng’emigga, bo babitwala ng’ensulo. Ng’ate bituukiriza ekigendererwa ng’ebikozesebwa byokka, ebiri wansi w’Omwoyo n’okukkiriza, bo balowooza nti bikituukiriza olw’omulimu gwennyini ogukoleddwa. Bwe basiiba ekigero ekyo, ne basaba ekigero ekyo, ne bakuuma essaawa zaabwe n’ebiseera byabwe, omulimu guba guwedde. Ng’omutume bw’ayogera ku balala mu nsonga endala nti, “abayiga bulijjo, kyokka ne batatuuka ku kutegeerera ddala amazima;” bwe batyo bo bulijjo batta ekibi, naye tebatuuka ku kutta kibi okwa nnamaddala. Mu bimpimpi, balina engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okutta omuntu ow’obutonde, ku bikwata ku bulamu obw’obutonde bwe tulimu wano; tebalina n’emu ey’okutta okwegomba okubi oba obuvundu.

Eno y’ensobi ey’awamu ey’abantu abatamanyi njiri ku nsonga eno; era y’eri wansi w’ebintu bingi eby’obulombolombo obutaliimu n’okusinza okw’okwesalirawo ebiyingiziddwa mu nsi. Okwebonyaabonya okw’entiisa kwenkana wa okwakolebwanga abamu ku batandisi ab’edda ab’okusinza okw’ekimonaaki! Obukambwe bwenkana wa bwe baakola ku butonde! Okubonaabona okw’amaanyi kwenkana wa kwe beetekako! Noonya amakubo gaabwe n’emisingi gyabwe okutuuka wansi ddala, ojja kusanga nti tegyalina mulandira mulala wabula ensobi eno, kwe kugamba, nti bwe baagezaako okutta ekibi okw’amaanyi, baagwa ku muntu ow’obutonde mu kifo ky’omuntu ow’edda omuvundu, — ku mubiri gwe tulimu mu kifo ky’omubiri gw’okufa.

Era n’Ekipaapa eky’obutonde ekiri mu balala tekisobola kukikola. Abantu balumwa olw’omusango gw’ekibi ekibawangudde; amangu ago beesuubiza bo bennyini ne Katonda nti tebalikiddamu; beekuuma, ne basaba okumala akaseera, okutuusa ebbugumu lino lwe linnyogoga, n’okuwulira ekibi ne kuggwaawo: n’okutta ekibi nakwo ne kugenda, n’ekibi ne kiddayo mu bufuzi bwakyo obwasooka. Emirimu gy’eddiini mmere nnungi nnyo eri emmeeme etali nnamu bulungi; si ddagala eri emmeeme endwadde. Oyo afuula emmere ye eddagala lye tasaanye kusuubira bikulu. Abantu abalwadde mu mwoyo tebasobola kuggyamu bulwadde bwabwe nga batuuyana mu kukola. Naye lino lye kkubo ly’abantu abalimba emmeeme zaabwe; nga bwe tulilaba oluvannyuma.

Nti tewali na limu ku makubo gano erimala kyeyolekera mu mulimu gwennyini ogugenda okukolebwa; mulimu ogwetaagisa ebikolwa bingi ebikolera awamu, okufuba kw’omuntu yekka kwe kutasobola kutuukako, era gwa ngeri eyetaagisa amaanyi ag’Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna okugutuukiriza; nga bwe kirirabika oluvannyuma.

2. Kale, guno gwe mulimu gw’Omwoyo. Kubanga, —

(1.) Yasuubizibwa Katonda okuweebwa gye tuli okukola omulimu guno. Okuggyibwamu omutima ogw’ejjinja, — kwe kugamba, omutima omukakanyavu, ogw’amalala, omujeemu, ogutakkiriza, — okutwalira awamu gwe mulimu gw’okutta ekibi gwe twogerako. Kaakano kino kisuubizibwa bulijjo okukolebwa Omwoyo (Ezeekyeri 11:19; 36:26), “ndibawa Omwoyo wange … ndibaggyamu omutima ogw’ejjinja;” era Omwoyo wa Katonda y’akola omulimu guno ng’engeri zonna ziremye (Isaaya 57:17, 18).

(2.) Okutta ekibi kwaffe kwonna tukufuna okuva mu kirabo kya Kristo, era ebirabo byonna ebya Kristo bituweebwa era bituleeterwa Omwoyo wa Kristo: “Awatali Kristo tetuliiko kye tuyinza kukola” (Yokaana 15:5). Byonna ebituweebwa n’obuyambi bwonna, mu kutandika, mu kukula, ne mu kukola kw’ekirabo kyonna eky’ekisa, okuva gy’ali, biyita mu Mwoyo, oyo yekka gw’akozesa okukola mu bakkiriza ne ku bo. Okuva gy’ali tufuna okutta ekibi kwaffe: “Katonda n’amugulumiza okubeera Omulangira era Omulokozi,” okutuwa okwenenya (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:31); era mu kwenenya kwaffe, okutta ekibi si kitundu kitono. Akikola atya? Bwe yamala “aweebwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu eyamusuubizibwa Kitaffe,” amutuma olw’ekigendererwa ekyo (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:33). Mumanyi ebisuubizo bye ebingi bye yawa eby’okutuma Omwoyo, nga Tertullian bw’ayogera, “Vicariam navare operam,” okukola emirimu gye yalina okutuukiriza mu ffe.

Okuddamu ekibuuzo kimu oba bibiri kaakano kujja kunsembereza ku kye ngenderera okusinga byonna.

Ekisooka kiri nti, Omwoyo atta atya ekibi?

Nziramu nti, okutwalira awamu, mu ngeri ssatu:—

[1.] Ng’aleetera emitima gyaffe okujjula ekisa n’ebibala ebikontana n’omubiri, n’ebibala byagwo n’emisingi gyabyo. Bw’atyo omutume ateeka ebibala by’omubiri n’eby’Omwoyo nga bikontana: “Ebikolwa by’omubiri,” bw’agamba, “biri bwe biti na bwe biti” (Abaggalatiya 5:19-21); “naye,” bw’agamba, “ebibala eby’Omwoyo bikontana nabyo ddala, bya ngeri ndala ddala” (ennyiriri 22, 23). Weewaawo; naye singa bino biri mu ffe era nga bijjudde, ebirala tebiyinza nabyo kujjula? Nedda, bw’agamba (olunyiriri 24), “abo aba Kristo Yesu baakomerera omubiri n’okwegomba kwagwo, n’omululu gwagwo.” Naye batya? Laba (olunyiriri 25), “Nga babeera balamu mu Mwoyo era nga batambula ng’Omwoyo bw’abaluŋŋamya;” — kwe kugamba, ebirabo bino eby’ekisa eby’Omwoyo bwe bijjula mu ffe, era bwe tutambula nga bwe biri. Kubanga, omutume bw’agamba, “bino byombi bikontana” (olunyiriri 17); ne kiba nti tebiyinza byombi kubeera mu muntu y’omu ku ddaala erya waggulu oba ery’amaanyi. Kuno “okufuulibwa abaggya olwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu,” nga bwe kuyitibwa (Tito 3:5), y’emu ku ngeri enkulu ez’okutta ekibi; atuleetera okukula, okugaggawala, okumulisa, n’okujjula mu birabo ebyo eby’ekisa ebikontana, ebiwakanya, era ebizikiriza ebibala byonna eby’omubiri, n’emirembe oba okukulaakulana kw’ekibi ekibeera mu ffe kyennyini.

[2.] Mu maanyi ag’ennamaddala agakola ku mulandira n’omuze gw’ekibi, okukinafuya, okukizikiriza n’okukiggyawo. Kyava ayitibwa “omwoyo ogusala ensonga n’omwoyo ogwokya” (Isaaya 4:4), ng’ayokya ddala era ng’azikiriza okwegomba kwaffe okubi. Aggyawo omutima ogw’ejjinja n’amaanyi ag’Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna; kubanga nga bw’atandika omulimu mu ngeri yaagwo, bw’atyo bw’agutwala mu maaso mu madaala gaagwo. Ye muliro ogwokya omulandira gwennyini ogw’okwegomba okubi.

[3.] Aleeta omusaalaba gwa Kristo mu mutima gw’omwonoonyi ku bw’okukkiriza, n’atuwa okussa ekimu ne Kristo mu kufa kwe, n’okugabana mu kubonaabona kwe: ku ngeri gye kikolebwamu nja kwogera nate oluvannyuma.

Eky’okubiri. Bwe kiba nti guno mulimu gwa Mwoyo yekka, lwaki tukubirizibwa okugukola? — okuva Omwoyo wa Katonda yekka bw’asobola okugukola, omulimu ogwo gumulekerwe yekka ddala.

[1.] Si mulimu gwa Mwoyo mu ngeri ndala okuggyako nga bwe biri ebirabo byonna eby’ekisa n’ebikolwa ebirungi ebiri mu ffe nga bibye. Ye “yakolera mu mmwe, era yabaagazisa n’abasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, olw’okumusanyusa” (Abafiripi 2:13); akola nti “ebyo byonna bye tukoze, ggw’obitukoledde” (Isaaya 26:12), — “buli mulimu ogw’okukkiriza mu maanyi” (2 Abasessaloniika 1:11; Abakkolosaayi 2:12); atuleetera okusaba, era ye “Omwoyo ow’ekisa n’okwegayirira” (Abaruumi 8:26; Zekkaliya 12:10); naye era tukubirizibwa, era tusaanidde okukubirizibwa, okukola ebyo byonna.

[2.] Takola kutta kibi kwaffe mu ffe mu ngeri eyandikuggya ku kuba ekikolwa eky’obuwulize bwaffe. Omwoyo Omutukuvu akola mu ffe ne ku ffe, nga bwe tusaanira okukolebwamu ne ku ffe; kwe kugamba, mu ngeri ekuuma eddembe lyaffe n’obuwulize bwaffe obw’okweyagalira. Akola ku magezi gaffe, ku kusalawo kwaffe, ku muntu waffe ow’omunda, ne ku nneewulira zaffe, nga bwe kituukagana n’obutonde bwabyo; akola mu ffe era naffe, si kutulwanyisa oba awatali ffe; ne kiba nti obuyambi bwe butuzzaamu amaanyi kubanga bwanguyiza omulimu, so si nsonga ya kugulagajjalira gwennyini. Era ddala, nandisobodde wano okukungubagira okufuba okutakoma, okw’obusirusiru, okw’emmeeme ennaku, ezo, bwe zikakasibwa ekibi, nga tezisobola kuyimirira mu maaso ga maanyi ga kukakasibwa kwazo, zeeteeka, mu makubo n’emirimu egitabalika egitabula omutwe, okukkakkanya ekibi, naye, nga tezimanyi Mwoyo wa Katonda, byonna bwereere. Balwana nga tebawangula, balina olutalo awatali mirembe, era bali mu buddu ennaku zaabwe zonna. Basaasaanya amaanyi gaabwe ku ebitali bya kulya, n’okutegana kwabwe ku ebyo ebitakkusa.

Eno y’entalo esinga obunaku ekitonde kyonna eky’ennaku kye kiyinza okuyingizibwamu. Emmeeme eri wansi w’amaanyi g’okukakasibwa ekibi okuva mu mateeka ekakkibwa okulwanyisa ekibi, naye nga terina maanyi ga kulwana. Tebayinza butalwana, era tebayinza kuwangula; bali ng’abantu abasindikiddwa ku kitala ky’abalabe bagende battibwe. Amateeka gabagoba mu maaso, ate ekibi ne kibazza emabega. Oluusi balowooza ddala nti bawangudde ekibi, so nga bakubye bukubi nfuufu ne batakiraba; kwe kugamba, batabulatabula enneewulira zaabwe ez’obutonde ez’okutya, ennaku n’obulumi, ekibaleetera okukkiriza nti ekibi kiwanguddwa so nga tekikwatiddwako n’akatono. Bwe bamala okunnyogoga, balina okuddayo mu lutalo nate; n’okwegomba okubi kwe baalowooza nti kuttiddwa kulabika nga tekwafuna kiwundu kyonna.

Era bwe kiba nti embeera eyo nnaku bwetyo eri abo abategana era abafuba, naye ne batayingira mu bwakabaka, embeera y’abo abanyooma bino byonna eri etya; abali bulijjo wansi w’amaanyi n’obufuzi bw’ekibi, era abaagala kibe bwe kityo; era abatatawaanyizibwa kintu kyonna, okuggyako nti tebasobola kuwa mubiri bbanga kukola ng’okwegomba kwagwo bwe kuli ku kigero ekimala?

fields.title: Omugaso gw’okutta ekibi eri amaanyi g’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo
fields.body_html:
Omusingi ogusembayo; ku mugaso gw’okutta ekibi — Amaanyi n’okubudaabudibwa kw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo byesigamye ku kutta ekibi kwaffe — Mu ngeri ki — Si mu ngeri ya ddala era etayinza kulema; (Zabbuli 88), embeera ya Kemani — Si ng’ekivaako ekiddirira era eky’amangu — Ng’engeri; nga kiggyawo ekikontana — Ebiva mu kwegomba okubi kwonna okutattiddwa eby’akabi; kunafuya emmeeme (Zabbuli 38:3, 8), mu ngeri nnyingi, era kugizikiza — Ebirabo byonna eby’ekisa bikulaakulana olw’okutta ekibi — Bwe bujulizi obusinga obw’obwesimbu.

Omusingi ogusembayo gwe nnaakkaatirizaako (nga ndese, ekisooka, obwetaavu bw’okutta ekibi olw’obulamu, n’ekyokubiri, obukakafu bw’obulamu olw’okutta ekibi) gwe guno, —

III. Nti obulamu, amaanyi, n’okubudaabudibwa kw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo byesigamye nnyo ku kutta ekibi kwaffe.

Amaanyi n’okubudaabudibwa, n’obuyinza n’emirembe, mu kutambula kwaffe ne Katonda, bye bintu bye twegomba. Singa omuntu yenna ku ffe abuuzibwa mu bwesimbu ekimutawaanya kye ki, twandikizza ku kimu ku bino:— oba tubulwa amaanyi oba obuyinza, obuvumu n’obulamu, mu buwulize bwaffe, mu kutambula kwaffe ne Katonda; oba tubulwa emirembe, okubudaabudibwa, n’okugumizibwa omwo. Kyonna ekiyinza okutuuka ku mukkiriza ekitali kya ku nsonga zino ebbiri, tekisaanidde kwogerwako mu nnaku ez’okwemulugunya kwaffe.

Kaakano, bino byonna byesigamye nnyo ku kutta ekibi obutayosa, era ku ekyo mwetegereze, —

1. Sigamba nti biva mu kyo, ng’ebisibiddwa ku kyo mu ngeri etayinza kulema. Omuntu ayinza okutambuzibwa mu kutta ekibi obutayosa ennaku ze zonna; naye oboolyawo n’atafuna lunaku na lumu olulungi olw’emirembe n’okubudaabudibwa. Bwe kyali bwe kityo eri Kemani (Zabbuli 88); obulamu bwe bwali bulamu bwa kutta kibi obutakoma n’okutambula ne Katonda, naye entiisa n’ebiwundu bye byali omugabo gwe ennaku ze zonna. Naye Katonda yalonda Kemani, mukwano gwe omulonde, okumufuula ekyokulabirako eri abo abaali bagenda okubeera mu nnaku oluvannyuma. Oyinza okwemulugunya bwe kiba nti tekiri bulala gy’oli okusinga bwe kyali eri Kemani, omuweereza wa Katonda oyo ow’ettutumu? era kino kye kiriba ettendo lye okutuusa enkomerero y’ensi. Katonda afuula enkizo ye okwogera emirembe n’okubudaabuda (Isaaya 57:18, 19). “Nze ndikola omulimu ogwo,” Katonda bw’agamba, “Ndimubudaabuda” (olunyiriri 18). Naye atya? Mu mulimu ogw’amangu ogw’okutonda okuggya: “Nkitonda,” Katonda bw’agamba. Okukozesa engeri ez’okufuna emirembe kwaffe; okugitugabira y’enkizo ya Katonda.

2. Mu makubo Katonda ge yateekawo okutuwa obulamu, amaanyi, obuvumu n’okubudaabudibwa, okutta ekibi si kye kimu ku bivaako ebyo eby’amangu. Enkizo ez’okufuulibwa abaana zaffe bwe zimanyisibwa emmeeme zaffe ze zituwa ebintu bino butereevu. “Omwoyo yennyini akakasiza wamu n’omwoyo waffe nga bwe tuli abaana ba Katonda,” ng’atuwa erinnya eriggya n’ejjinja eryeru, okufuulibwa abaana n’okuweebwa obutuukirivu, — kwe kugamba, mu kubiwulira n’okubimanya, — bye bivaako eby’amangu (mu mukono gw’Omwoyo) eby’ebintu bino. Naye kino kye ŋŋamba, —

3. Mu kutambula kwaffe okwa bulijjo ne Katonda, ne mu ngeri ye eya bulijjo ey’okutukwatamu, amaanyi n’okubudaabudibwa kw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo byesigamye nnyo ku kutta ekibi kwaffe, si nga “causa sine qua non” kyokka, naye ng’ekintu ekirina amaanyi ddala ku byo. Kubanga, —

(1.) Kino kyokka kye kiziyiza ekibi okutunyagako ekimu ku byo n’ekirala.

Buli kibi ekitattiddwa kijja kukola ebintu bibiri ddala:— [1.] Kijja kunafuya emmeeme, ne kigiggyako amaanyi gaayo. [2.] Kijja kuzikiza emmeeme, ne kigiggyako okubudaabudibwa kwayo n’emirembe gyayo.

[1.] Kinafuya emmeeme, ne kigiggyako amaanyi gaayo. Dawudi bwe yamala ekiseera ng’alabirira mu mutima gwe okwegomba okubi okutattiddwa, kwamenya amagumba ge gonna, ne kumuleka nga talina maanyi ga mwoyo; kyeyava yeemulugunya nti mulwadde, munafu, mufumite, ayongobedde. “Mu nze,” bw’agamba, “temuli kalamu” (Zabbuli 38:3); “Sikyalimu maanyi era nzenna mmenyesemenyese” (olunyiriri 8); weewaawo, “sikyasobola na kulaba” (Zabbuli 40:12). Okwegomba okubi okutattiddwa kujja kunywa omwoyo, n’amaanyi gonna ag’emmeeme, ne kuginafuya eri emirimu gyonna. Kubanga, —

1. Kitabula era kisasamaza omutima gwennyini, nga kisiba enneewulira zaagwo. Kiwugula omutima okuva ku mbeera ey’omwoyo eyeetaagisa okussa ekimu ne Katonda n’amaanyi; kikwata ku nneewulira, ne kifuula ekintu kye kyegomba ekyagalwa era ekyegombebwa, bwe kityo ne kigobamu okwagala kwa Kitaffe (1 Yokaana 2:15; 3:17); ne kiba nti emmeeme tesobola kugamba Katonda mu bwesimbu era mu mazima nti, “Ggwe mugabo gwange,” kubanga erina ekintu ekirala kye yagala. Okutya, okwegomba n’essuubi, nga ze nneewulira ez’emmeeme ezisinga obulungi, ezandibadde nga zijjudde Katonda, zijja kusibibwa nakyo mu ngeri emu oba endala.

2. Kijjuza ebirowoozo enteekateeka ez’okukiweereza. Ebirowoozo be bagabi abakulu ab’emmeeme abagireetera ebyetaago okukkusa enneewulira zaayo; era singa ekibi kisigala nga tekittiddwa mu mutima, birina buli kaseera okuwa omubiri ebbanga kukola ng’okwegomba kwagwo bwe kuli. Birina okunyiriza, okuyonja n’okuwunda ebintu by’omubiri, ne bibireeta eka okukkusa; era kino bisobola okukikola, mu buweereza bw’okulowooza okwonoonese, okusukka ebigambo byonna.

3. Kibutuka ne kiziyiza ddala emirimu gy’eddiini. Omuntu ow’ebigendererwa eby’amalala aba alina okuba ng’ateekateeka, n’omuntu w’ensi ng’akola oba ng’ateesa, n’omuntu ow’obwagazi bw’omubiri era ataliimu nsa ng’anoonya eby’obwereere, mu kiseera we bandibadde mu kusinza Katonda.

Singa guno gwe gwali omulimu gwange kaakano, okulaga ebituli, okuzikirira, obunafu n’amatongo okwegomba okubi okumu okutattiddwa bye kuleeta ku mmeeme, okwogera kuno kwandibadde kulina okuwanvuwa nnyo okusukka kye nnali ngenderera.

[2.] Ng’ekibi bwe kinafuya, bwe kityo bwe kizikiza emmeeme. Kire, kire ekikwafu, ekyebunya ku maaso g’emmeeme, ne kiziyiza ebitangaala byonna eby’okwagala kwa Katonda n’ekisa kye. Kiggyawo okuwulira kwonna okw’enkizo ey’okufuulibwa abaana; era emmeeme bw’etandika okukuŋŋaanya ebirowoozo eby’okubudaabudibwa, ekibi kibisaasaanya mangu: ku kino nja kwogera oluvannyuma.

Kaakano, mu nsonga eno amaanyi n’obuyinza bw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo byesigamye ku kutta ekibi kwaffe: Y’engeri yokka ey’okuggyawo ekyo ekitajja kutukkiriza kufuna kimu wadde ekirala. Abantu abalwadde era abafumite wansi w’amaanyi g’okwegomba okubi banoonya obuyambi mu ngeri nnyingi; bakaabirira Katonda ng’okutabulwa kw’ebirowoozo byabwe kubasukkiridde, weewaawo eri Katonda gye bakaabira, naye tebanunulibwa; bakozesa bwereere eddagala lingi, — “ tebaliwonyezebwa.” Bwe kityo (Koseya 5:13), “Efulayimu bwe yalaba obulwadde bwe, ne Yuda n’alaba ekivundu kye,” ne bagezaako eddagala ery’enjawulo: tewali kiyamba okutuusa (olunyiriri 15) “lwe balikkiriza omusango gwabwe.” Abantu bayinza okulaba obulwadde bwabwe n’ebiwundu byabwe, naye bwe batakozesa ddagala lituufu, tebajja kuwona.

(2.) Okutta ekibi kusalira ebirabo byonna eby’ekisa kya Katonda, ne kubiwa ebbanga mu mitima gyaffe okukula. Obulamu n’amaanyi g’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo biri mu maanyi n’okumulisa kw’ebimera eby’ekisa mu mitima gyaffe. Kaakano, nga bw’oyinza okulaba mu nnimiro, ka kimera eky’omuwendo kisimbibwe, ettaka ne litalimibwa, omuddo omubi ne gukula okukyetooloola, oboolyawo kijja kusigala nga kiramu, naye nga kimera kinafu, ekiwotoka, ekitaliiko mugaso. Olina okukinoonya n’okukinoonyereza, era oluusi n’otokisanga n’akamu; era bw’okisanga, tosobola na kukitegeera, oba kye kimera ky’onoonya oba si kyo; era singa kye kyo, tosobola kukikozesa n’akatono. Ate, ka kimera ekirala eky’engeri y’emu kisimbibwe mu ttaka, mu butonde ery’obugumba era eribi ng’eddala, naye ne kikoolebwa bulungi, buli kintu ekyonoona n’ekirumya ne kiggyibwako, — kimulisa era kikula; oyinza okukiraba amangu ddala ng’otunuulidde mu nnimiro, n’okikozesa buli lw’oyagala. Bwe kityo bwe kiri n’ebirabo by’ekisa eby’Omwoyo ebisimbiddwa mu mitima gyaffe. Ekyo kya mazima; bikyaliwo, bibeera mu mutima omuli obulagajjavu mu kutta ekibi; naye biri kumpi kufa (Okubikkulirwa 3:2), biwotoka era bikala. Omutima guba ng’ennimiro y’omugayaavu, — omuddo omubi gugibisse nnyo n’otosobola na kulaba ŋŋaano nnungi. Omuntu ng’oyo ayinza okunoonya okukkiriza, okwagala n’obunyiikivu, n’atasobola na kubisanga; era bw’azuula nti ebirabo bino eby’ekisa bikyaliwo nga biramu era nga bya mazima, naye bibeera binafu nnyo, nga bizitoowereddwa nnyo okwegomba okubi, ne bibeera n’omugaso mutono nnyo; bisigaddewo ddala, naye biri kumpi kufa. Naye kaakano omutima ka gutukuzibwe olw’okutta ekibi, omuddo omubi ogw’okwegomba okubi gukuulibwe obutayosa buli lunaku (kubanga gumera buli lunaku, obutonde nga lye ttaka lyagwo ery’ennono), ekisa kiweebwe ebbanga okukula n’okumulisa, — nga buli kirabo kya kisa kijja kukola omulimu gwakyo, ne kiba kyetegefu olwa buli mugaso na buli kigendererwa!

(3.) Ku bikwata ku mirembe gyaffe; nga bwe watali kintu kirina bujulizi bwa bwesimbu awatali kyo, bwe ntyo simanyi kintu kirina bujulizi bwa bwesimbu obwenkana obwo nga kyo; — ogwo si musingi mutono ogw’emirembe gyaffe. Okutta ekibi kwe kuwakanya okw’amaanyi emmeeme kw’ekola ku kwerowoozaako yokka, era omwo obwesimbu mwe businga okweyoleka.

fields.title: Okutta ekibi kye kiri, nga kitunuulirwa mu ngeri ey’okugaana
fields.body_html:
Ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’okwogera kuno kwonna kuteekebwawo — Ensonga y’omuntu ow’omunda esooka enkulu eteekebwawo — Okutta ekibi kyonna kye kiri, nga kitunuulirwa mu ngeri ey’okugaana — Si kukizikiririza ddala mu bulamu buno — Si kukikweka —Si kukulaakulanya musingi gwonna ogw’obutonde — Si kukiwugula — Si buwanguzi obw’akaseera — Obuwanguzi obw’akaseera ku kibi, kye buli n’ebiseera byabwo; ekibi bwe kibutuka; mu biseera eby’akabi oba eby’obuzibu.

Ebintu bino bwe bimala okutegeezebwa, kaakano ntuuka ku kye ngenderera ekikulu, okwogera ku bibuuzo ebimu oba ensonga ez’omu bulamu ezeeyoleka mu nsonga eno ey’okutta ekibi mu bakkiriza.

Ekisooka, nga kye kikulu ku birala byonna, era nga byonna bye bikizzibwako, kiyinza okutunuulirwa nga kiri mu kiteeso kino ekiddako:—

Ka tugambe nti omuntu mukkiriza wa mazima, naye n’asanga mu ye ekibi ekibeera mu ye eky’amaanyi, ekimutwala nga musibe eri etteeka lyakyo, ekiruma omutima gwe n’okweraliikirira, ekitabula ebirowoozo bye, ekinafuya emmeeme ye mu mirimu gy’okussa ekimu ne Katonda, ekimutabula ku by’emirembe, era oboolyawo ekyonoona omuntu we ow’omunda, ne kimuleka mu kabi ak’okukakanyazibwa olw’obulimba bw’ekibi, — anaakola ki? kkubo ki ly’anaakwata era ly’anaakkaatirizaako olw’okutta ekibi kino, okwegomba kuno okubi, obulwadde buno oba obuvundu buno, okutuuka ku ddaala nti, newaakubadde nga tekizikiriziddwa ddala, naye, mu kulwana kwe nakyo, asobozesebwe okukuuma obuyinza, amaanyi n’emirembe mu kussa ekimu ne Katonda?

Okuddamu okubuuza kuno okukulu, nja kukola ebintu bino:—

I. Okulaga okutta ekibi kyonna kye kiri, mu ngeri ey’okugaana n’ey’okukakasa, tuleme okukyamira ku musingi.

II. Okuwa obulagirizi obw’awamu ku bintu ebyo, awatali byo tekiyinzika n’akatono omuntu yenna okutta ddala ekibi kyonna mu mazima ne mu mwoyo.

III. Okulaga ebitundu kimu ku kimu ebigenda okukozesebwa okukikola; mu byonna nga nkuuma mu birowoozo nti siri mu kwogera ku njigiriza ey’okutta ekibi okutwalira awamu, wabula ku nsonga yokka eyo eyateekebwawo waggulu.

I. 1. (1.) Okutta ekibi si kwe kukimalirawo ddala, okukikuulamu n’okukizikiriza, ne kiba nti tekikyalina kyekwata kyonna wadde ekifo mu mitima gyaffe. Kya mazima nti kino kye kigendererwa; naye tekiyinza kutuukirizibwa mu bulamu buno. Tewali muntu yeeteekateeka mu mazima okutta ekibi kyonna, nga tagenderera, nga tayagala era nga teyeegomba kukizikiriza ddala, ne kitaleka mulandira wadde ekibala mu mutima oba mu bulamu. Yandyagadde okukitta bw’atyo kireme kuddamu kunyeenya wadde okusagaasagana, okukaaba oba okuyita, okusendasenda oba okukema, emirembe gyonna. Obutabaawo bwakyo kye kigendererwa. Kaakano, newaakubadde nga tewali kubuusabuusa nti, ku bw’Omwoyo n’ekisa kya Kristo, omuntu ayinza okutuuka ku buwanguzi obw’ekitalo n’obw’ettutumu ku kibi kyonna, ne kiba nti ayinza okuba n’obuwanguzi kumpi obutakoma ku kyo, naye okukimalirawo ddala n’okukizikiriza, kireme kubaawo, tekisuubirwa mu bulamu buno. Kino Pawulo akitukakasa (Abafiripi 3:12), “Sigamba nti mmaze okufuna oba nti mmaze okutuukirira.” Yali mutukuvu mulonde, ekyokulabirako eri abakkiriza, eyali, mu kukkiriza n’okwagala, ne mu bibala byonna eby’Omwoyo, nga talina amwenkana mu nsi, era olw’ensonga eyo yeeyogerako nti atuukiridde bw’ogeraageranya n’abalala (olunyiriri 15); naye yali tannaba “kufuna,” teyali “atuukiridde,” wabula yali “afuba:” yali akyalina omubiri omunafu, nga naffe bwe tugulina, ogugenda okukyusibwa amaanyi amangi aga Kristo ku nkomerero (olunyiriri 21). Kino twandikyagadde; naye Katonda alaba nga kye kisinga obulungi gye tuli obutatuukirira mu kintu kyonna mu ffe ffekka, tulyoke mu bintu byonna tubeere “abatuukiridde mu Kristo;” ekyo kye kitusinga obulungi (Abakkolosaayi 2:10).

(2.) Ndowooza siteekwa na kugamba nti si kwe kukweka ekibi. Omuntu bw’alekayo okukola ekibi kyonna olw’ensonga ez’ebweru, abantu oboolyawo bayinza okumutwala ng’omuntu eyakyuka. Katonda amanyi nti ku butali butuukirivu bwe obw’edda yayongerako obunnanfuusi obukolimiddwa, era ayingidde mu kkubo erimutwala mu ggeyeena nga talina kye yeeraliikirira okusinga bwe yali edda. Afunye omutima omulala gwe yali talina, ogusingako obukujjukujju; si mutima muggya, ogusingako obutukuvu.

(3.) Okutta ekibi tekuli mu kukulaakulanya butonde obukkakkamu, obuteefu. Abantu abamu balina enkizo mu butonde bwabwe, ne kiba nti tebatuukibwako bukambwe bwa busungu obutafugika n’enneewulira ezeetabula ng’abalala bangi. Kaakano abantu bano ka bakuze era bakulaakulanye embeera yaabwe ey’obutonde n’empisa zaabwe nga bayita mu kwekangavvula, mu kulowooza ne mu magezi, bayinza okulabika gye bali n’eri abalala ng’abantu abattidde ddala ekibi, so nga, oboolyawo, emitima gyabwe kinnya kya bugwagwa bwonna ekitakalira. Omuntu omu tatawaanyizibwa nnyo mu bulamu bwe bwonna, oboolyawo, obusungu n’ekiruyi, wadde okutawaanya abalala, ng’omulala bw’atawaanyizibwa kumpi buli lunaku; naye oyo ow’okubiri akoze bingi mu kutta ekibi ekyo okusinga ow’olubereberye. Abantu ng’abo baleme kugezesa kutta ekibi kwabwe ku bintu embeera yaabwe ey’obutonde by’etawa bulamu wadde amaanyi. Ka beeleete ku kwefiiriza, ku butakkiriza, ku buggya, oba ku kibi ekirala eky’omwoyo ekiringa ekyo, bajja kweraba bulungi okusingawo.

(4.) Ekibi tekiba kittiddwa nga kiwugulibwa bugwugulibwa. Simooni Omulogo yaleka okumala akaseera obulogo bwe; naye omululu gwe n’okwegulumiza kwe, ebyamuleetera okubukola, byasigalawo, era byandikoze mu ngeri endala. Kyeyava Peetero amugamba nti, “ndaba nga mu mutima gwo mujjudde obuggya;” — “Newaakubadde ng’oyatula bw’otyo, newaakubadde ng’olese obulogo bwo, okwegomba kwo okubi kukyali kwa maanyi mu ggwe nga bwe kwali; okwegomba okwo kwe kumu, emigga gyakwo gyokka gye giwuguliddwa. Kaakano kweyoleka era kwefulumya mu ngeri endala, naye kukyali obukaawu obw’edda bwe bumu.” Omuntu ayinza okumanya okwegomba okubi, ne yeeteeka okulwanyisa okubutuka kwakwo, n’afaayo kuleme kubutuka nga bwe kwabutukanga, naye ate mu kiseera ekyo n’aleka omuze gwe gumu omwonoonefu okweyoleka mu ngeri endala; ng’oyo awonya ekiwundu ekikulukuta n’akibikkako olususu n’alowooza nti awonye, naye ate mu kiseera ekyo omubiri gwe ne guvunda olw’obuvundu bw’amazzi ge gamu ag’omu mubiri, ne gubutukira mu kifo ekirala. Era okuwugulibwa kuno, n’enkyukakyuka ezikugoberera, emirundi mingi kutuuka ku bantu olw’ensonga ezitakwatagana n’akatono na kisa: okukyusa engeri y’obulamu omuntu gye yalimu, enkolagana ze n’abantu, ebimuganyula, ebigendererwa bye, biyinza okukuleeta; weewaawo, n’enkyukakyuka zennyini mu mibiri gy’abantu, eziva mu kukula okw’obutonde mu bulamu bwabwe, ziyinza okuleeta enkyukakyuka ng’ezo. Abantu abakaddiye tebatera kweyongera kugoberera kwegomba okubi okw’obuvubuka, newaakubadde nga tebattangako na kumu ku kwo. Era bwe kityo bwe kiri ku kuwaanyisa okwegomba okubi, n’okuleka okuweereza okumu omuntu alyoke aweereze okulala. Oyo awaanyisa amalala n’obwagazi bw’ensi, obwagazi bw’omubiri n’Obufalisaayo, okwemanya ye kennyini n’okunyooma abalala, aleme kulowooza nti asse ekibi ky’alabika ng’alese. Akyusizza mukama we, naye akyali muddu.

(5.) Obuwanguzi obw’akaseera ku kibi tebwenkana kukitta.

Waliwo emirundi ebiri oba ebiseera bibiri omuntu alwanagana n’ekibi kyonna mw’ayinza okulowooza nti akisse:—

[1.] Kiri bwe kimala okuba n’okubutuka okw’ennaku, ne kitabula emirembe gye, ne kitiisa omuntu we ow’omunda, ne kimutiisa okuswala, era ne kisunguwaza Katonda mu lwatu. Kino kizuukusa era kikubiriza byonna ebiri mu muntu, ne kimwewuunyisa, ne kimujjuza okukyawa ekibi, n’okwekyawa ye kennyini olw’ekyo; ne kimusindika eri Katonda, ne kimukaabya ng’alwanira obulamu, okukyawa okwegomba kwe okubi nga ggeyeena, n’okukwerwanyisa. Omuntu yenna, ow’omwoyo n’ow’obutonde, bw’amala okuzuukuka, ekibi kiyingiza omutwe gwakyo, tekirabika, naye kigalamira ng’ekifu mu maaso ge: ng’omuntu eyasembera ku ggye ekiro, n’atta omukulu, — amangu ago abakuumi bazuukuka, abantu bagolokoka, ne banoonyereza nnyo omulabe, so nga ye mu kiseera ekyo, okutuusa oluyoogaano n’akajagalalo lwe biggwaawo, yeekweka, oba agalamira ng’afudde, naye ng’amaliridde okuddamu okukola obulabe bwe bumu bw’anaafuna omukisa ogwo. Ku kibi ekyali mu Bakkolinso, laba bwe beekuŋŋaanya okukyekwatira n’okukizikiriza (2 Abakkolinso 7:11). Bwe kiri bwe kityo ku muntu, okwegomba kwe okubi bwe kumala okumenya omuntu we ow’omunda, emirembe gye, oboolyawo n’erinnya lye, mu kubutuka kw’ekibi ekikoleddwa; — okufaayo, okusunguwala, okwegomba, okutya n’okuwalana eggwanga, byonna bikozesebwa ku kyo n’okukirwanyisa, n’okwegomba okubi ne kusirika okumala akaseera, nga kuwanguddwa bino; naye akajagalalo bwe kaggwaawo n’okunoonyereza ne kuyita, omubbi alabika nate nga mulamu, era akola omulimu gwe n’amaanyi nga bwe yali.

[2.] Mu kiseera eky’omusango ogumu, akabi, oba okubonaabona okunyigiriza; omutima olwo guba gujjudde ebirowoozo n’enteekateeka ez’okudduka ebizibu ebiriwo, okutya n’obulabe. Kino, ng’omuntu akakasiddwa ekibi bw’alowooza, kiyinza kukolebwa kyokka ng’aleka ekibi, ekireeta emirembe ne Katonda. Obusungu bwa Katonda obuli mu buli kubonaabona bwe bulumya omuntu akakasiddwa ekibi. Okubuwona, abantu mu biseera ng’ebyo bamalirira okulwanyisa ebibi byabwe. Ekibi tekiriddamu kufuna kifo mu bo; tebaliddamu kwewaayo kukiweereza. Bwe kityo, ekibi kisirika, tekinyeenya, kirabika ng’ekittiddwa; si lwa kuba nti kifunye ekiwundu kyonna, wabula olw’okuba emmeeme ejjuzizza obusobozi bwayo, ekibi bwe kyandyeyolesezzaamu, ebirowoozo ebitakwatagana na kunyeenya kwakyo; era ebirowoozo ebyo bwe biggwaawo, ekibi kiddamu obulamu bwakyo n’amaanyi gaakyo nga bwe kyali. Bwe batyo abo aboogerwako mu (Zabbuli 78:32-37) kye kyokulabirako ekijjuvu era kye kinnyonnyola eky’embeera y’omwoyo gye njogerako: “Naye newaakubadde ebyo byonna byabatuukako, kyokka beeyongera okwonoona; newaakubadde nga yabakolera ebyamagero, naye tebakkiriza. Mukama kyeyava asala ku myaka gyabwe, n’abaleetako okuzikirizibwa okw’amangu era okw’entiisa. Bwe yattanga abamu ku bo, ne balyoka bamunoonya, ne beenenya ne badda gy’ali. Ne bajjukira nti Katonda lwe Lwazi lwabwe; era nti Katonda Ali Waggulu Ennyo ye Mununuzi waabwe. Kyokka baamuwaananga n’emimwa gyabwe, nga bwe bamulimba n’ennimi zaabwe, so tebaali beesigwa mu mitima gyabwe, era nga tebatuukiriza ndagaano ye.” Sibuusabuusa n’akamu nti bwe baamunoonya, ne beenenya, ne badda eri Katonda, baakikola n’omutima ogumalirivu okuleka ebibi byabwe; kyogerwa mu bigambo “ne badda gy’ali.” Okukyuka oba okudda eri Mukama kwe kuleka ekibi. Kino baakikola mangu, — n’obumalirivu n’obunyiikivu; naye ekibi kyabwe kyali tekinnattibwa newaakubadde ebyo byonna (ennyiriri 36, 37). Era eno y’embeera y’okwetoowaza okungi mu nnaku ez’okubonaabona, era obulimba obunene mu mitima gy’abakkiriza bennyini butera okubeera mu kino.

Mu ngeri zino n’endala nnyingi emmeeme ennaku mwe zeerimbira, ne zirowooza nti zisse okwegomba kwazo okubi, so nga kukyali kulamu era kwa maanyi, era ku buli mukisa kubutuka, ne kuzitabula n’okuzimalako emirembe.

fields.title: Okutta ekibi kunnyonnyolwa mu bujjuvu
fields.body_html:
Okutta ekibi kunnyonnyolwa mu bujjuvu — Ebitundu byakwo n’amadaala gaakwo — Okunafuya okw’olubeerera okw’ekikolo kyakyo n’ensibuko yaakyo — Amaanyi g’okwegomba okukema — Enjawulo y’amaanyi ago ng’abantu n’ebiseera bwe biri — Okulwanyisa ekibi obutayosa — Ebitundu by’olutalo olwo nga byekenneenyezebwa — Okuwangula ekibi — Ebyogeddwa byonna nga bifunzibwa.

Kaakano kitusaanidde okwetegereza kye kitegeeza okutta ekibi okutwalira awamu; ekyo kijja kutuggulira ekkubo eri obulagirizi obusingako obutongole.

2. Okutta okwegomba kulimu ebintu bisatu:—

(1.) Okukunafuya okw’olubeerera. Buli kwegomba mpisa nvundu oba omuze omubi, ogutayosa kusika mutima eri obubi. Kyekiva kiwandiikibwa bwe kiti ku muntu atalina kwegomba kwonna kuttiddwa ddala (Olubereberye 6:5), “buli ndowooza y’omutima gw’omuntu mbi njereere ebbanga lyonna.” Bulijjo aba wansi w’amaanyi g’okusikirizibwa okw’amaanyi n’okukutamira eri ekibi. Era ensonga lwaki omuntu ow’obutonde tabeera bulijjo ng’agoberera okwegomba kumu kwokka, emisana n’ekiro, eri nti alina bingi by’aweereza, nga buli kimu kikaaba kimatizibwe; noolwekyo atwalibwa mu ngeri nnyingi ez’enjawulo, naye okutwalira awamu bulijjo aba ng’akutamidde ku kwesanyusa yekka.

Kale ka tulowooze nti okwegomba oba obulwadde obwo bwe tunoonyeza okuttibwa, mu bwakwo, kusika kwa maanyi, kwasimba emirandira ennyo, okw’olubeerera, okw’okwagala n’enneewulira eri ekibi ekimu eky’ebikolwa, nga bwe kiri mu nsonga yaakyo, newaakubadde nga si bulijjo nti kusitula endowooza, ebirowoozo n’enkwe ku kintu ekyo. Kyebava abantu boogerwako nti emitima gyabwe “gijjula kuteekateeka kukola bubi”; omwoyo gwabwe gukutamidde eri obubi, okuwa omubiri ebbanga “kukola ng’okwegomba kwagwo bwe kuli.” Era empisa ey’ekibi enfuuvu, nga bwe kiri mu bintu ebirala bingi, ne mu kino eyawukana ku mpisa zonna ez’obutonde oba ez’empisa ennungi: kubanga zo zisika omwoyo mpola era mu ngeri egusaanira, naye empisa ez’ekibi zisindiikiriza n’amaanyi n’obukambwe; kyekiva okwegomba kwogerwako nti “kulwanagana n’omwoyo” (1 Peetero 2:11), — nti kujeema oba kugolokoka mu lutalo n’enkola n’okuziyiza ebitera okubaawo mu lutalo (Abaruumi 7:23), — nti kutwala mu busibe, oba kuwamba ddala nga kuwangudde mu lutalo, — ebikolwa byonna eby’obukambwe obungi n’amaanyi.
