Kale, kino kye kiragiro kyange eky’okubiri, era kikwata ku kukontana okusaanidde okukolebwa eri okwegomba olw’okubeera kwakwo okw’olubeerera mu mmeeme:— Kuuma nga biramu ku mutima gwo ebirowoozo bino oba ebifaanana nabyo ku musango gwakwo, ku kabi kaakwo, ne ku bubi bwakwo; fumiitiriza nnyo ku bintu bino; leetera omutima gwo okubeera n’okusigala ku byo; teeka ebirowoozo byo mu kufumiitiriza kuno; tobikkiriza kugenda wadde okuwaba okubivaako okutuusa lwe bitandika okuba n’amaanyi ku mmeeme yo, — okutuusa lwe bigikankanya.

fields.title: Tikka omuntu wo ow’omunda omusango gw’obulwadde obukutawaanya
fields.body_html:
Ekiragiro eky’okusatu ekiteekeddwawo: Tikka omuntu wo ow’omunda omusango gw’obulwadde obukutawaanya — Amakubo n’engeri ekyo mwe kiyinza okukolebwa — Ekiragiro eky’okuna: Okwegomba okw’amaanyi okununulibwa — Eky’okutaano: Endwadde ezimu z’omwoyo zisimbye emirandira wansi mu mbeera z’abantu ez’obutonde — Ebirowoozo ku ndwadde ng’ezo; engeri y’okuzikwatamu — Ekiragiro eky’omukaaga: Ebiseera n’emikisa egy’ekibi biteekwa okuziyizibwa — Ekiragiro eky’omusanvu: Okukola okusooka okw’ekibi kuteekwa okulwanyisibwa n’amaanyi.

Kino kye kiragiro kyange eky’okusatu, —

Tikka omuntu wo ow’omunda omusango gwakyo. Tofumiitiriza kyokka nti kirina omusango, naye tikka omuntu wo ow’omunda omusango gw’okubalukawo kwakyo mu bikolwa n’okutabula kwakyo.

Okukozesa obulungi etteeka lino, nja kuwa ebiragiro ebimu eby’enjawulo:—

1. Kozesa enkola ya Katonda mu kino, otandike n’ebintu ebya awamu, olyoke okke ku bintu ebimu ku bimu:—

(1.) Lumiriza omuntu wo ow’omunda omusango ogulabika mu kyo okuva mu bwenkanya n’obutukuvu bw’amateeka. Leeta amateeka amatukuvu aga Katonda mu muntu wo ow’omunda, ogeraageranye obwonoonefu bwo nago, osabe olyoke okwatibweko nago. Fumiitiriza ku butukuvu, ku bw’omwoyo, ku bukambwe obw’omuliro, ku kutuuka munda, ne ku butakyuka bw’amateeka, olabe bw’oyinza okuyimirira mu maaso gaago. Nkugamba, fuba nnyo okukwatako omuntu wo ow’omunda n’entiisa ya Mukama mu mateeka, n’engeri gye kiri eky’obwenkanya buli kimu ku byonoono byo okufuna empeera esaanidde. Oboolyawo omuntu wo ow’omunda ajja kuyiiya obukodyo n’okwewoma okwewala amaanyi g’ekirowoozo kino; — nga, nti obuyinza bw’amateeka obusalira omusango tebukukwatako, wasumululwa okuva mu go, n’ebirala; bwe kityo, wadde nga tokwatagana nago, tekikwetaagisa kutawaana nnyo olw’ekyo. Naye, —

[1.] Gamba omuntu wo ow’omunda nti tayinza kuleeta bukakafu bwonna obusaana nti wasumululwa okuva mu buyinza bw’ekibi obusalira omusango, ng’okwegomba kwo okutattiddwa kukyali mu mutima gwo; bwe kityo, oboolyawo amateeka gayinza okukakasa omusango gwago gy’oli nti gakufugira ddala, olwo n’oba kitonde ekibuze. Noolwekyo kye kisinga obulungi okufumiitiriza okutuuka ku nkomerero ku ebyo bye gagamba.

Ddala, oyo eyeekwasa mu kyama ekisingira ddala eky’omutima gwe nti yasumululwa okuva mu buyinza bw’amateeka obusalira omusango, alyoke mu kyama yeewolereze ng’akkiriza ekibi kyonna oba okwegomba wadde akatono, tasobola, ku misingi gy’Enjiri, kuleeta bukakafu bwonna obumuwa obukuumi obw’omwoyo obugumiikirizika, nti ddala yasumululwa mu ngeri esaanidde okuva mu ekyo ky’ayogera nti yanunulibwamu.

[2.] Ka kibe nga kinaavaamu ki, amateeka galina obuyinza okuva eri Katonda okukwata aboonoonyi buli we gabasanga, n’okubaleeta mu maaso g’entebe ye ey’obwakabaka, gye balina okwewoleza. Eno y’embeera yo kaakano; amateeka gakuzudde, era gajja kukuleeta mu maaso ga Katonda. Bw’oba osobola okwewoleza n’okusonyiyibwa, kirungi nnyo; bw’oba tosobola, amateeka gajja kukola omulimu gwago.

[3.] Ate era, guno gwe mulimu omutuufu ogw’amateeka, okwolesa ekibi mu musango gwakyo, okuzuukusa n’okwetoowaza emmeeme ku lwakyo, okuba endabirwamu eraga ekibi mu langi zaakyo; era bw’ogaana okugakozesa olw’ensonga eno, si lwa kukkiriza, wabula lwa bukakanyavu bw’omutima gwo n’olw’obulimba bw’ekibi.

Luno lwe luggi abeeyatula bangi nnyo lwe baafulumiramu ne batuuka ku kwabulira okw’olwatu. Beekwasa okusumululwa okuva mu mateeka okw’engeri eyo, ne kiba nti tebaddayo kunoonya bulagirizi bwago n’ebiragiro byago; tebaddayo kupima kibi kyabwe nago. Mpola mpola enkola eno, mu ngeri etategeerekeka, okuva ku ndowooza yaayo, yeeyongerayo n’efuga okutegeera kwabwe mu bikolwa, era bwe yamala okwefunira ekifo eyo, n’esumulula okwagala n’enneewulira mu bibi eby’omuzizo ebya buli ngeri.

Kale nkugamba, mu makubo nga gano, sendasenda omuntu wo ow’omunda awulirize n’obunyiikivu amateeka bye gakugamba, mu linnya lya Mukama, ku kwegomba kwo n’obwonoonefu bwo. Ayi! amatu go bwe gaba nga gaggule, gajja kwogera n’eddoboozi erinaakukankanya, erinaakusuula wansi, n’okukujjuza okwewuunya. Bw’oba onootta obwonoonefu bwo, oteekwa okusiba omuntu wo ow’omunda ku mateeka, omuggalire ebweru w’obukodyo bwonna n’okwekwasa, okutuusa lw’akkiriza omusango gwe ng’ategeera bulungi era mu bujjuvu; olwo, nga Dawudi bw’ayogera, “ebibi byo obimanyenga bulijjo.”

(2.) Leeta okwegomba kwo eri Enjiri, — si lwa kuwummuzibwa, wabula lwa kweyongera kumatizibwa ku musango gwakwo; tunuulira oyo gwe wafumita, olumirwe nnyo omwoyo. Gamba emmeeme yo nti, “Nkoze ki? Kwagala ki, kusaasira ki, musaayi ki, kisa ki bye nnyoomye ne mbirinnyirira! Kuno kwe kusasula kwe nsasula Kitaffe olw’okwagala kwe, Omwana olw’omusaayi gwe, Omwoyo Omutukuvu olw’ekisa kye? Bwe ntyo bwe nsasula Mukama? Nnyonoonye omutima Kristo gwe yafiirira okwoza, Omwoyo ow’omukisa gwe yalonda okubeeramu? Era nnyinza okwekuuma obutagwa mu nfuufu? Nnaagamba ki Mukama Yesu omwagalwa? Nnaayimusa ntya omutwe gwange n’obuvumu bwonna mu maaso ge? Mpa okussa ekimu naye omuwendo omutono bwe gutyo, ne kiba nti olw’okwegomba kuno okw’ekivve mmulekedde ekifo kitono nnyo mu mutima gwange? Nze ndiwona ntya bwe ndiragajjalira obulokozi obukulu obwenkana awo? Mu kiseera kino, nnaagamba ki Mukama? Okwagala, okusaasira, ekisa, obulungi, emirembe, essanyu, okubudaabudibwa, — byonna mbinyoomye, ne mbitwala ng’ekintu ekitaliimu, ndyoke nsuze okwegomba mu mutima gwange. Nnafuna okulaba amaaso ga Katonda nga Kitange, ndyoke ntunuulire amaaso ge era mmunyiize mu maaso ge? Emmeeme yange yanaazibwa, ekifo kiryoke kiteekebwewo eri obucaafu obuggya? Nnaafuba okulemesa ekigendererwa ky’okufa kwa Kristo? Nnaanakuwazanga buli lunaku Omwoyo oyo eyanteekako akabonero akalaga nga nnanunulibwa?” Kwatanga omuntu wo ow’omunda buli lunaku n’okuteesa kuno. Laba obanga anaayinza okuyimirira mu maaso g’okwongera kuno okw’omusango gwe. Bino bwe bitamuleetera kugwa wansi mu kigero ekimu n’okusaanuuka, ntya nti embeera yo ya kabi.

2. Kka ku bimu ku bimu. Nga wansi w’omutwe ogwa awamu ogw’Enjiri emiganyulo gyayo gyonna bwe giteekwa okufumiitirizibwako, ng’okununulibwa, okuweebwa obutuukirivu, n’ebirala; bwe kityo, mu ngeri ey’enjawulo, fumiitiriza ku ngeri okwagala okuli mu byo gye kukoleddwamu eri emmeeme yo, olw’okwongera obuzito ku musango gw’obwonoonefu bwo. Nga, —

(1.) Fumiitiriza ku bugumiikiriza obutaliiko kkomo n’okulwawo okusunguwala kwa Katonda gy’oli ggwe kennyini. Fumiitiriza ku mikisa gye yandifunye okukulwanyisa, okukufuula ensonyi n’ekivume mu nsi muno, era ekyagalwa ky’obusungu emirembe gyonna; nga bw’omukoze mu bukuusa n’obulimba buli kiseera, n’omuwaanawaana n’emimwa gyo, naye n’omenya ebisuubizo byonna n’endagaano, era ekyo nga kiva ku kibi ekyo ky’ogoberera kaakano; era naye akusonyiye buli kiseera, wadde nga kirabika wagezesa n’obuvumu okulaba bw’anaayinza okugumiikiriza okumala ebbanga eddenga. Era okyayagala okumwonoonako? okyayagala okumukooya, n’okumuteganya n’obwonoonefu bwo?

Tewatera kwetuukako mu kusalawo nti tekisoboka n’akatono okweyongera okukugumiikiriza; nti ajja kukusuula, n’atakyaddamu kukukwatirwa kisa; nti obugumiikiriza bwe bwonna bwaggwaawo, era nti geyena n’obusungu byali bikuteekeddwateekeddwa dda? naye, okusinga byonna bye wasuubira, yakomawo n’okukukyalira mu kwagala. Era okyayagala okusigala ng’onyiiza amaaso g’ekitiibwa kye?

(2.) Emirundi emeka gy’obadde ku mulyango gw’okukakanyazibwa obulimba bw’ekibi, n’olw’ekisa kya Katonda ekingi ekitaliiko kkomo n’okomezebwawo mu kussa ekimu naye nate?

Tewasanga ekisa nga kikendeera; essanyu mu mirimu gy’okusinza, mu biragiro bye, mu kusaba ne mu kufumiitiriza, nga libula; okwagala okutambula mu bulagajjavu n’obuteefiirayo nga kweyongera; n’abo abaali beezingiddwa edda, nga kumpi tebakyasobola kudda? Tewesanga ng’oli mu makubo, mu bibiina, mu mikwano, ng’ebyo Katonda by’akyawa, era ng’obisanyukira? Era okyagenda okwetantala okusemberera omugo gw’obukakanyavu?

(3.) Ebikolwa bya Katonda byonna eby’ekisa gy’oli, mu ntegeka ze, mu kununulibwa, mu kubonaabona, mu kusaasirwa, mu bintu by’onyumirwa, byonna bisaanidde okufuna ekifo wano. Mu bino, nkugamba, ne mu ngeri endala ezifaanana bwe zityo, tikka omuntu wo ow’omunda; era tomuleka okutuusa ng’akwatiddwako ddala omusango gw’obwonoonefu bwo obubeera mu ggwe, okutuusa ng’awulira ekiwundu kye, n’agalamira mu nfuufu mu maaso ga Mukama. Okuggyako nga kino kikoleddwa nga bwe kisaanidde, okufuba okulala kwonna tekuliiko kye kugasa. Omuntu ow’omunda bw’aba ng’akyalina engeri yonna ey’okukendeeza ku musango gw’ekibi, emmeeme teriyinza kugezaako na maanyi kukitta.

Eky’okuna. Ng’okwatiddwako bw’otyo ekibi kyo, ekiddako funa okwegomba okutakoma, okuwejjawejja olw’okununulibwa okuva mu buyinza bwakyo. Tokkiriza mutima gwo kaseera na kamu okumatira n’embeera yo ey’omwoyo eya kaakano. Okwegomba okw’amaanyi olw’ekintu kyonna, mu bintu eby’obutonde n’eby’ensi, tekuliiko mugaso wadde ensonga, okuggyako nga kukubiriza era kusiikuula omuntu alina okwegomba okwo okukozesa n’obunyiikivu engeri ezireeta ekintu ky’ayagala. Mu bintu eby’omwoyo si bwe kiri. Okwegomba, okuwejjawejja, n’okuyaayaanira okununulibwa kye kisa mu kyokka, ekirina amaanyi amangi okufaananya emmeeme n’ekintu ekiyaayaanirwa. N’olwekyo omutume, ng’annyonnyola okwenenya n’okunakuwala okw’okutya Katonda okw’Abakkolinso, abala kino ng’ekisa kimu eky’enjawulo ekyali kikolera mu bo, “okwegomba,” (2 Abakkolinso 7:11). Era mu mbeera eno ey’ekibi ekibeera mu muntu n’obuyinza bwakyo, alaga nti yali mu mbeera ki? (Abaruumi 7:24). Omutima gwe gubalukawo n’okwegomba nga gwogera ebigambo ebisingira ddala okwoleka okuyaayaanira okununulibwa. Kaakano, bw’eba nga eno y’embeera y’abatukuvu nga bafumiitiriza ku kibi ekibeera mu bo okwa awamu, kiteekwa okweyongera n’okugulumizibwa kwenkana wa, bwe kigattibwako obukambwe obutabula n’obuyinza bw’okwegomba n’obwonoonefu obumu obw’enjawulo! Kakasa nti, okuggyako nga oyaayaanira okununulibwa, tolikufuna.

Kino kijja kuleetera omutima okutunula olw’emikisa gyonna egy’okulwanyisa omulabe waagwo, era okuba omwetegefu okwaniriza obuyambi bwonna obuweebwa olw’okumuzikiriza. Okwegomba okw’amaanyi bwe bulamu bwennyini obw’okusaba okwo “nga mwegayiririranga mu mwoyo buli kiseera” kwe tulagirwa mu mbeera zonna, era okusaba okwo tekwetaagisa nnyo mu mbeera yonna okusinga mu eno; okwegomba okwo kuleetera okukkiriza n’essuubi okukola, era kwe kutambula kw’emmeeme eri Mukama.

Kale, teeka omutima gwo mu mbeera ey’okuwejjawejja n’okuyaayaana; yaayaana, ssa ebikkowe, kaaba. Omanyi ekyokulabirako kya Dawudi; sijja kwetaaga kukyogerako nnyo.

Ekiragiro eky’okutaano kye kino, —

Fumiitiriza obanga obulwadde bw’omwoyo obukutawaanya tebusimbye mirandira mu butonde bwo, ne bulabirirwa, ne busiikuulwa, ne bwongerwa amaanyi embeera y’omubiri gwo. Okukyamira ku bibi ebimu tewali kubuusabuusa kuyinza okubeera mu mbeera ey’obutonde n’empisa z’abantu. Mu mbeera eno fumiitiriza, —

1. Kino si kukendeeza n’akatono ku musango gw’ekibi kyo. Abamu, n’obutatya Katonda obw’olwatu, bassa ebibi eby’omuzizo ennyo ku mbeera zaabwe ez’obutonde n’empisa zaabwe; era obanga abalala tebeewummuza ku musango ogubanyigiriza olw’endwadde zaabwe nga bakozesa ekirowoozo kye kimu, simanyi. Kiva mu kugwa, mu kwonooneka okwasooka okw’obutonde bwaffe, fomes — ensigo n’emmere ey’ekibi kyonna — okubeera mu mbeera yaffe ey’obutonde. Dawudi abala okubumbibwa kwe mu butali butuukirivu n’okufunibwa kwe mu kibi ng’ekyongera obuzito ku kibi kye ekyaddirira, so si ng’ekikikendeeza oba ekikiwolereza. Okuba nti okyamira mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ku bulwadde bwonna obw’ekibi, kwe kubalukawo kwokka okw’enjawulo okw’okwegomba okwasooka mu butonde bwo, ekisaanidde okukwetoowaza n’okukukkakkanya mu ngeri ey’enjawulo.

2. Ky’olina okunyweza ku nsonga eno, ku bikwata ku kutambula kwo ne Katonda, kye kino, nti omukisa omunene bwe gutyo guweebwa ekibi, era ne Setaani, olw’embeera yo eno n’empisa zo, nti awatali kutunula, kufaayo, na bunyiikivu obw’enjawulo ennyo, bijja kuwangula emmeeme yo awatali kubuusabuusa. Enkumi n’enkumi olw’ensonga eno basindiikiriziddwa mangu mu geyena, abandiyinzizza, waakiri, okugenda mu mbiro empola, ezitanyiiza nnyo, ezitali za kabi nnyo.

3. Okutta obulwadde bwonna obusimbye emirandira bwe butyo mu butonde bw’omuntu, ng’oggyeeko amakubo gonna n’engeri endala ezaayogeddwako oba ezigenda okwongera okwogerwako, waliwo engeri emu esaanira mu ngeri ey’enjawulo; eno y’eya omutume (1 Abakkolinso 9:27): “mbonereza omubiri gwange ne ngufuula omuddu wange.” Okufuula omubiri gwennyini omuddu kye kiragiro kya Katonda ekigenderera okutta ekibi. Kino kiziyiza ekikolo eky’obutonde eky’obulwadde, ne kikiwotosa nga kiggyawo obugimu bw’ettaka lyakyo. Oboolyawo, kubanga Abapapa, abantu abatamanyi butuukirivu bwa Kristo, omulimu gw’Omwoyo we, n’ensonga yonna eri mu maaso gaffe, bateeka obuzito bwonna n’omugugu gwonna ogw’okutta ekibi ku buweereza obw’okweyagalira n’okwebonereza, ebireeta okufuga omubiri, nga ddala tebamanyi butonde bwa kibi wadde obw’okukitta, kiyinza, ku ludda olulala, okuba ekikemo eri abamu okulagajjalira engeri ezimu ez’okwetoowaza Katonda yennyini z’akkiriza era z’ateekawo. Okufuula omubiri omuddu mu mbeera eyogeddwako, nga tuziyiza okwegomba kw’omubiri okw’obutonde, nga tusiiba, nga tutunula, n’ebirala, tewali kubuusabuusa nti kisiimibwa Katonda, kasita kikolebwa n’obukomo buno obugoberera:—

(1.) Okunafuya n’okukosa omubiri okw’okungulu tekutwalibwanga ng’ekintu ekirungi mu kyokka, oba nti okutta ekibi kwonna kuli mu kyo, — ekyandituzzizza wansi w’ebiragiro eby’omubiri; wabula ng’engeri yokka ey’okutuuka ku kigendererwa ekiteekeddwawo, — okunafuya obulwadde bwonna mu kikolo kyabwo eky’obutonde ne mu kifo kyabwo. Omuntu ayinza okukogga mu mubiri ne mu mmeeme wamu.

(2.) Nti engeri ekyo mwe kikolebwa, — kwe kugamba, okusiiba n’okutunula, n’ebirala, — tezitwalibwanga ng’ebintu ebiyinza mu byo byokka, n’olw’amaanyi gaabyo, okuleeta okutta okwa ddala okw’ekibi kyonna; kubanga singa byali bisobola, ekibi kyandisobodde okuttibwa awatali buyambi bwonna obw’Omwoyo mu muntu yenna atazaalibwanga buggya mu nsi. Bisaanidde okutwalibwa nga makubo gokka Omwoyo mw’ayinza, era oluusi mw’ayolesa, amaanyi okutuukiriza omulimu gwe, naddala mu mbeera eyogeddwako. Okubulwa okutegeera okutuufu n’okukozesa obulungi ebirowoozo bino n’ebifaanana nabyo, kwazaala mu Bapapa okutta ekibi okwandisinze okusaanira embalaasi n’ensolo endala ez’omu nsiko okusinga abakkiriza.

Kino kye kifunze ky’ebyo ebyogeddwako: Obulwadde obwemulugunyizibwako bwe bulabika nga busimbye emirandira mu mbeera ey’obutonde n’ey’omubiri, nga tuteeka emmeeme zaffe okugabana ku musaayi gwa Kristo ne ku Mwoyo we, okufuba kuteekwa okukolebwa okuziyiza, mu kkubo lya Katonda, ekikolo eky’obutonde eky’obulwadde obwo.

Ekiragiro eky’omukaaga kye kino, —

Fumiitiriza ku biseera, ku mikisa obulwadde bwo gye bufunye okwolesa n’okwoleka amaanyi gaabwo, otunule okubiziyiza byonna.

Kino kitundu ku mulimu ogwo Omulokozi waffe ow’omukisa gw’alagira abayigirizwa be mu linnya ly’okutunula (Makko 13:37): “Kye mbagamba mmwe, kye ŋŋamba buli muntu, mwekuume;” ekyo mu (Lukka 21:34) kiri nti, “Mwekuume muleme okwemalira mu binyumu.” Tunula okuziyiza okubalukawo kwonna okw’obwonoonefu bwo. Ntegeeza omulimu ogwo Dawudi gwe yeeyatula okwemanyiiza. “nneekuuma obutayonoona,” bw’agamba. Yatunuulira amakubo gonna n’okukola kwonna okw’obutali butuukirivu bwe, okubiziyiza, n’okubisitukira. Kino kye tuyitibwa okukola mu linnya ly’“okweddako ku neeyisa yaffe.” Fumiitiriza ku makubo ki, mikwano ki, mikisa ki, misomo ki, mirimu ki, mbeera ki, ebyali biwadde oba ebitera okuwa obulwadde bwo omukisa, oteeke amaanyi go n’obwegendereza okubiziyiza byonna. Abantu bwe batyo bwe bakola ku bunafu bwabwe n’endwadde z’emibiri. Ebiseera, emmere, empewo, ebyabakosa, babyewala. Ebintu by’emmeeme bya mugaso mutono? Manya nti oyo eyeetantala okuzannya n’ebiseera by’ekibi ajja kwetantala okwonoona. Oyo eyeetantala ebikemo ebireeta obubi ajja kwetantala obubi. Kazayeeri yalowooza nti teyandibadde mubi nga nnabbi bwe yamugamba nti aliba. Okumumatiza, nnabbi teyamugamba kirala kyonna wabula nti, “ggwe ogenda okubeera kabaka w’e Busuuli.” Bw’anaayetantala ebikemo ebireeta obukambwe, ajja kuba mukambwe. Gamba omuntu nti ajja kukola ebibi bino na biri, ajja kwekanga. Bw’oyinza okumumatiza nti ajja kwetantala ebiseera ng’ebyo n’ebikemo ebibireeta, ajja kusigaza ensonga ntono nnyo ez’okwekakasa. Ebiragiro eby’enjawulo ebikwata ku mutwe guno bingi, tebigenda kwogerwako kaakano. Naye kubanga omutwe guno si mutono mu bukulu okusinga enjigiriza yonna eyogerwako wano, nkyogeddeko mu bujjuvu mu kitabo ekirala, ekikwata ku kuyingira mu bikemo.

Ekiragiro eky’omusanvu kye kino, —

Situka n’amaanyi okulwanyisa okukola okusooka okw’obulwadde bwo, okufunibwa kwabwo okusooka; tobukkiriza kufuna kifo n’akatono. Toyogeranga nti, “Wano we kinaakoma, tekijja kweyongerayo.” Bwe kiweebwa olukusa okutambula ekigere kimu, kijja kutambula n’ekirala. Tekisoboka kuteekera kibi nsalo. Kiri ng’amazzi mu mukutu, — bwe gamala okubotola, gajja kukulukuta nga bwe gayagala. Okukiziyiza obutakola kwangu okusinga okukiteekera ensalo. N’olwekyo Yakobo ateekawo omutendera ogwo n’okugenda mu maaso kw’okwegomba (Yakobo 1:14-15), tulyoke tuyimirire ku mulyango. Owulira obwonoonefu bwo nga butandise okuzinga ebirowoozo byo? situka n’amaanyi go gonna obulwanyise, n’obusungu obutali butono okusinga nga bwandibadde bumaze okutuukiriza ddala kye bugenderera. Fumiitiriza ku ekyo ekirowoozo ekitali kirongoofu kye kyandyagadde; kyandyagadde weekulukuunye mu busirusiru n’obucaafu. Buuza obuggya kye bwandyagadde; — obussi n’okuzikiriza bye biri ku nkomerero yaabwo. Bulwanyise n’amaanyi agatali matono okusinga nga bwe bwandibadde bumaze okukussa ddala wansi mu bubi. Awatali kkubo lino tojja kuwangula. Ng’ekibi bwe kifuna ekifo mu nneewulira okukisanyukira, kifuna n’ekifo mu kutegeera okukitwala nga kitono.

fields.title: Okulowooza ku bukulu bw’obukulu bwa Katonda
fields.body_html:
Obulagirizi obw’omunaana: Okulowooza ku bukulu bw’obukulu bwa Katonda — Obutamumanya bwaffe bunnyonnyolwa era bwetegerezebwa.

Ekyomunaana, weemanyiize era weegezeemu okufumiitiriza okuyinza okukujjuza buli kiseera okwetoowaza n’okulowooza ku bubi bwo bwennyini; nga, —

1. Lowooza nnyo ku bukulu bw’obukulu bwa Katonda, ne ku bbanga eriri wakati wo naye eritaliiko kkomo era eritategeerekeka. Okukirowoozaako ennyo tekuyinza butakujjuza kumanya bubi bwo, ekintu ekikuba wansi ddala ku kikolo ky’ekibi kyonna ekibeera mu ffe. Yobu bwe yatuuka okulaba obulungi obunene n’obukulu bwa Katonda, yajjula okwenyooma era n’asindiikirizibwa okwetoowaza (Yobu 42:5-6). Era nnabbi Kaabakuuku yeeyogerako nti yasuulibwa mu mbeera ki, bwe yategeera obukulu bwa Katonda? (essuula 3:16). Yobu agamba nti, “Katonda ajja mu kitiibwa eky’amaanyi.” Kyerwava abantu ab’edda balowooza nti bwe bandirabye Katonda bandifudde. Ebyawandiikibwa bijjudde okulowooza kuno okutoowaza omuntu, nga bigeraageranya abantu ab’oku nsi ku “amayanzi,” ku “si kintu n’akamu,” ku “enfuufu ekutte ku minzaani,” bwe bageraageranyizibwa ne Katonda. Lowooza nnyo mu ngeri eno, okutoowaza amalala g’omutima gwo, n’okukuuma emmeeme yo nga ntoowaze munda mu ggwe. Tewali kintu kirikufuula atasobola kulimbibwa bukuusa bw’ekibi okusinga embeera y’omutima ng’eyo. Lowooza bunene ku bunene bwa Katonda.

2. Lowooza nnyo ku butamumanya bwo. Newaakubadde ng’omanyi ekimala okukukuuma nga oli wansi era ng’oli muwombeefu, naye nga kitundu kitono nnyo ky’omumanyiko! Okufumiitiriza kuno kwe kwasuula omusajja oyo ow’amagezi mu kwetegeera kw’ayogera (Engero 30:2-4), “Ddala Ayi Katonda wange nze nsinga obutategeera, sirina kutegeera kwa bantu. Siyize magezi, so n’oyo Omutukuvu simumanyi. Ani eyali alinnye mu ggulu n’akka? Ani eyali akuŋŋaanyiza empewo mu kibatu ky’engalo ze? Ani eyali asibye amazzi mu kyambalo kye? Ani eyatonda enkomerero zonna ez’ensi? Erinnya lye y’ani, ne mutabani we y’ani? Mbulira obanga obimanyi.” Kino nakyo kikozese okumenya amalala g’omutima gwo. Kiki ky’omanyi ku Katonda? Nga kitundu kitono! Nga mugazi nnyo mu butonde bwe! Oyinza okutunuulira mu buziba bw’emirembe n’emirembe nga totiddemu? Toyinza kugumira bitangaala bya kubeerawo kwe okw’ekitiibwa.

Kubanga okulowooza kuno nkutwala nga kwa mugaso munene mu kutambula kwaffe ne Katonda, kasita kukwatagana n’obuvumu obw’abaana obwatuweebwa mu Yesu Kristo okusembera ku ntebe ey’ekisa, nja kugenda mu maaso nga nkussaako essira, okukuteeka ku mitima gy’abo abaagala okutambulira mu buwombeefu ne Katonda, kubeere eky’olubeerera.

Kale, nzigamba nti, okukuuma omutima gwo nga gutya buli kiseera obukulu bwa Katonda, lowooza nti n’abantu abaatuuka ku ddaala erisingayo waggulu era ery’ekitiibwa, abaalina okussa ekimu ne Katonda okw’okumpi ennyo era okw’omukwano, mu bulamu buno bamumanyiiko kitono nnyo ye n’ekitiibwa kye. Katonda yabikkulira Musa erinnya lye, — engeri ze ez’ekitiibwa ennyo z’ayolesezza mu ndagaano ey’ekisa (Okuva 34:5-6); naye byonna “amabega” bwokka ga Katonda. Byonna Musa bye yamanya mu ngeri eyo bitono, biri wansi, bwe bigeraageranyizibwa n’obujjuvu bw’ekitiibwa kye. Kyekyava kyogerwa nga kyogera ku Musa mu ngeri ey’enjawulo nti, “Tewali n’omu eyali alabye ku Katonda” (Yokaana 1:18); kubanga ye gw’ayogerako ng’amugeraageranya ne Kristo (olunyiriri 17); era ku ye kwe kugambibwa wano nti, “Tewali n’omu,” nedda, wadde Musa, eyasinga bonna obukulu, “eyali alabye ku Katonda.” Twogera nnyo ku Katonda, tuyinza okumwogerako, ne ku makubo ge, ne ku bikolwa bye, ne ku kuteesa kwe, olunaku lwonna; naye amazima gali nti tumumanyiiko kitono nnyo. Ebirowoozo byaffe, okufumiitiriza kwaffe, n’ebigambo byaffe ku ye biri wansi, bingi ku byo tebisaanira kitiibwa kye, era tewali na kimu ku byo kituuka ku bujjuvu bwe.

Oligamba nti Musa yali wansi w’amateeka, Katonda bwe yali yeebisse mu kizikiza, n’ekigendererwa kye ng’akibisse mu bifaananyi, ne mu bire, ne mu biragiro ebitategeerekeka; — naye wansi w’okwakaayakana okw’ekitiibwa okw’enjiri, eyaleese obulamu n’obutafa mu musana, Katonda ng’abikkuddwa okuva mu kifuba kye yennyini, kaakano tumumanyi bulungi nnyo okusingawo, era nga bw’ali; kaakano tulaba maaso ge, so si mabega ge gokka nga Musa bwe yalaba.

Okuddamu. 1. Nzikiriza nti waliwo enjawulo nnene ennyo era kumpi etategeerekeka wakati w’okumanya kwe tulina kaakano ku Katonda, oluvannyuma lw’okwogera naffe ng’ayita mu Mwana we yennyini, n’okwo abatukuvu abasinga obungi kwe baalina wansi w’amateeka; kubanga newaakubadde ng’amaaso gaabwe gaali malungi, nga gasongovu era nga galaba bulungi nga agaffe, okukkiriza kwabwe n’okutegeera kwabwe okw’omwoyo nga tekuli wansi w’okwaffe, n’ekyo kye baali batunuulira nga kya kitiibwa gye bali nga bwe kiri gye tuli, naye olunaku lwaffe lwakaayakana okusinga olwabwe, ebire bifuumuuddwa ne bisaasaana, ebisiikirize by’ekiro biweddewo ne bidduka, enjuba evuddeyo, n’ebyuma eby’okulabisa bifuuliddwa bya waggulu era ebirabika obulungi okusinga edda. Naye, —

2. Okulaba okwo okw’enjawulo Musa kwe yalaba Katonda (Okuva 34), kwali kulaba kwa njiri, okulaba Katonda nga “alina ekisa,” n’ebirala, era naye kuyitibwa “amabega” ge gokka; kwe kugamba, kuli wansi era kwa wansi nnyo, bwe kugeraageranyizibwa n’obukulu bwe n’obujjuvu bwe.

3. Omutume, bw’agulumiza ennyo nga bwe kisoboka ekitiibwa kino eky’omusana okusinga eky’amateeka, ng’alaga nti kaakano “essuuka” eyaleetanga ekizikiza eggiddwawo, ne tulyoka, “amaaso gaffe nga gabikuddwa,” tulaba ekitiibwa kya Mukama, atugamba bwe kiri: “ng’endabirwamu” (2 Abakkolinso 3:18). “Mu ndabirwamu,” ekyo kiri kitya? Kirabika bulungi, mu bujjuvu? Woowe, nedda! Akugamba bwe kiri (1 Abakkolinso 13:12), agamba nti, “tulaba kifaananyi bufaananyi, ng’abali mu ndabirwamu eteraba bulungi.” Si ndabirwamu ya kulengera eyamba okulaba ebintu ebiri ewala gy’ayogerako omutume; ate nga n’ezo nga buyambi butono! nga tukyali wala nnyo n’amazima g’ebintu newaakubadde nga zituyamba! Endabirwamu ey’okwetunuuliramu gy’ayogerako (mwe muli ebifaananyi n’ebisiikirize by’ebintu ebitategeerekeka bulungi byokka, so si bintu byennyini), era okulaba omwo kw’ageraageranya okumanya kwaffe. Akugamba era nti byonna bye tulaba, δι’ ἐσόπτρου, “mu” oba “nga tuyita mu ndabirwamu eno,” biri mu αἰνίγματι — mu “kikokko,” mu kizikiza ne mu butalabika bulungi. Era bw’ayogera ku ye yennyini, eyali addala alaba obulungi ennyo okusinga omuntu yenna mulamu kaakano, atugamba nti yamanya ἐκ μέρους, — “kitundu butundu.” Yalaba amabega gokka ag’ebintu eby’omu ggulu (olunyiriri 12), era ageraageranya okumanya kwonna kwe yali atuuseeko ku Katonda n’okwo kwe yalina ku bintu bwe yali omwana omuto (olunyiriri 11). Kiri μέρος, ekitatuuka ku τὸ τέλειον· weewaawo, kiri kye kimu ne καταργηθήσεται , — “kirizikirizibwa,” oba kirivaawo. Tumanyi ebirowoozo by’abaana bwe biba ebinafu, ebitaliimu maanyi era ebitali bikakafu ku bintu ebizibu okutegeera; era nga bwe bakula ne beeyongera mu magezi n’obusobozi, ebirowoozo ebyo bwe bivaawo, ne bikwasa ensonyi. Omwana atenderezebwa olw’okwagala, olw’okussa ekitiibwa, olw’okukkiriza, n’olw’okugondera kitaawe; naye ku bye amanyi n’ebirowoozo bye, kitaawe amanyi obwana bwe n’obusirusiru bwe. Newaakubadde nga twekakasa nti tutuuse waggulu, ebirowoozo byaffe byonna ku Katonda bya kito bwe bigeraageranyizibwa n’obujjuvu bwe obutaliiko kkomo. Twogera bya kito ne tuwowoggana, ne twogera bye tutamanyi, emirundi egisinga, ne mu birowoozo byaffe ku Katonda bye tulowooza nti bye bisinga obutuufu. Tuyinza okwagala Kitaffe, okumussaamu ekitiibwa, okumukkiriza, n’okumugondera; era olw’ekyo akkiriza ebirowoozo byaffe eby’ekito, kubanga bya kito bwokka. Tulaba amabega ge gokka; tumumanyiiko kitono. Kyekiva kiba nti ekisuubizo ekyo kye tuwanirirwa nakyo emirundi mingi ne kitubudaabuda mu nnaku yaffe: “tulimulabira ddala nga bw’ali;” tulimulaba “amaaso n’amaaso;” tulimanya nga bwe tumanyiddwa, era tulitegeera ekyo kye twakwatibwako (1 Abakkolinso 13:12, 1 Yokaana 3:2); era ng’ekintu ekikakafu, “kaakano temumulaba;” — byonna nga bikakasa nti wano tulaba amabega ge gokka; si nga bw’ali, wabula mu kifaananyi ekiri mu kizikiza ekitategeerekeka; si mu bujjuvu bw’ekitiibwa kye.

Kabaka omukazi ow’e Seeba yali awulidde bingi ku Sulemaani, era n’alowooza mu mutima gwe ebirowoozo bingi ebinene ku bukulu bwe; naye bwe yajja n’alaba ekitiibwa kye, yawalirizibwa okwatula nti n’ekitundu kimu kyokka eky’amazima kyali tekimubuuliddwa. Tuyinza okulowooza nti wano tutuuse ku kumanya kungi, n’ebirowoozo ebirabika obulungi era ebya waggulu ku Katonda; naye, woowe! bw’alituyingiza mu maaso ge tulikaaba nti, “Tetwamumanya nga bw’ali; ekitundu ekimu ku lukumi eky’ekitiibwa kye, n’obujjuvu bwe, n’omukisa gwe, tekyayingira mu mitima gyaffe.”

Omutume atugamba (1 Yokaana 3:2) nti tetumanyi bwe tuliba ffe ffennyini, — bye tulyesangamu ku nkomerero; kale n’okusingawo tekiriyingira mu mitima gyaffe okutegeera Katonda kye ali, n’ekyo kye tulimusanga nga ye. Lowooza oba ku oyo agwanira okumanyibwa, oba ku kkubo lye tumumanyiramu, era kino kijja kweyongera okulabika:—

(1.) Tumanyi kitono nnyo ku Katonda, kubanga Katonda y’agwanira okumanyibwa bwe tutyo, — kwe kugamba, oyo eyeeyogeddeko gye tuli ennyo mu kino, nti tetuyinza kumumanya. Kiki ekirala ky’ategeeza bwe yeeyita atalabika, atategeerekeka, n’ebirala ebiringa ebyo? — kwe kugamba, oyo gwe tutamanyi, era gwe tutayinza kumanya nga bw’ali. Era okweyongera kwaffe mu maaso kusinga kuba mu kumanya ky’atali, okusinga ky’ali. Bw’atyo bw’ayogerwako nti tafa, talina kkomo, — kwe kugamba, si nga ffe bwe tuli, abafa, abalina ekkomo era abaziyizibwa. Kyekiva kiba okumwogerako okw’ekitiibwa (1 Timoseewo 6:16), “ye yekka atafa era atuula mu kwakaayakana okutasemberekeka, era tewali n’omu yali amulabye, so tewali asobola kumulaba.” Omusana gwe guli gwe kitonde kyonna kye kitayinza kusemberera. Talabibwa, si lwa kuba nti tayinza kulabibwa, wabula kubanga ffe tetuyinza kugumira kumulaba. Omusana gwa Katonda, atalimu kizikiza n’akatono, guziyiza buli kitonde kyonna okumutuukako. Ffe abatayinza kutunuulira njuba mu kitiibwa kyayo tuli banafu nnyo okugumira ebitangaala by’okwakaayakana okutaliiko kkomo. Olw’okulowooza kuno, nga bwe kyayogeddwa, omusajja ow’amagezi yeeyatula nti “nsinga obutategeera,” era nti “sirina kutegeera kwa bantu” (Engero 30:2); — kwe kugamba, teyamanya kintu bwe yeegeraageranya ne Katonda; n’alabika ng’afiiriddwa okutegeera kwe kwonna bwe yatuuka okulowooza ku ye, ne ku mulimu gwe, ne ku makubo ge.

Mu kulowooza kuno emmeeme zaffe zikke mu nsonga ezimu ku zimu:—

[1.] Ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda; tuli wala nnyo n’okukumanya, n’okusobola okuyigirizagana ku kwo mu bigambo n’ebyogerwa, era okukola ekifaananyi kyonna mu birowoozo byaffe, ng’ebifaananyi n’obubonero bw’ebintu ebyo bye tufunamu okumanya ebintu ebirala byonna, kwe kwekolera ekifaananyi ekisinzibwa, bwe tutyo ne tusinza katonda gwe twekoledde ffe, so si Katonda eyatukola. Kyandibadde kye kimu era eky’amateeka okumubajja mu muti oba mu jjinja ng’okumukolera mu birowoozo byaffe ekifaananyi ekikwatagana n’okutegeera kwaffe. Ekisingayo mu birowoozo byaffe ebisinga obulungi ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda kiri nti tetuyinza kubeera na birowoozo ku kwo. Okumanya kwaffe ku kubeerawo kuli wansi nnyo bwe kutalinnya waggulu okusinga okumanya nti tetukumanyi.

[2.] Waliwo ebintu ebimu ku Katonda ye yennyini by’atuyigiriza okwogerako, n’okulungamya ebigambo byaffe ku byo; naye bwe tumala okukola bwe tutyo, tetulaba bintu byennyini; tetubimanyi. Okukkiriza n’okuwuniikirira bye byokka kye tutuukako. Twatula, nga bwe twayigirizibwa, nti Katonda talina kkomo, wa buyinza bwonna, wa mirembe na mirembe; era tumanyi empaka n’ebirowoozo ebiriwo ku kubeerawo kwe wonna wonna, ku bugazi bwe obutapimika, ku butaba na kkomo, ne ku mirembe n’emirembe. Tulina, nzigamba, ebigambo n’ebirowoozo ku bintu bino; naye ku bintu byennyini tumanyi ki? tubitegeerako ki? Amagezi g’omuntu gayinza okukola ekirala kyonna okuggyako okwemira mu buziba obutaliiko kkomo, obuli ng’obutaliiwo; okwewaayo eri ekyo ky’atayinza kutegeera, n’okusingawo ky’atayinza kwogera? Okutegeera kwaffe tekuli kwa ‘obutategeera’ nga tulowooza ku bintu ng’ebyo, era tekuli ng’okutaliiwo? Weewaawo, obujjuvu bw’okutegeera kwaffe kwe kutategeera, ne tuwummulira awo. Mabega gokka ag’emirembe n’emirembe n’obutaba na kkomo ge tulengerako. Kiki kye nnyinza okwogera ku Busatu, oba ku kubeerawo kw’abantu ab’enjawulo mu bulamu bumu obwa Katonda, — ekyama abangi kye beegaana, kubanga tewali akitegeera, — ekyama nga buli nnukuta yaakyo kyama? Ani ayinza okunnyonnyola okuzaalibwa kw’Omwana, okuva kw’Omwoyo, oba enjawulo wakati w’omu n’omulala? Naye sijja kweyongera kuwa byakulabirako mu nsonga ezimu ku zimu. Ebbanga eryo eritaliiko kkomo era eritategeerekeka eriri wakati we naffe litukuuma mu kizikiza ku kulaba kwonna okw’amaaso ge oba okutegeera obulungi obujjuvu bwe.

Tumumanya okusinga mu by’akola okusinga mu ky’ali, — mu kutukolera ebirungi okusinga mu bulungi bwe obw’obutonde; era, nga Yobu bw’ayogera, nga “katundu butundu” bwokka ku ye bwe kubikkulirwa mu ngeri eno!

(2.) Tumanyi kitono ku Katonda, kubanga kukkiriza kwokka kwe tumumanyiramu wano. Kaakano sijja kwogera ku ebyo ebisigaddeyo nga byawandiikibwa ku mitima gy’abantu bonna mu butonde nti waliwo Katonda, wadde ku ebyo bye bayinza okuyigirizibwa mu magezi ku Katonda oyo okuva mu mirimu gy’okutonda kwe n’okulabirira kwe, bye balaba ne batunuulira. Kikkirizibwa, era nga kikakasibwa okumanya okw’ennaku okw’emirembe gyonna, nti kunafu nnyo, kuli wansi, kuli mu kizikiza, era kutabuddwatabuddwa, ne kiba nti tewali yali agulumizza Katonda nga bwe kibagwanidde olw’ensonga eyo, wabula, newaakubadde nga baali bamanyi ku Katonda, mazima ddala baali “wala ne Katonda” mu nsi.

Okumanya okukulu, era, mu mazima, kumpi kwe kwokka kwe tulina ku Katonda, ne ku ngeri gy’atuyisaamu nga yeeraga, kuli lwa kukkiriza. “Buli ajja eri Katonda kimugwanira okukkiriza nti Katonda waali era n’abo abamunoonya n’obwesigwa abawa empeera” (Abaebbulaniya 11:6). Okumanya kwaffe ku ye ne ku kuwa kwe empeera (omusingi gw’obuwulize bwaffe oba okujja kwaffe gy’ali), kwe kukkiriza. “tutambula lwa kukkiriza so si lw’amaaso gaffe bye galaba” (2 Abakkolinso 5:7); — Διὰ πίστεως οὐ διὰ εἴδους· lwa kukkiriza, era lwa kukkiriza mu ngeri etatuleka kubeera na kirowoozo kyonna ekirambulukufu, oba ekifaananyi, oba akabonero k’ekyo kye tukkiriza. Okukkiriza bwe bukakafu bwokka bwe tulina ku bintu ebyo nga “tebirabika” (Abaebbulaniya 11:1). Nandisigadde wano ku butonde bwakwo; era okuva mu byonna ebigenda nakwo n’ebikukwatako, ne ndaga nti ebyo bye tumanya olw’okukkiriza kwokka tubimanyiiko amabega gokka. Ku ntandikwa yaakwo, kuzimbiddwa ku bujulirwa bwa Oyo gwe tutalabangako kwokka: ng’omutume bw’ayogera nti, “Muyinza mutya okwagala oyo gwe mutalabangako?” — kwe kugamba, gwe mumanyi nti weewaali olw’okukkiriza kwokka. Okukkiriza kufuna byonna ku bujulirwa bwe, oyo gwe kukkiriza nti weewali ku bujulirwa bwe yekka. Ku butonde bwakwo, kwe kukkiriza olw’obujulirwa, so si bukakafu obulagiddwa; era kye kutunuulira, nga bwe kyayogeddwa edda, kiri waggulu waffe. Kyekiva kiba nti okukkiriza kwaffe, nga bwe kyalagiddwa edda, kuyitibwa okulaba “kifaananyi bufaananyi, ng’abali mu ndabirwamu eteraba bulungi.” Byonna bye tumanya mu kkubo lino (era byonna bye tumanya ku Katonda tubimanyira mu kkubo lino) biri wansi, biri mu kizikiza, era tebirabika bulungi.

Naye oligamba nti, “Bino byonna mazima, naye biri bwe bityo eri abo bokka abatamanyi Katonda, oboolyawo, nga bwe yabikkulirwa mu Yesu Kristo; eri abo abamumanyi kiri kirala. Mazima, ‘Tewali n’omu eyali alabye ku Katonda,’ naye ‘Omwana we omu yekka,’ ‘oyo ye yatutegeeza byonna ebimufaako’ (Yokaana 1:18); era ‘Omwana wa Katonda yajja mu nsi, n’atuwa okutegeera tumanye Katonda ow’amazima’ (1 Yokaana 5:20). Okwakaayakana kw’enjiri ‘ey’ekitiibwa kya Kristo, ye nga kye kifaananyi kya Katonda,’ kwakira abakkiriza (2 Abakkolinso 4:4); weewaawo, era Katonda oyo eyalagira omusana okwaka okuva mu kizikiza, ‘ye yayaka mu mitima gyaffe, okuleetera abantu ekitangaala eky’okumanya ekitiibwa kya Katonda ekirabikira mu Yesu Kristo’ (olunyiriri 6). Kale newaakubadde ‘Edda mwali ng’abantu ab’ekizikiza,’ naye ‘kaakano muli bantu ba musana mu Mukama waffe’ (Abaefeso 5:8). Era omutume agamba nti, ‘ffe ffenna, amaaso gaffe nga gabikuddwa,’ tulaba ekitiibwa kya Mukama (2 Abakkolinso 3:18); era kaakano tuli wala nnyo n’okubeera mu kizikiza ng’ekyo, oba ewala ng’ako ne Katonda, ne kiba nti okussa kimu kwaffe n’okukolagana kwaffe kuli ‘ne Kitaffe awamu n’Omwana we’ (1 Yokaana 1:3). Omusana gw’enjiri Katonda mw’abikkulirwa kaakano gwa kitiibwa; si mmunyeenye, wabula enjuba mu bulungi bwayo evuddeyo ku ffe, era essuuka eggiddwa ku maaso gaffe. Kale newaakubadde ng’abatakkiriza, weewaawo, era oboolyawo abakkiriza abamu abanafu, bayinza okubeera mu kizikiza ekimu, naye abo abakuze oba abatuuse ewala balaba bulungi era beetegereza amaaso ga Katonda mu Yesu Kristo.”

Kwe nziramu nti, —

[1.] Amazima gali nti ffenna tumumanyiiko ekimala okumwagala okusinga bwe tukola, okumusanyukira n’okumuweereza, okumukkiriza, okumugondera, n’okumwesiga, okusinga byonna bye tutuuseeko okutuusa kaakano. Ekizikiza kyaffe n’obunafu bwaffe si nsonga ewolereza obulagajjavu bwaffe n’obujeemu bwaffe. Ani eyali atambudde okutuuka ku kumanya kw’alina ku bujjuvu, ku bukulu, ne ku kwagala kwa Katonda? Ekigendererwa kya Katonda mu kutuwa okumanya kwonna ku ye wano kwe kuba nti tulyoke “tumugulumize nga Katonda;” kwe kugamba, okumwagala, okumuweereza, okumukkiriza n’okumugondera, — okumuwa ekitiibwa kyonna n’okugulumizibwa okumugwanidde okuva eri ebitonde ebyavu eby’ebibi eri Katonda asonyiwa ebibi era Omutonzi. Ffenna tuteekwa okwatula nti tetufuulibwanga ddala mu kifaananyi ky’okumanya okwo kwe tubadde nakwo. Era singa twakozesa bulungi ttalanta zaffe, twandiwereddwa ebisingawo.

[2.] Bwe tugeraageranya, okumanya kwe tulina ku Katonda olw’okubikkulirwa kwa Yesu Kristo mu njiri kwa waggulu nnyo era kwa kitiibwa. Kuli bwe kutyo bwe kugeraageranyizibwa n’okumanya kwonna ku Katonda okwandifuniddwa mu ngeri endala, oba okwaweebwa mu mateeka wansi w’Endagaano Enkadde, agaalina ekisiikirize kyokka eky’ebirungi, so si kifaananyi kyennyini eky’ebyo; kino omutume akinnyonnyola mu bujjuvu (2 Abakkolinso 3). Kristo kaakano mu nnaku zino ez’enkomerero abikkudde Kitaffe okuva mu kifuba kye yennyini, alangiridde erinnya lye, amanyisizza ebirowoozo bye, okwagala kwe, n’okuteesa kwe mu ngeri erabika obulungi, ey’ekitiibwa era etegeerekeka okusinga ennyo nga bwe yakola edda, bwe yali akuuma abantu be wansi w’obuyigiriza bw’amateeka; era kino kye kiba kitegeezebwa emirundi egisinga mu bifo ebyo ebyogeddwako waggulu. Okuweebwa okulambulukufu era okutegeerekeka n’okulangirira Katonda n’okwagala kwe mu njiri kugulumizibwa mu lwatu okusinga engeri endala yonna gy’ayinza okweyolekamu.

[3.] Enjawulo wakati w’abakkiriza n’abatakkiriza ku by’okumanya teri nnyo mu bye bamanya wabula mu ngeri gye bamanyamu. Abatakkiriza, abamu ku bo, bayinza okumanya ebisingawo era n’okusobola okwogera ebisingawo ku Katonda, ku bujjuvu bwe, ne ku kwagala kwe, okusinga abakkiriza bangi; naye tebalina kye bamanyi nga bwe kibagwanidde, tebalina kye bamanyi mu ngeri entuufu, tebalina kye bamanyi mu mwoyo ne mu ngeri erokola, tebalina kye bamanyi mu musana omutukuvu ogw’omu ggulu. Obukulu bw’omukkiriza si nti alina okutegeera okugazi ku bintu, wabula nti ekyo ky’ategeera, newaakubadde nga kiyinza okuba ekitono ennyo, akiraba mu musana gw’Omwoyo wa Katonda, mu musana ogulokola era ogukyusa emmeeme; era kino kye kituwa okussa ekimu ne Katonda, so si birowoozo ebisokoola oba endowooza ez’obukodyo.

[4.] Yesu Kristo ng’ayita mu kigambo kye ne mu Mwoyo we abikkulira emitima gy’abantu be bonna Katonda nga Kitaffe, nga Katonda ow’endagaano, ng’oyo awa empeera, mu buli ngeri ekimala okutuyigiriza okumugondera wano, n’okututwala mu kifuba kye, okugalamira eyo nga tumunyumirwa emirembe n’emirembe. Naye kaakano,

[5.] Newaakubadde nga bino byonna biri bwe bityo, kitundu kitono kyokka kye tumumanyiiko; tulaba amabega ge gokka. Kubanga, —

1. Ekigendererwa ky’okubikkulirwa kwonna okw’enjiri si kwe kubikkula kitiibwa kya Katonda eky’obutonde bwe, tulyoke tumulabe nga bw’ali, wabula kwe kulangirira obulangirizi ku ye ekyo ky’amanyi nti kimala okuba omusingi gw’okukkiriza kwaffe, okwagala, obuwulize, n’okujja gy’ali, — kwe kugamba, ogw’okukkiriza ky’atusuubiramu wano; obuweereza obusaanira ebitonde ebyavu ebiri wakati mu bikemo. Naye bw’alituyita mu kuwuniikirira n’okufumiitiriza okw’emirembe n’emirembe, awatali kuziyizibwa, alyeraga mu ngeri empya, era embeera yonna ey’ebintu, nga bw’eri kaakano mu maaso gaffe, eriggwaawo ng’ekisiikirize.

2. Tuli bazito era tuli ba mitima egirwawo okukkiriza ebintu ebibikkuliddwa mu kigambo; Katonda, olw’obunafu bwaffe n’obuyinike bwaffe, atukuuma nga tumwesigamye buli kiseera okutuyigiriza n’okweraga gye tuli okuva mu kigambo kye, ng’atatuusa mmeeme yonna mu nsi muno ku bujjuvu bw’ebyo ebyandiggiddwa mu kigambo ne bitegeerebwa: kale newaakubadde ng’ekkubo ly’okubikkulirwa mu njiri lirabika bulungi era lyeyoleka, naye ebintu byennyini ebibikkuliddwa tubimanyiiko kitono.

Kale, tuzzeemu omugaso n’ekigendererwa ky’okulowooza kuno: Okutegeera okutuufu okw’obukulu buno obwa Katonda obutategeerekeka, n’ebbanga eryo eritaliiko kkomo lye tuliko okuva gy’ali, tekulijjuza mmeeme kutya okutukuvu era okw’entiisa gy’ali, ne kugikuuma mu mbeera etasaanira kukula oba kukulaakulana kwa kwegomba kwonna okubi? Emmeeme k’emanyiizibwe buli kiseera okulowooza n’okussa ekitiibwa ku bukulu bwa Katonda n’okubeerawo kwe wonna wonna, era ejja kwekuuma nnyo ku nneeyisa yonna etasaana. Lowooza ku oyo gw’olina okukolagana naye, — nti ddala “Katonda waffe, gwe muliro ogwokya;” era mu kuswala kwo okusingayo mu maaso ge ne mu liiso lye, manya nti obutonde bwo bwennyini bufunda nnyo okugumira okutegeera okusaanira ekitiibwa kye eky’obutonde bwe.

fields.title: Omutima bwe gutabuka olw’ekibi, togwogerako mirembe okutuusa Katonda lw’agyogera
fields.body_html:
Obulagirizi obw’omwenda: Omutima bwe gutabuka olw’ekibi, togwogerako mirembe okutuusa Katonda lw’agyogera — Emirembe egitali na kukyawa kibi si mituufu; bwe gityo bwe giri emirembe gye twepimira ffekka — Engeri gye tuyinza okumanya nga twepimira emirembe ffekka — Obulagirizi ku kunoonyereza okwo — Obutaliimu bw’okwogera emirembe mu bwangu; era n’obw’okugyogera ku nsonga emu yokka, so si ku byonna.

Ogw’omwenda, Katonda bw’aba ng’atabula omutima olw’omusango gw’endwadde zaagwo, oba olw’ensibuko yaazo n’okubeera kwazo mu gwo, oba olw’engeri yonna gye zibutukamu, weegendereze oleme kwogera mirembe eri gwe kennyini nga Katonda tannagyogera; naye wuliriza ky’agamba emmeeme yo. Buno bwe bulagirizi bwaffe obuddako; omutima bwe gutabwegendereza, gujja kuba mu kabi ka maanyi okulimbibwa obulimba bw’ekibi.

Kino kintu kikulu nnyo. Kya nnaku omuntu okulimba emmeeme ye mu nsonga eno. Okulabula kwonna Katonda kw’atuwa, mu kusaasira emmeeme zaffe, tusobole okwekebera n’okwegeza, kugendereddwamu okuziyiza ekibi kino ekinene: okwogera emirembe eri ffe ffekka nga tewali musingi; ekyo ku nkomerero kwe kwewa omukisa ffekka nga tuwakanya Katonda. Si mulimu gwange okulwawo ku kabi kaakyo, wabula okuyamba abakkiriza okukyewala, n’okubamanyisa nga bakikola.

Okutambuza obulagirizi buno obulungi, weetegereze nti, —

1. Nga bwe kiri obuyinza n’obwakabaka obukulu bwa Katonda okuwa ekisa oyo gw’ayagala (“Katonda asaasira oyo gw’ayagala okusaasira,” Abaruumi 9:18; era mu baana b’abantu bonna, ayita gw’ayagala, era atukuza gw’ayagala), bw’atyo ne mu abo abayitiddwa ne baweebwa obutuukirivu, era b’ayagala okulokola, akyeterekera yekka enkizo eno: okwogera emirembe eri oyo gw’ayagala, era ku kigero ky’ayagala, wadde mu abo be yawa ekisa. Ye “Katonda w’okubudaabuda kwonna,” mu ngeri ey’enjawulo mu nkolagana ye n’abakkiriza; kwe kugamba, ow’ebirungi by’akuuma nga bisibiddwa mu maka ge, n’abigabira abaana be bonna nga bw’asiima. Kino Mukama akinyweza mu (Isaaya 57:16-18). Embeera gye twetegereza wano y’emu n’eyo enywezebwa eyo. Katonda bw’agamba nti aliwonya ebituli byabwe n’ennaku yaabwe, yeetwalira enkizo eno mu ngeri ey’enjawulo: “Nze nkitonda,” olunyiriri 19; — “Ne ku bitonde bino ebinaku ebiwundiddwa, nze nkitonda, era mu bwakabaka bwange nkigaba nga bwe nsiima.”

Noolwekyo, nga bwe kiri mu kugaba ekisa eri abo abali mu mbeera ey’obutonde, — Katonda akikola n’obwegendereza bungi, n’engeri gy’akolamu mu kutwala n’okuleka, ku ndabika ey’okungulu, emirundi mingi ewukana era ekontana n’ebyo byonna abantu bye bandisuubidde; bwe kiri ne mu kugaba kwe okw’emirembe n’essanyu eri abo abali mu mbeera ey’ekisa, — emirembe mingi agigaba nga tetusuubira, ku bikwata ku nsonga zonna ezirabika ez’enkola ye.

2. Nga Katonda bw’agitondera oyo gw’ayagala, bwe kiri obuyinza bwa Kristo okugyogera n’etuuka ddala mu muntu ow’omunda. Bwe yayogera eri ekkanisa ey’omu Lawodikiya, eyali ejjanjabye ebiwundu byayo mu bulimba, n’eyeyogerako emirembe nga tekyagwanidde, yeetwalira erinnya lino: “Nze Amiina, omujulirwa, omwesigwa,” (Okubikkulirwa 3:14). Ye awa obujulirwa ku mbeera yaffe nga bw’eri ddala. Ffe tuyinza okukyama, ne twetawaanya bwereere, oba ne twewaanawaana ku misingi egy’obulimba, naye ye “Amiina, omujulirwa, omwesigwa;” era ky’ayogera ku mbeera yaffe, ekyo kye kiri ddala. (Isaaya 11:3), kyogerwa ku ye nti “Taasalenga misango ng’asinziira ku maaso ge,” — si ng’endabika ey’okungulu bw’eri, oba ekintu kyonna ekiyinza okukyamya, nga ffe bwe tutera okukola; wabula alisala era n’alamula buli nsonga nga bw’eri ddala.

Mu kwetegereza ebintu bino ebibiri ebisooka, nja kuwa amateeka abantu ge bayinza okumanyiramu oba Katonda ye ayogera nabo emirembe, oba nga beeyogerera bokka emirembe:—

1. Abantu mazima beeyogerera emirembe bokka, ekyo bwe bakikola nga tekigenda wamu n’okukyawa okusingirayo ddala ekibi ekyo kye beeyogerako emirembe, n’okwetamwa bo bennyini ku lwakyo. Abantu bwe bawundibwa ekibi, ne batabuka ne basoberwa, era nga bamanyi nti tewali ddagala gye bali wabula mu kusaasira kwa Katonda kwokka, olw’omusaayi gwa Kristo, ne kyebava batunuulira ye, n’ebisuubizo by’endagaano mu ye, ne bakkakkanya emitima gyabwe nti bijja kubagendera bulungi, era nti Katonda aligulumizibwa alyoke abakwatirwe ekisa, kyokka emmeeme zaabwe ne zitakolebwamu kukyawa nnyo ekibi oba ebibi ebibatabudde, — kuno kwe kwewonya bokka, so si kuwonyezebwa Katonda. Eno nga mbuyaga nnyingi ey’amaanyi, Mukama gy’ali okumpi, naye nga Mukama taliimu mu mbuyaga. Abantu bwe batunuulira ddala “Kristo gwe baafumita,” awatali ekyo tewali kuwona wadde emirembe, “balimukungubagira,” (Zekkaliya 12:10); balimukungubagira, ne ku nsonga eno, era balikyawa ekibi ekyamufumita. Bwe tugenda eri Kristo okuwonyezebwa, okukkiriza kumutunuulira mu ngeri ey’enjawulo ng’oyo eyafumitibwa. Okukkiriza kutunuulira Kristo mu ngeri nnyingi, okusinziira ku nsonga ezikutwala gy’ali n’okussa ekimu naye. Oluusi kutunuulira obutukuvu bwe, oluusi amaanyi ge, oluusi okwagala kwe, [oluusi] okuganja kwe eri Kitaawe. Era bwe kugenda okunoonya okuwonyezebwa n’emirembe, kutunuulira nnyo omusaayi gw’endagaano, okubonaabona kwe; kubanga “Ebiwundu bye, bye bituwonya, era Yeetikka ekibonerezo ffe tusobole okubeera n’emirembe,” (Isaaya 53:5). Bwe tunoonya okuwonyezebwa, ebiwundu bye bye tulina okutunuulira, — si mu byafaayo byabyo eby’okungulu, nga bwe bakola abasinza ab’ekipaapa, wabula mu kwagala, ekisa, ekyama n’ekigendererwa ky’omusaalaba; era bwe tunoonya emirembe, ekibonerezo kye kirina okuba mu maaso gaffe. Kale kino, njogera, bwe kikolebwa nga Katonda bw’ayagala, era mu maanyi g’Omwoyo oyo afukiddwa ku bakkiriza, kijja kuzaala okukyawa ekibi oba ebibi ebyo by’onoonyeza okuwonyezebwa n’emirembe. Bwe kityo mu (Ezeekyeri 16:60, 61), “Naye ndijjukira endagaano gye nakola naawe mu biseera eby’obuvubuka bwo, era ndissaawo endagaano ey’emirembe n’emirembe.” Era olwo ki? “Olwo olijjukira engeri zo, n’oswala.” Katonda bw’ajja ddala okwogera emirembe mu ndagaano yaago enywevu, ajjuza emmeeme ensonyi olw’amakubo gonna mwe yeeyawulira ku ye. Era ekimu ku ebyo omutume by’ayogerako nga bigenda wamu n’okunakuwala okw’okutya Katonda okuleeta okwenenya okutuusa mu bulokozi, okutalina kwejjusa, kwe kuwalana eggwanga: “Weewaawo, n’okuwalana eggwanga!” (2 Abakkolinso 7:11). Baddamu okulowooza ku nsobi zaabwe n’obusungu n’okuwalana eggwanga, olw’obusirusiru bwabwe mu zo. Yobu bwe yatuuka ku kuwona okujjuvu, yakaaba nti, “Kyenvudde neenyooma,” (Yobu 42:6); era okutuusa lwe yakikola, teyalina mirembe gya lubeerera. Oboolyawo yandyekkakkanyizza n’enjigiriza ey’ekisa eky’obwereere Eriku gye yabuulira obulungi ennyo, essuula 33 okuva ku lunyiriri 14 okutuuka ku 30; naye olwo yali abisse busibi lususu ku biwundu bye: yalina okutuuka ku kwetamwa yekka bw’aba wa kuwona. Bwe kyali bwe kityo ne ku abo ab’omu (Zabbuli 78:33-35), mu nnaku yaabwe ennene n’okusoberwa, olw’ekibi. Sibuusabuusa nti bwe baagenda eri Katonda mu Kristo (kubanga kyeyoleka nti bwe baakola, okuva mu mannya ge baamuwa; bamuyita Olwazi lwabwe era Omununuzi waabwe, ebigambo bibiri ebiraga Mukama Kristo buli wamu), beeyogerako emirembe bokka; naye gyali mituufu era egy’olubeerera? Nedda; gyayita ng’omusulo ogw’oku makya. Katonda teyayogera kigambo na kimu kya mirembe eri emmeeme zaabwe. Naye lwaki tebaalina mirembe? Kubanga, bwe baagenda eri Katonda, baamuwaanawaana. Naye ekyo kyeyoleka kitya? Olunyiriri 37: “tebaali beesigwa mu mitima gyabwe, era nga tebatuukiriza ndagaano ye;” tebaalina kukyawa wadde okuleka ekibi ekyo kye beeyogerako emirembe. Omuntu k’asabe nga bw’ayagala okuwonyezebwa n’emirembe, k’asabe Omusawo ow’amazima, k’akikole mu kkubo ettuufu, k’akkakkanye omutima gwe mu bisuubizo by’endagaano; naye emirembe bwe gyogerwa, bwe gitagenda wamu n’okukyawa n’okwetamwa ekibi ekyo ekyali ekiwundu era ekyaleeta okutabuka, gino si mirembe Katonda gy’atonze, wabula gye twegulidde ffekka. Kuba kubikka busibi lususu ku kiwundu, ng’amasira gakyali wansi, agajja okuvunda, n’okwonooneka, n’okulya, okutuusa lwe gaddamu okubutuka n’okuwunya, n’okutawaanya, n’akabi. Emmeeme ennaku ezitambulira mu kkubo nga lino, ezisinga okuwulira obuzibu bw’ekibi okusinga obucaafu bw’obugwagwa obugenda nakyo; ezisaba okusaasirwa, weewaawo, ezisaba Mukama mu Kristo okusaasirwa, naye ne zikyakuuma akatole akawoomu ak’ekibi kyazo wansi w’olulimi; — njogera, ziremenga okulowooza nti zirifuna emirembe egy’amazima era aganywevu. Ng’ekyokulabirako, osanga omutima gwo nga gudduka okugoberera ensi, era ekyo nga kikutabula mu kussa ekimu ne Katonda; Omwoyo n’akugamba lwatu, — “omuntu yenna ayagala ensi taliimu kwagala kwa Kitaffe.” Kino ne kikuleetera okukolagana ne Katonda mu Kristo olw’okuwonya emmeeme yo, n’okukkakkanya omuntu wo ow’omunda; naye ate, okukyawa okujjuvu ekibi kyennyini tekubeera ku ggwe; weewaawo, oboolyawo kikyakusanyusa ddala, wabula olw’ebivaamu byakyo byokka. Oboolyawo oyinza okulokolebwa, naye ng’oyita mu muliro, era Katonda alina omulimu gw’alikola naawe nga tannamaliriza; naye ojja kuba n’emirembe mitono mu bulamu buno, — ojja kuba mulwadde era ng’ozirika ennaku zo zonna, (Isaaya 57:17). Buno bulimba obuli ku kikolo ky’emirembe gy’abeeyita abakkiriza bangi, era bugimalawo. Bakola n’amaanyi gaabwe gonna ku kusaasirwa n’okusonyiyibwa, era balabika ng’abassa ekimu ennyo ne Katonda mu kukola ekyo; bagwa wansi mu maaso ge, bakaabira ebibi byabwe n’obusirusiru bwabwe, buli muntu n’alowooza, weewaawo, nabo bennyini ne balowooza, nti mazima kaakano bo n’ebibi byabwe baawukanye; bwe batyo ne bafuna okusaasirwa okumatiza emitima gyabwe okumala akaseera katono. Naye okunoonyereza okujjuvu bwe kukolebwa, wabaddewo ekyama kye bakyekuumidde ku busirusiru oba obusirusiru bwe baabadde bakolako, — oba waakiri, tewabaddewo kwetamwa kwennyini okwetaagisa; era emirembe gyabwe gyonna mangu ddala ne gizuulibwa nga minafu era mivundu, nga kumpi tegisukka bbanga ebigambo by’okugisaba lye bimala mu kamwa kaabwe.

2. Abantu bwe beepimira emirembe ku nkomerero okumatizibwa kwabwe n’amagezi gaabwe ag’obuzaaliranwa kwe bibatwala, gino mirembe gya bulimba, era tegijja kubeerera. Ka nnyinnyonnyoleko katono kye ntegeeza. Omuntu afunye ekiwundu olw’ekibi; alina okumatizibwa ku kibi ekimu mu muntu we ow’omunda; tatambulidde mu bugolokofu nga bwe kisaanira enjiri; byonna si birungi era tebiri mu nteeko wakati wa Katonda n’emmeeme ye. Kaakano alowooza ekirina okukolebwa. Ekitangaala alina, era amanyi ekkubo ly’alina okukwata, n’engeri emmeeme ye gye yawonyezebwamu edda. Bw’alowooza nti ebisuubizo bya Katonda bye bikozesebwa eby’okungulu eby’okuwonya amabwa ge n’okukkakkanya omutima gwe, agenda gye biri, abinoonyereza, n’azuula ekimu oba okusingawo ku byo ebigambo byabyo ebyennyini bye bituukana butereevu n’embeera ye. Ne yeegamba nti, “Katonda ayogera mu kisuubizo kino; wano nja kwetwalira eddagala eriweza obuwanvu n’obugazi bw’ekiwundu kyange;” bw’atyo n’atwala ekigambo ky’ekisuubizo n’akiteeka ku mbeera ye, n’atuula mu mirembe. Kino kirala ekirabikira ku lusozi; Mukama ali kumpi, naye Mukama taliimu. Tegubadde mulimu gwa Mwoyo, oyo yekka ayinza “okutulumiriza olw’ekibi, n’olw’obutuukirivu n’olw’omusango,” wabula kukola kwokka kw’emmeeme ey’amagezi n’okutegeera. Nga bwe wabaawo engeri ssatu ez’obulamu, bwe tugamba, — obw’okukula, obw’okuwulira, n’obw’amagezi oba okutegeera, — ebintu ebimu birina obw’okukula bwokka; ebirala ne obw’okuwulira, era obwo buzingiramu obwasooka; ebirala birina obw’amagezi, obutwala era obusinziira ku bwombi obulala. Kale, oyo alina obw’amagezi takola kyokka ng’omusingi ogwo bwe gugwanira, wabula ne ng’emisingi emirala gyombi bwe giri, — akula era awulira. Bwe kiri ne ku bantu mu bintu bya Katonda. Abamu bantu ba buzaaliranwa era ab’amagezi bokka; abalala baweereddwa okwongerwako okumatizibwa awamu n’okumulisibwa; ate abalala bazaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri ddala. Kale, oyo alina ekisembayo alina n’ebyasooka byombi; noolwekyo oluusi akola ng’emisingi gy’omuntu ow’amagezi bwe giri, oluusi ng’emisingi gy’omuntu eyamulisibwa bwe giri. Obulamu bwe obw’omwoyo obw’amazima si gwe musingi gw’ebikolwa bye byonna; tabeera bulijjo ng’akola mu maanyi gaabwo, so n’ebibala bye byonna tebiva ku kikolo ekyo. Mu mbeera eno gye njogerako, akola ku musingi gw’okumatizibwa n’okumulisibwa kwokka, okugulumiza obutonde bwe obwasooka; naye Omwoyo tafuuwa n’akatono ku mazzi ago gonna. Twale ekyokulabirako: Teebereza nti ekiwundu n’okutabuka kw’emmeeme biva ku kuddira ekibi, — ekyo, ka kibe ekibi oba obusirusiru bwonna, wadde nga mu bunene bwakyo kitono nnyo, kyokka tewali biwundu bisinga buziba ku ebyo emmeeme by’efuna ku nsonga eyo, wadde okutabuka okusinga obunene; — mu kweraliikirira kw’ebirowoozo bye, azuula ekisuubizo kiri, (Isaaya 55:7), “anaamusaasira, adde eri Katonda waffe kubanga anaamusonyiyira ddala,” — aliyongera okusonyiwa, alikikola emirundi n’emirundi; oba kiri mu (Koseya 14:4), “Ndibalekesaayo empisa zaabwe embi, ne mbaagala awatali kye mbasalidde kya kusasula.” Kino omuntu akirowoozaako, n’olwekyo ne yeesalirawo emirembe; ka kibe nti Omwoyo wa Katonda akiteeka ku ye oba nedda, ka kibe nti Omwoyo awa obulamu n’amaanyi eri ebigambo ebyawandiikibwa oba nedda, ekyo tafaayo. Tawuliriza oba Katonda Mukama ayogera emirembe. Talindirira Katonda, oyo oboolyawo akyakweka amaaso ge, era alaba ekitonde ekyo ekinaku nga kibba emirembe ne kiddukira nagyo, ng’amanyi nti ekiseera kijja kutuuka lw’aliddamu okukolagana naye, n’amuyita okubalirira omulundi omulala; lw’alitegeera nti tekigasa kutambula na kigere kimu Katonda gy’atamukwata ku mukono.

Wano, mazima, ndaba ebibuuzo ebirala bingi nga bigolokoka ku kino ne byeyingiza. Siyinza kubyogerako byonna: ekimu nja kukyogerako katono.

Kale kiyinza okugambibwa nti, “Okuva kino bwe kirabika nga lye kkubo Omwoyo Omutukuvu ly’atukulemberamu olw’okuwonya ebiwundu byaffe n’okukkakkanya emitima gyaffe, tunaamanya tutya nga tutambula ffekka, era nga n’Omwoyo atuwerekera?”

Okuddamu. (1.) Omuntu yenna mu mmwe bw’aba nga yakyama ku nsonga eno, Katonda ajja kukumanyisa mangu; kubanga ng’oggyeko nti mulina ekisuubizo kye nti “Abawombeefu abaluŋŋamya mu kkubo ettuufu n’abayigiriza ekkubo lye,” (Zabbuli 25:9), tajja kubaleka kukyama bulijjo. Njogera nti tajja kukkiriza bwereere bwammwe kubikkibwa bikoola bya mutiini, naye alibiggyawo n’emirembe gyonna gye mulina mu byo, era tajja kubaleka kutereera ku nsenke ng’ezo. Mujja kumanya mangu nti ekiwundu kyammwe tekiwonye; kwe kugamba, mujja kumanya mangu oba nga bwe kiri bwe kityo gye muli olw’ebirivaamu. Emirembe gye mufuna bwe mutyo tegijja kubeerera. Ebirowoozo bwe biba nga biwanguddwa okumatizibwa kwabyo, tewabaawo we okutabuka kuyinza kukwata. Linda katono, n’ensonga zino zonna zijja kunnyogoga ne ziggwaawo mu maaso g’okukemebwa okusooka okujja. Naye, —

(2.) Enkola eno etera okukwatibwa awatali kulindirira; ate ekyo kye kisa, era kwe kukola kw’okukkiriza okw’enjawulo Katonda kw’ayagala kukozesebwe mu mbeera eyo. Mmanyi nti Katonda oluusi ajja ku mmeeme amangu ddala, mu kaseera katono, ng’ewundibwa era ng’ewonyezebwa, — nga bwe nkakasa nti bwe kyali ku Dawudi, bwe yasala ku kirenge ky’ekyambalo kya Sawulo; naye ebiseera ebisinga, mu mbeera ng’eyo, Katonda ayagala tulindirire era tufube, nga tutunuulira ng’amaaso g’omuddu bwe gatunuulira mukama we. Nnabbi Isaaya agamba, essuula 8:17, “nnaalindirira Mukama Katonda akwese amaaso ge okuva ku nnyumba ya Yakobo.” Katonda ayagala abaana be bagalamire akaseera ku mulyango gwe nga bamaze okudduka mu nnyumba ye, so si kumufubutukirako mangu; okuggyako ng’abakutte ku mukono n’abasikira munda, nga bakwatiddwa ensonyi nnyingi ne batayaŋŋanga kujja gy’ali. Kale, abeewonya bokka, oba abantu abeeyogerera emirembe bokka, batera okwanguyiriza; tebaagala kulinda; tebawuliriza Katonda ky’ayogera, wabula beeyongera bweyongezi okugenda okuwonyezebwa.

(3.) Enkola ng’eyo, wadde eyinza okukkakkanya omuntu ow’omunda n’ebirowoozo, ekitundu ky’emmeeme eky’amagezi ekisalawo, kyokka tewoomya mutima na kiwummulo na kumatira okw’ekisa. Eky’okuddamu ky’efuna kifaanana nnyo ekyo Erisa kye yaddamu Naamani, “Genda mirembe;” kyakkakkanya ebirowoozo bye, naye mbuusabuusa nnyo oba kyawoomya omutima gwe, oba kyamuwa essanyu lyonna mu kukkiriza, okuggyako essanyu ery’obutonde eryamukwata mu kiseera ekyo olw’okuwona kwe. “Ebigambo bye tebiba birungi eri abo abakola obulungi?” bw’ayogera Mukama, (Mikka 2:7). Katonda bw’ayogera, mu bigambo bye temuli mazima gokka agayinza okuddamu okumatizibwa kw’amagezi gaffe, naye era bikola obulungi; bireeta ekiwoomu, ekirungi, era ekyegombebwa eri okwagala n’emyoyo; olw’ebyo “emmeeme eddayo mu kiwummulo kyayo,” (Zabbuli 116:7).

(4.) Ekisinga obubi, tekirongoosa bulamu, tekiwonya kibi, tekiwonya ndwadde. Katonda bw’ayogera emirembe, aluŋŋamya era akuuma emmeeme “tebaddayo mu byonoono byabwe.” Bwe tugyogera ffekka, omutima tegugibwa ku kibi; nedda, lye kkubo erisinga obwangu mu nsi okutwala emmeeme mu muze gw’okuddira ekibi. Bw’oba, oluvannyuma lw’okwesiiga eddagala ggwe kennyini, weesanga ng’ozzeemu amaanyi okuddayo mu lutalo okusinga okulwawukanako ddala, kyeyoleka lwatu nti obadde ng’okolagana n’emmeeme yo yokka, naye Yesu Kristo n’Omwoyo we tebaabaddeyo. Weewaawo, era emirundi mingi obutonde bwe bumala okukola omulimu gwabwo, ennaku ntono nga tezinnayitawo, bujja okusaba empeera yaabwo; era, nga bwe bubadde bukozi mu mulimu gw’okuwonya, bujja kuba bweteefuteefu okuwolereza okuwundibwa okuggya. Katonda bw’ayogera emirembe, wajja ekiwoomu kingi bwe kityo, n’okubikkulirwa kw’okwagala kwe, ekiba omusingo ogw’amaanyi ku mmeeme obutaddamu kukola bya bukyamu.

3. Tweyogerera emirembe ffekka bwe tugyogera mu bwangu nga tetufuddeyo. Kino nnabbi akyemulugunyaako ku bayigiriza abamu: (Yeremiya 6:14), “Ekiwundu ky’abantu bange bakijjanjaba ng’ekitali ky’amaanyi.” Era bwe kiri ne ku bantu abamu: okuwonya ebiwundu byabwe bakufuula mulimu mwangu; okutunula, okulingiza okukkiriza okw’akaseera ku bisuubizo kwe kukikola, era ensonga n’eggwa. Omutume atugamba nti “ekigambo tekyagasa” abamu, kubanga “tekyagattibwa na kukkiriza,” (Abaebbulaniya 4:2), — μὴ συγκεκραμένος· “tekyatabulwa bulungi” era ne kigattibwa n’okukkiriza. Si kutunula butunuzi ku kigambo ky’okusaasira mu kisuubizo, wabula kirina okugattibwa n’okukkiriza okutuusa lwe kifuuka ekimu n’obutonde bwennyini obw’emmeeme; olwo, mazima, kikola obulungi eri emmeeme. Bw’oba wabadde n’ekiwundu ku muntu wo ow’omunda, ekyagenda n’obunafu n’obutaba na kiwummulo, kaakano ky’owonye, wakikola otya? “Natunuulira ebisuubizo by’okusonyiyibwa n’okuwonyezebwa, bwe ntyo ne nfuna emirembe.” Weewaawo, naye oboolyawo wayanguyiriza nnyo, wakikola mu bwangu, tewaliisa ku kisuubizo n’okigatta n’okukkiriza, amaanyi gaakyo gonna ne gasaasaana mu mmeeme yo; wakikola bukozi mu bwangu nga tofuddeyo. Ojja kusanga ekiwundu kyo, nga tekinnaba kuwangaala, nga kiddamu okubutuka; era olimanya nti towonye.

4. Buli eyeeyogerera emirembe ku nsonga emu yokka, ate mu kiseera kye kimu ng’alina ekibi ekirala ekitali kitono mu bukulu ekimuli ku mwoyo, ky’atakolaganyeeko na Katonda, omuntu oyo ayogera nti “Mirembe” so nga tewali mirembe. Ka nnyinnyonnyole katono kye ntegeeza: Omuntu alagajjalidde omulimu gwe ogw’obuvunaanyizibwa emirundi n’emirundi, oboolyawo, nga mu butuukirivu bwonna gwali gumugwanidde; omuntu we ow’omunda asobeddwa, emmeeme ye ewundiddwa, talina mirembe mu magumba ge olw’ekibi kye; anoonya okuwonyezebwa, n’afuna emirembe. Kyokka, mu kiseera ekyo, oboolyawo, okwagala ensi, oba amalala, oba obusirusiru obulala, Omwoyo wa Katonda bw’anakuwalira ennyo, biyinza okuba mu kifuba ky’omuntu oyo, ne bitamutabula wadde ye okubitabula. Omuntu oyo aleme kulowooza nti ku mirembe gye kuliko egiva eri Katonda. Abantu lwe balibeera obulungi, lwe balissa ekitiibwa kye kimu ku biragiro bya Katonda byonna. Katonda alituwa obutuukirivu nga atuggya mu bibi byaffe, naye talikkiriza kibi na kimu ekisinga obutono okubeera mu ffe nga kituukirivu: “Amaaso ge gajjudde obulongoofu tegatunula ku kibi.”

5. Abantu bwe beeyogerera bokka emirembe eri emyoyo gyabwe, kitono nnyo Katonda okwogera okwetoowaza eri emmeeme zaabwe. Emirembe gya Katonda mirembe egitoowaza, emirembe egisaanuusa, nga bwe kyali ku Dawudi; teyetoowaza nnyo nga bwe yali Nasani bwe yamuleetera amawulire g’okusonyiyibwa kwe.

Naye mujja kugamba nti, “Tuyinza ddi okutwala okubudaabudibwa kw’ekisuubizo ng’okwaffe, ku kiwundu ekimu eky’enjawulo, okukkakkanya omutima?”

Okusooka, Okutwalira awamu, Katonda bw’akyogera, k’abe ddi, mangu oba oluvannyuma. Nabagamba edda nti ayinza okukikola mu kaseera kennyini ak’ekibi, era n’amaanyi agatayinza kuziyizibwa emmeeme ne yeetaaga okukkiriza ky’ayagala mu kyo; oluusi alituleetera okulinda ebbanga eriwanvu: naye bw’ayogera, k’abe mangu oba oluvannyuma, ka tube nga tukola ekibi oba nga twenenya, embeera y’emmeeme zaffe k’ebe nga bw’eri, Katonda bw’ayogera, alina okukkirizibwa. Tewali kintu, mu kussa ekimu naye, Mukama ky’asinga okututawaanyizibwako, bwe nnyinza okwogera bwe ntyo, okusinga okutya kwaffe okw’obutakkiriza, okutulemesa okufuna okubudaabudibwa okw’amaanyi bw’atyo bw’ayagala ennyo okutuwa.

Naye mujja kugamba nti, “Tukyali we twali. Katonda bw’akyogera, tulina okukikkiriza, ekyo kituufu; naye tunaamanya tutya nga ayogera?”

(1.) Nandyagadde ffenna tutuuke ku kino mu bikolwa, okukkiriza emirembe bwe tukakasa nti Katonda ye agyogera, era nti buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe okugikkiriza. Naye, —

(2.) Waliwo, bwe nnyinza okwogera bwe ntyo, okutegeera okw’ekyama mu kukkiriza, okumanyisa okukkiriza eddoboozi lya Kristo bw’ayogera ddala; ng’omwana bwe yabuuka mu lubuto omukazi Embeerera eyaweebwa omukisa bwe yajja eri Erisabeesi, okukkiriza kubuuka mu mutima Kristo bw’asembera ddala gye kuli. “Endiga zange zitegeera eddoboozi lyange,” bw’agamba Kristo, (Yokaana 10:4); — “zitegeera eddoboozi lyange; zimanyidde okuwulira kwalyo;” era zimanya nga emimwa gye gibikkuliddwa gye zili era nga gijjudde ekisa. Omugole yali mu mbeera ey’ennaku, (Oluyimba 5:2), — nga yeebase mu kwekakasa; naye amangu ddala nga Kristo ayogedde, akaaba nti, “Lino lye ddoboozi lya muganzi wange ayogera!” Yali amanyi eddoboozi lye, era yali amanyidde nnyo okussa ekimu naye, n’amutegeerera amangu ago; era nammwe bwe mutyo bwe mulikola. Bwe mweyigiriza okumumanya n’okussa ekimu naye, mujja kwawula mangu wakati w’eddoboozi lye n’eddoboozi ly’omugenyi. Era mutwale κριτήριον eno: Bw’ayogera, ayogera nga tewali muntu yali ayogedde bw’atyo; ayogera n’amaanyi, era mu ngeri emu oba endala ajja kuleetera “emitima gyammwe okubuguumirira,” nga bwe yakola abayigirizwa, (Lukka 24). Akikola “ng’ayingiza omukono gwe mu kituli ky’oluggi,” (Oluyimba 5:4), — Omwoyo we mu mitima gyammwe okubakwata.

Oyo alina amagezi ge agayigiriziddwa okwawula ekirungi n’ekibi, ng’ayongedde okutegeera n’obumanyirivu olw’okwetegereza buli kiseera amakubo Kristo mw’akolaganira naffe, engeri Omwoyo gy’akolamu, n’ebivaamu by’atera okuleeta, ye mulamuzi asinga obulungi ku lulwe mu nsonga eno.

Okubiri, Ekigambo kya Mukama bwe kikola obulungi eri emmeeme zammwe, ye akyogera; bwe kitoowaza, bwe kirongoosa, era ne kigasa ku bigendererwa ebyo ebisuubizo kwe biweebwa, — kwe kugamba, okwagazisa, okulongoosa, okusaanuusa n’okusiba ku buwulize, ku kwemalamu ffekka, n’ebirala. Naye kino si gwe mulimu gwange; era sijja kweyongera kuwugulibwa mu kugoberera obulagirizi buno. Awatali kubwegendereza, ekibi kijja kuba n’omukisa munene okukakanyaza omutima.

fields.title: Kozesa okukkiriza ku Kristo okutta ekibi kyo
fields.body_html:
Enkozesa ey’awamu ey’ebiragiro ebyasoose — Ekiragiro ekikulu eky’okutuukiriza omulimu oguluubirirwa: Kozesa okukkiriza ku Kristo — Engeri ez’enjawulo ez’okukikolamu — Okulowooza ku kujjula okuli mu Kristo okututaasa — Okusuubira ebinene okuva eri Kristo — Ensibuko y’okusuubira okwo: okusaasira kwe, obwesigwa bwe — Ebiva mu kusuubira okwo; ku ludda lwa Kristo; ku ludda lw’abakkiriza — Okukkiriza kusaanye okukozesebwa ennyo ku kufa kwa Kristo (Abaruumi 6:3-6) — Omulimu gw’Omwoyo mu nsonga eno yonna.

Kale, ebintu bye mbadde nkkaatiriza okutuusa kaakano bisinga kuba bya kuteekateeka mulimu oguluubirirwa okusinga okuba ebyo ebigutuukiriza. Kye mbadde nduubirira okutuusa kaakano kwe kuteekateeka omutima nga bwe kigwanira olw’omulimu gwennyini, kubanga awatali ekyo omulimu tegujja kutuukirira.

Ebiragiro eby’omulimu gwennyini bitono nnyo; ntegeeza ebyo ebigwanira omulimu ogwo gwokka. Era bye bino wammanga:—

1. Kozesa okukkiriza ku Kristo olw’okutta ekibi kyo. Omusaayi gwe lye ddagala eddene erisinga obulungi eri emyoyo egirwadde ekibi. Beera mu kino, era olifa ng’omuwanguzi; weewaawo, olw’okulabirira kwa Katonda okulungi, oliba mulamu n’olaba okwegomba kwo nga kufudde nga kugudde ku bigere byo.

Naye oligamba nti, “Okukkiriza kunaakola kutya ku Kristo olw’ekigendererwa kino?” Nziramu nti, Mu ngeri nnyingi:—

(1.) Olw’okukkiriza jjuza emmeeme yo okulowooza nga bwe kigwanira ku bintu ebyaterekebwa mu Yesu Kristo olw’ekigendererwa kino, okwegomba kwo kwonna, n’okwegomba kuno kwennyini okukusibye, kulyoke kuttibwe. Olw’okukkiriza fumiitiriza ku kino: wadde nga mu ggwe wennyini oba ku bubwo toyinza n’akatono kuwangula bulwadde bwo, wadde nga okooye n’okulwana, era ng’oli kumpi okuzirika ddala, naye mu Yesu Kristo mulimu ebimala okukutaasa (Abafiripi 4:13). Omwana omujaajaamya bwe yali kumpi okuzirika, kyamugumya nti mu nnyumba ya kitaawe mwalimu emmere emala; wadde nga yali wala nayo, naye kyamuwummuza era kyamunyweza nti eyo gye yali. Mu buyinike bwo n’obulumi bwo obusinga obunene, lowooza ku kujjula okwo okw’ekisa, obugagga obwo, n’amawanika ago ag’amaanyi, obuyinza n’obuyambi, ebyaterekebwa mu ye okutuwanirira (Yokaana 1:16; Abakkolosaayi 1:19). Leka bijje mu birowoozo byo era bibeere omwo. Lowooza nti Katonda “n’amugulumiza okubeera Omulangira era Omulokozi, … okuwa Isirayiri omukisa ogw’okwenenya” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 5:31); era obanga okuwa okwenenya, n’okuwa okutta ekibi, awatali ekyo okwenenya tekubaawo era tekuyinza kubaawo. Kristo atugamba nti ekisa ekirongoosa tukifuna nga tubeera mu ye (Yokaana 15:3). Okukozesa okukkiriza ku kujjula okuli mu Kristo tufune bye twetaaga, y’engeri ey’enkukunala ey’okubeera mu Kristo, kubanga okusimbibwa kwaffe mu ye n’okubeera kwaffe mu ye byombi biri lwa kukkiriza (Abaruumi 11:19, 20). Kale emmeeme yo, olw’okukkiriza, ekolenga n’ebirowoozo n’entegeera nga zino: “Ndi kitonde kyavu era kinafu; sinywevu ng’amazzi, siyinza kusukkuluma. Obubi buno bunsinze amaanyi, era buli kumpi nnyo okuzikiriza emmeeme yange; era kye nnaakola sikimanyi. Emmeeme yange efuuse ng’ensi eyakala, era ng’ekifo ebibe we byagalamiranga. Nnasuubiza ne mmenya obusuubizi; obweyamo n’endagaano byafuuka ng’ekintu ekitaliimu. Emirundi mingi nnalowooza nti nnali mpangudde era nti nnaali wa kununulwa, naye nnalimbibwa; n’okulaba ndaba lwatu nti, awatali buyambi n’obuwagizi obw’enkukunala, mbuze, era ndisendebwasendebwa ne ndekeraawo ddala Katonda. Naye wadde nga bwe ntyo bwe ndi, emikono egikooye giyimusibwe, n’amaviivi agajugumira ganywezebwe. Laba, Mukama Kristo, alina okujjula kwonna okw’ekisa mu mutima gwe n’okujjula kwonna okw’amaanyi mu mukono gwe, ayinza okutta abalabe be bano bonna. Mu ye mulimu ebimala okuntaasa n’okunnyamba. Ayinza okutwala emmeeme yange ewotose era efa, n’ampanguza n’okukirawo. ‘Lwaki ogamba, ggwe emmeeme yange, nti Mukama tamanyi mitawaana gye mpitamu, era tafaayo nga tuggyibwako eddembe lyaffe ery’obwebange? Tonnamanya? Tonnawulira? Mukama, ye Katonda ataliggwaawo. Omutonzi w’enkomerero y’ensi. Tazirika so takoowa era n’amagezi ge tewali n’omu ayinza kugapima. Awa amaanyi abazirika, n’oyo atalina buyinza amwongerako amaanyi. Abavubuka bazirika, bakoowa, n’abalenzi bagwira ddala. Naye abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe, balitumbiira n’ebiwaawaatiro ng’empungu; balidduka mbiro ne batakoowa, balitambula naye ne batazirika,’ (Isaaya 40:27-31). Ayinza okufuula ‘omusenyu ogwokya’ ogw’emmeeme yange ‘ekidiba’, n’omutima gwange ogulumwa ennyonta era omugumba gufuuke ng’ensi ‘etiiriika ensulo ez’amazzi;’ weewaawo, ayinza okufuula ‘ebibe we byagalamiranga,’ omutima guno ogujjudde okwegomba okw’omuzizo n’okukemebwa okwaka ng’omuliro, okuba ekifo ‘walimera omuddo’ n’ebibala ebibye,” (Isaaya 35:7). Bw’atyo Katonda bwe yanyweza Pawulo mu kukemebwa kwe, ng’amulaga nti ekisa kye kimala: “Ekisa kyange kikumala” (2 Abakkolinso 12:9). Wadde nga teyakifunirawo mangu ekyo okumuggyako okukemebwa kwe, naye okumanya nti mu Katonda ekisa ekyo kimala olw’ekigendererwa ekyo kyali kimala okunyweza omwoyo gwe. Kale nzigamba nti, olw’okukkiriza, wefumiitirizenga nnyo ku bintu ebyo n’okujjula kwabyo ebiri mu Yesu Kristo, era nga bw’ayinza buli kiseera okukuwa amaanyi n’okukununula. Kaakano, ne bw’otoofune buwanguzi mu ngeri eyo, oliyimirira nga onywevu mu ggaali, n’otodduka mu lutalo okutuusa olutalo lw’aliggwa; olikuumibwa obutaggwaamu ddala ssuubi, n’obutagalamira wansi w’obutakkiriza bwo, oba okukyama okunoonya engeri n’eddagala ery’obulimba, ebitajja kukutaasa ku nkomerero. Amaanyi g’okulowooza kuno galabikira mu kukukola kwokka.

(2.) Yimusa omutima gwo olw’okukkiriza okusuubira okutaasibwa okuva eri Kristo. Okutaasibwa okuva eri Kristo mu nsonga eno kuli ng’okwolesebwa kwa nnabbi (Kaabakuuku 2:3), “Kubanga okwolesebwa okwo kujja mu kiseera kyakwo ekigere. Kwogera ku by’enkomerero ate si kwa bulimba. Bwe kunaaba ng’okuluddewo, mukulindirire, kujja kutuukirira, tekugya kulwa.” Wadde nga kiyinza okukulabikira ng’ekiruddewo ennyo, ng’oli mu buzibu bwo n’okutabulwa kwo, naye ddala kirijja mu kiseera Mukama Yesu kye yateekawo, nga kye kiseera ekisinga obulungi. Kale, bw’onooyinza okuyimusa omutima gwo okusuubira nga tonyeenya okutaasibwa okuva eri Yesu Kristo, — amaaso go bwe ganaatunuuliranga gy’ali “amaaso g’abaddu nga bwe gatunuulira omukono gwa mukama waabwe,” bwe basuubira okubaako kye bafuna okuva gy’ali, — emmeeme yo erimatira, ddala alikununula; alitta okwegomba okwo, era enkomerero yo eriba ya mirembe. Naye kyokka kinoonyenga mu mukono gwe; suubiranga ddi era mu ngeri ki gy’alikikolamu. “Bwe mutalinywerera mu kukkiriza kwammwe, ddala temuliyimirira n’akatono.”

Naye oligamba nti, “Nsibuko ki gye nnina okuzimbako okusuubira okwo, nsuubire nga sijja kulimbibwa?”

Nga bw’olina obwetaavu obukusindika ku kkubo lino, oteekwa okutaasibwa n’okulokolebwa mu ngeri eno oba tewali ngeri yonna. Onoogenda eri ani? Bwe kityo mu Mukama Yesu mulimu ebintu bingi ebitabalika ebikuzzaamu amaanyi era ebikusika eri okusuubira kuno.

Ku bwetaavu bwakyo, nnakyogerako katono emabegako, bwe nnalaga nti guno mulimu gwa kukkiriza era gwa bakkiriza bokka. Kristo agamba nti, “awatali Nze temuliiko kye muyinza kukola” (Yokaana 15:5); ng’ayogera nnyo ku kulongoosa omutima okuggyamu ekibi (olunyiriri 2). Okutta ekibi kyonna kuteekwa okubaawo olw’ekisa ekituweebwa. Ffe ku bwaffe tetuyinza kukikola. Kale, “Katonda yasiima okutuukiriza byonna mu ye” (Abakkolosaayi 1:19); nti “ku kujjula kwe ffenna kwe twagabana ekisa ekisukiridde ekisa” (Yokaana 1:16). Ye mutwe omuntu omuggya mw’ateekwa okuggya amaanyi n’obulamu, oba si ekyo anafuwa buli lunaku. Obanga ‘tunywezebwa mu muntu waffe ow’omunda’, kiri lwa ‘Kristo okubeera mu mitima gyaffe olw’okukkiriza’ (Abaefeso 3:16, 17). Era nnalaga dda nti omulimu guno tegukolebwa awatali Mwoyo. Kale, Omwoyo tumusuubira kuva wa? Tumunoonya okuva eri ani? Ani yatusuubiza Omwoyo, ng’amaze okumutufunira? Okusuubira kwaffe kwonna mu nsonga eno tekusaanidde kuba ku Kristo yekka? Kale kino kinywerere ku mutima gwo: bw’otoofune kutaasibwa okuva gy’ali, toliyinza kukufuna n’akatono. Engeri zonna, okufuba n’okulwana kwonna ebitaliiko bulamu obuva mu kusuubira kuno okutaasibwa okuva eri Kristo yekka, tebiriiko kye bigasa, tebijja kukuyamba; weewaawo, bwe biba si bya kuwanirira mutima gwo mu kusuubira kuno, oba engeri ze yennyini yateekawo ez’okufuna obuyambi okuva gy’ali, bya bwereere.

Kaakano, okukusika ennyo eri okusuubira kuno, —

(1.) Lowooza ku kusaasira kwe, obuteefu bwe n’ekisa kye, nga ye Kabona waffe Asinga Obukulu ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda. Ddala akusaasira mu buyinike bwo; agamba nti, “Ng’omwana bw’asanyusibwa nnyina, bwe ntyo bwe ndikuzzaamu amaanyi” (Isaaya 66:13). Alina omutima omugonvu ng’ogwa maama eri omwana ayonka. (Abaebbulaniya 2:17, 18), “Kyekyava kimugwanira mu byonna okufaananyizibwa baganda be, alyoke abeerenga Kabona Asinga Obukulu asaasira era omwesigwa mu kuweereza Katonda. Ekyo yakikola alyoke atangirire ebibi by’abantu. Yabonaabona, ye yennyini ng’akemebwa, alyoke ayambe abo abakemebwa.” Obusobozi bwa Kristo olw’okubonaabona kwe butulagibwa butya? “Yabonaabona, ye yennyini ng’akemebwa,” kyeyava ayinza. Okubonaabona n’okukemebwa kwa Kristo kwayongera ku busobozi bwe n’amaanyi ge? Nedda, awatali kubuusabuusa, bwe tukutunuulira ku bwakwo kwokka. Naye obusobozi obwogerwako wano bwe buli nga bugenderako okwetegeka, okwagala n’okweyagalira okwolesebwa; bwe busobozi obw’okwagala obuwangula buli ekiyinza okubuziyiza. Ayinza, ng’amaze okubonaabona n’okukemebwa, okuwangula buli ekimuziyiza, n’ataasa emyoyo egyavu egikemebwa: Δύναται βοηθῆσαι, — “Ayinza okuyamba.” Kino kyogera ku kivaamu; kubanga kaakano ayinza okukwatibwako okuyamba, ng’amaze okukemebwa bw’atyo. Bwe kityo ne mu (essuula 4:15, 16): “Tulina Kabona Asinga Obukulu alumirwa awamu naffe mu bunafu bwaffe, eyakemebwa mu byonna nga ffe, kyokka n’atakola kibi kyonna. Kale tusembererenga entebe ya Katonda ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa n’obuvumu, tufune okusaasirwa n’ekisa tubeerwe mu kwetaaga kwaffe.” Okubuulirira okw’omu lunyiriri 16 kwe kumu kwe ndiko, — kwe kugamba, nti tusuubirenga okutaasibwa okuva eri Kristo, omutume kw’ayita eyo χάριν εἰς εὔκαιρον βοήθειαν, “ekisa eky’obuyambi mu kiseera ekituufu.” Emmeeme egamba nti, “Obanga waaliwo obuyambi obujjira mu kiseera ekituufu, bwandibadde gye ndi mu mbeera yange eno. Kino kye nneegomba, — ekisa eky’obuyambi mu kiseera ekituufu. Ndi kumpi okufa, okuzikirira, okubula emirembe gyonna; obutali butuukirivu bujja kumpangula, obuyambi bwe butajja.” Omutume agamba nti, “Suubira obuyambi buno, okutaasibwa kuno, ekisa kino, okuva eri Kristo.” Weewaawo, naye ku nsonga ki? Eyo gy’ateekawo (olunyiriri 15). Era tuyinza okwetegereza nti ekigambo eky’omu lunyiriri 16, kye twavvuunula “okufuna,” kiri λαβωμεν. Ἵνα λάβωμεν ἔλεον, “Tulyoke tukiweebwe;” obuyambi obusaanidde era obujjira mu kiseera ekituufu bulijja. Njogera lwatu nti, ekintu kino kimu, eky’okunyweza emmeeme olw’okukkiriza mu kusuubira okutaasibwa okuva eri Yesu Kristo, olw’okusaasira kwe nga ye kabona waffe asinga obukulu, kirisinga okugasa mu kuzikiriza okwegomba kwo n’obulwadde bwo, era kirireeta ebivaamu ebirungi era eby’amangu, okusinga engeri zonna ez’okwebonyaabonya ezisinga obukakali abaana b’abantu ze baali beewaddeyo okukola. Weewaawo, ka nyongereko nti tewali mmeeme n’emu eyali ezikiridde oba erizikirira olw’amaanyi g’okwegomba kwonna, ekibi oba obubi, eyayinza okuyimusa emmeeme yaayo olw’okukkiriza okusuubira okutaasibwa okuva eri Yesu Kristo.

(2.) Lowooza ku bwesigwa bw’Oyo eyasuubiza; ekyo kiyinza okukuyimusa n’okukunyweza mu kulindirira kuno ng’osuubira okutaasibwa. Yasuubiza okutaasa mu mbeera ng’ezo, era alituukiriza ekigambo kye okutuuka ku nkomerero. Katonda atugamba nti endagaano ye naffe eri ng’“amateeka” ag’omu ggulu, enjuba, omwezi n’emmunyeenye, ebirina amakubo gaabyo amanyiddwa (Yeremiya 31:36). Kyeyava Dawudi agamba nti yalindirira okutaasibwa okuva eri Katonda “ng’abakuumi bwe balindirira obudde okukya,” — ekintu ekiteekwa okujja mu kiseera kyakyo ekyateekebwawo. Bwe kityo bwe kuliba okutaasibwa kwo okuva eri Kristo. Kulijja mu kiseera kyakwo, ng’omusulo n’enkuba ku nsi enkalu; kubanga mwesigwa oyo eyasuubiza. Ebisuubizo eby’enjawulo ebikwata ku nsonga eno tebibalika; emmeeme ebeerenga bulijjo n’ebimu ku byo, ebirabika okutuukirira ddala ku mbeera yaayo.

Kaakano, waliwo ebirungi bibiri eby’enkukunala ebigenda bulijjo n’okusuubira kuno okuyambibwa okuva eri Yesu Kristo:—

[1.] Kumusika okuyamba mu bujjuvu era mangu. Tewali kintu kisinga kusika mutima gw’omuntu okugasa n’okuyamba munne okusinga munne oyo okusuubira obuyambi okuva gy’ali, singa okusuubira okwo kuba kwa butuufu era nga kwazuukizibwa era kuwagirwa oyo agenda okuwa obuyambi. Mukama waffe Yesu yayimusa emitima gyaffe, olw’ekisa kye, okufaayo kwe n’ebisuubizo bye, eri okusuubira kuno; ddala okwerimbisa kwaffe mu kyo kuteekwa okuba ekintu ekinene ekimusika okutuyamba nga bwe kisaanidde. Kino omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli akituwa ng’ekigambo ekikakasibwa: “Ayi Mukama, abakunoonya tobaleka bokka.” Omutima bwe gumala okusikirizibwa okuwummulira mu Katonda, okwesigama ku ye, ddala aligumatiza. Taliba ng’amazzi agakalira; era tagambangako zzadde lya Yakobo nti, “Munoonyeze bwereere.” Kristo bw’alondebwa okuba omusingi gw’ebyo bye twetaaga, tajja kutuleka.

[2.] Kusika omutima okufaayo n’obunyiikivu ku makubo gonna n’engeri zonna Kristo mw’ayitira okwewa emmeeme; era bwe kityo kuyingizaamu obuyambi obwa ddala obw’ebisa byonna n’enkola zonna ze yateekawo. Asuubira ekintu kyonna okuva eri omuntu, yeewaayo eri amakubo n’engeri z’ayinza okukifunamu. Omusabirizi asuubira ebirabo agalamira ku mulyango gw’oyo gw’abisuubiramu oba mu kkubo lye. Ekkubo n’engeri Kristo mw’ayitira okwewa, bulijjo, ze nkola ze yateekawo; asuubira ekintu kyonna okuva gy’ali ateekwa okumulindiriranga omwo. Okusuubira kw’okukkiriza kwe kuteeka omutima ku mulimu. Si kusuubira kwa bugayaavu okutaliiko musingi kwe njogerako. Kaakano, obanga mu kusaba oba mu ssakalamentu mulimu amaanyi, obulamu n’obuyinza olw’ekigendererwa kino eky’okutta ekibi, ddala omuntu alibifunamu byonna olw’okusuubira kuno okutaasibwa okuva eri Kristo. Ku nsonga eno nzizza ebikolwa byonna eby’enjawulo, gamba okusaba, okufumiitiriza n’ebirala ebiringa ebyo, wansi w’omutwe guno; era siijja kubyogerako nnyo, bwe biba nga byazimbibwa ku musingi guno era nga biva mu kikolo kino. Bigasa nnyo nnyini olw’ekigendererwa kino, so si mu ngeri ndala.

Kaakano, ku kiragiro kino eky’okutta obulwadde obuwangula, oyinza okufuna obujulizi lukumi nti “probatum est” (kyagezesebwa). Baani abaali batambudde ne Katonda mu kukemebwa kuno abatalaba mugaso gwakyo n’obuwanguzi bwakyo? Neetaga okuleka emmeeme wansi w’ekiragiro kino, awatali kwongerako kirala. Naye ebintu ebimu ebikikwatako biyinza okwogerwako:—

Ekisooka, Kozesa okukkiriza ennyo ku kufa, omusaayi n’omusaalaba gwa Kristo; kwe kugamba, ku Kristo ng’eyakomererwa n’attibwa. Okutta ekibi kuva nnyo mu kufa kwa Kristo. Kye kimu ku bigendererwa eby’enjawulo, weewaawo, eby’enkukunala eby’okufa kwa Kristo, era ddala kirituukirizibwa olw’okufa okwo. Yafa azikirize ebikolwa bya Setaani. Buli kye twafuna mu buzaaliranwa bwaffe olw’okukema kwe okwasooka, buli ekifuna amaanyi mu ffe olw’ebyo by’atusiga buli lunaku, Kristo yafa okubizikiriza byonna. Ye oyo “eyeewaayo ku lwaffe, alyoke atununule mu bujeemu bwaffe bwonna, era yeerongooseza eggwanga ery’envuma, erinyiikirira ebikolwa ebirungi” (Tito 2:14). Kino kye yali aluubirira era kye yali agenderera (era tajja kulemwa) mu kwewaayo ku lwaffe. Okutusumulula okuva mu buyinza bw’ebibi byaffe, n’okutulongoosa okuva mu kwegomba kwaffe kwonna okutwonoona, kye yali ategese. “Kristo bwe yayagala Ekkanisa ne yeewaayo ku lwayo. Yaginaaza … n’agitukuza …, alyoke yeefunire Ekkanisa ey’ekitiibwa, eteriiko bbala wadde akamogo oba ekintu kyonna ekikyamu, wabula ebeere entukuvu, etuukiridde” (Abaefeso 5:25-27). Era kino, olw’amaanyi g’okufa kwe, kirituukirizibwa mu ddaala ez’enjawulo era ez’engeri nnyingi.
