Kyekiva okunaazibwa kwaffe, okulongoosebwa kwaffe n’okutukuzibwa kwaffe buli wamu kwogerwako ng’okuva mu musaayi gwe (1 Yokaana 1:7; Abaebbulaniya 1:3; Okubikkulirwa 1:5). Omusaayi ogwo bwe gumansirwa ku ffe, gusobola “okutukuza emyoyo gyaffe okuva mu bikolwa ebifu tulyoke tuweereze Katonda omulamu” (Abaebbulaniya 9:14). Kino kye tuluubirira, kino kye tugoberera, — emyoyo gyaffe gitukuzibwe okuva mu bikolwa ebifu, ebikolwa ebyo bisimbulwe, bizikirizibwe, era bireme kuddamu kufuna kifo mu ffe. Kino ddala kirituukirizibwa olw’okufa kwa Kristo; amaanyi gajja kuva omwo olw’ekigendererwa kino. Ddala, ebirabo byonna eby’Omwoyo, n’okugabibwa kwonna okw’ekisa n’amaanyi, biva awo; nga bwe nnalaga awalala. Bw’atyo omutume bw’akyanjula; mu (Abaruumi 6:2) mwe muli ensonga gye tulimu: “ffe abaafa eri ekibi tuyinza tutya okweyongera okukikola?” — “Twafa eri ekibi olw’okwatula eddiini; twafa eri ekibi olw’obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okuba bwe tutyo; twafa eri ekibi olw’okugabana ku maanyi n’obuyinza obw’okukitta; twafa eri ekibi olw’okwegatta ne Kristo n’okuba ab’omugabo mu ye, mu ye era ku bubwe ekibi mwe kittibwa: kale tuyinza tutya okubeera mu kyo?” Kino akikkaatiriza n’ensonga nnyingi, zonna nga ziggyibwa mu kufa kwa Kristo, mu nnyiriri eziddirira. Kino tekiteekeddwa kubaawo: (olunyiriri 3), “Oba temumanyi nga bonna bwe baabatizibwa mu Yesu Kristo, baafiira wamu naye?” Mu kubatizibwa tulina obukakafu obw’okusimbibwa kwaffe mu Kristo; tubatizibwa mu ye: naye kiki ekikye kye tubatizibwamu tukifunemu omugabo? “Okufa kwe,” bw’agamba. Obanga ddala twabatizibwa mu Kristo, era okusukka okwatula okw’ebweru, twabatizibwa mu kufa kwe. Okunnyonnyola kino, eky’omuntu okubatizibwa mu kufa kwa Kristo, omutume akutuwa mu (nnyiriri 4, 6): “Bwe twabatizibwa twaziikibwa wamu ne Kristo. Nga Kristo bwe yazuukizibwa okuva mu bafu olw’ekitiibwa kya Kitaawe, naffe twafuna obulamu obuggya, era bwe tutyo tutambulirenga mu bulamu obwo obuggya. Tumanyi kino nti omuntu waffe ow’edda yakomererwa wamu naye ku musaalaba, omubiri gw’ekibi guleme kuba gwa mugaso, tuleme kuddamu kuba baddu ba kibi.” “Kino,” bw’agamba, “kwe kubatizibwa kwaffe mu kufa kwa Kristo, kwe kugamba, okufaanana nakwo; okuba abafu eri ekibi, obubi bwaffe okuttibwa, nga ye bwe yattibwa olw’ekibi: bwe kityo nga ye bwe yazuukizibwa mu kitiibwa, naffe tulyoke tuzuukizibwe mu kisa ne mu bulamu obuggya.” Atugamba gye tufuna okubatizibwa kuno mu kufa kwa Kristo (olunyiriri 6); era kuno kuva mu kufa kwa Kristo kwennyini: “omuntu waffe ow’edda yakomererwa wamu naye ku musaalaba, omubiri gw’ekibi guleme kuba gwa mugaso;” συνεσταυρώθη, “yakomererwa wamu naye,” si mu ngeri ya biseera, wabula mu ngeri y’ekikireeta. Twakomererwa wamu naye olw’ebyo bye yatufunira, kubanga yatufunira Omwoyo okutta ekibi; olw’amaanyi agakola, kubanga okuva mu kufa kwe amaanyi gavaayo okutukomerera; ate mu ngeri ey’ekifaananyi n’ekyokulabirako ddala tulikomererwa eri ekibi, nga ye bwe yakomererwa olw’ekibi kyaffe. Kino omutume ky’ategeeza: Kristo, olw’okufa kwe, ng’azikiriza ebikolwa bya Setaani era ng’atufunira Omwoyo, yatta ekibi, ku bikwata ku kufuga kwakyo mu bakkiriza, ne kitatuuka ku kigendererwa kyakyo n’obufuzi bwakyo.

Eky’okubiri, Kale kozesa okukkiriza ku kufa kwa Kristo, mu ngeri zino ebbiri, — esooka, Ng’osuubira amaanyi; ey’okubiri, Ng’ofuba okufaanana naye. Ku esooka, ekiragiro ekyaweebwa okutwaliza awamu kiyinza okumala; ku ey’okubiri, ekigambo ky’omutume kiyinza okutuwa ekitangaala ku kiragiro kyaffe (Abaggalatiya 3:1). Okukkiriza kutunuulire Kristo mu njiri nga bw’alagibwa ng’afa era ng’akomererwa ku lwaffe. Mutunuulire ng’azitoowereddwa ebibi byaffe, ng’asaba, ng’avaamu omusaayi, ng’afa; muleete mu mbeera eyo mu mutima gwo olw’okukkiriza; teeka omusaayi gwe ogwo ogwayiika ku bubi bwo: kino kikolenga buli lunaku. Nnandiyinzizza okuwanvuya ennyo okulowooza kuno, mu bintu bingi eby’enjawulo, naye nteekwa okukomekkereza.

2. Kale nsigazza kwongerako bitundu bikulu byokka eby’omulimu gw’Omwoyo mu nsonga eno ey’okutta ekibi, ekyogerwako ennyo ng’omulimu gwe.

Mu kigambo kimu: Omulimu guno gwonna, gwe nnyinnyonnyodde ng’obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe, gukolebwa, gutambuzibwa era gutuukirizibwa olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo, mu bitundu byagwo byonna ne mu madaala gaagwo gonna; nga, —

(1.) Ye yekka alumiriza omutima mu ngeri etegeerekeka era mu bujjuvu ku bubi, omusango n’akabi k’obubi, okwegomba oba ekibi ekiteekwa okuttibwa. Awatali kulumirizibwa kuno, oba nga kunafu nnyo ne kiba nti omutima gusobola okukwemulugunyamu oba okukumira, tewajja kubaawo mulimu gukolebwa bulungi. Omutima ogutakkiriza (era ffenna tulina ogufaanana bwe gutyo mu kitundu) gujja kwewolereza n’ensonga yonna, okutuusa lwe guwangulwa okulumirizibwa okutegeerekeka era okweyolefu. Kale guno gwe mulimu gw’Omwoyo gwennyini: “Alirumiriza ensi olw’ekibi” (Yokaana 16:8); ye yekka ayinza okukikola. Singa okulowooza kw’abantu okw’amagezi, awamu n’okubuulira kw’ennukuta, byali biyinza okubalumiriza ku kibi, tuyinza, mpozzi, okulaba okulumirizibwa kungi okusinga kwe tulaba. Olw’okubuulira ekigambo, abantu bafuna mu ntegeera yaabwe okutegeera nti boonoonyi, nti bino na biri bibi, era nti bo bennyini bamusango ku byo; naye ekitangaala kino tekirina maanyi, era tekikwata ku misingi gy’emmeeme egy’ebikolwa, kufuula birowoozo n’okwagala okukkiriziganya nakyo, n’okuleeta ebivaamu ebisaanira okutegeera okwo. Era kyekiva kibaawo nti abantu abagezi era abategeevu, abatalina Mwoyo, tebalowooza nti ebintu ebyo bibi n’akatono, ebyo mwe muli okutambula n’okukola kw’okwegomba okusinga obukulu. Omwoyo yekka y’ayinza okukola, era y’akola, omulimu guno mu ngeri ey’omugaso. Era kino kye kintu ekisooka Omwoyo ky’akola okutuuka ku kutta okwegomba kwonna, — alumiriza emmeeme ku bubi bwonna bw’okwegomba okwo, amalawo okwewolereza kwakwo kwonna, abikkula obulimba bwakwo bwonna, aggala amakubo gaakwo gonna ag’okuwona, addamu ensonga z’okwekwasa kwakwo, aleetera emmeeme okukkiriza obuzizo bwakwo, n’okugalamira wansi ng’ewulira obuzito bwakwo. Kino bwe kitakolebwa, byonna ebiddirira bya bwereere.

(2.) Omwoyo yekka y’atubikkulira okujjula kwa Kristo olw’okututaasa; nga kuno kwe kulowooza okuziyiza omutima okugenda mu makubo ag’obulimba n’okuggwaamu essuubi (1 Abakkolinso 2:8).

(3.) Omwoyo yekka y’anyweza omutima mu kusuubira okutaasibwa okuva eri Kristo; nga lino lye ddagala eddene erisinga obulungi ery’okutta ekibi, nga bwe kyalagiddwa (2 Abakkolinso 1:21).

(4.) Omwoyo yekka y’aleeta omusaalaba gwa Kristo mu mitima gyaffe n’amaanyi gaagwo agatta ekibi; kubanga olw’Omwoyo tubatizibwa mu kufa kwa Kristo.

(5.) Omwoyo ye nsibuko era ye mutuukiriza w’okutukuzibwa kwaffe; atuwa ebirabo ebiggya n’amaanyi ag’ekisa olw’obutukuvu n’okutukuzibwa, ensibuko enkontanyi bw’enafuyizibwa era n’ekendeezebwa (Abaefeso 3:16-18).

(6.) Mu kwesembereza kwonna emmeeme kw’ekola eri Katonda mu mbeera eno, efuna okuwanirirwa okuva eri Omwoyo. Amaanyi, obulamu n’obunyiikivu bw’okusaba biva wa? Obuyinza bwakwo obw’okuwangula ewa Katonda buva wa? Si mu Mwoyo? Ye “Omwoyo ow’ekisa n’okwegayirira” eyasuubizibwa abo abalitunuulira oyo “gwe baafumita” (Zekkaliya 12:10), ng’abasobozesa okusaba “n’okusinda okutayogerekeka” (Abaruumi 8:26). Kino kikkirizibwa okuba ekkubo eddene okukkiriza mwe kuyitira okuwangula ewa Katonda. Bw’atyo Pawulo bwe yakola ku kukemebwa kwe, ne bwe kwali kutya: “nsaba Mukama amponye eriggwa eryo.” Omulimu gw’Omwoyo mu kusaba bwe guli, gye guva era nga bwe gutuyamba n’okutuwanguza, n’ebyo bye tuteekwa okukola tulyoke tufune obuyambi bwe olw’ekigendererwa ekyo, si kye ngenderera okulaga kaakano.
